declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsEmbeddedAssociatedPoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05AK, part (1).** An associated point is *embedded* when it is a proper
specialization of another associated point.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev IsEmbeddedAssociatedPoint {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : X.Modules) (x : X) : Prop
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsEmbeddedPoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05AK, part (2).** An embedded point of a scheme is an embedded associated point of
its structure sheaf.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev IsEmbeddedPoint (X : Scheme.{u}) (x : X) : Prop
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsEmbeddedComponent
declarations.doc: **Stacks 05AK, part (3).** An embedded component is the closure of an embedded point.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev IsEmbeddedComponent (X : Scheme.{u}) (Z : Set X) : Prop
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_associatedPoints_of_isGenericPoint_irreducibleComponent_supp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05AL, part (1).** The generic point of an irreducible component of the support of a
coherent sheaf is associated to that sheaf.
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isEmbeddedAssociatedPoint_iff_not_genericPoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05AL, part (2).** An associated point of a coherent sheaf is embedded exactly when
it is not generic in any irreducible component of its support.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEmbeddedAssociatedPoint_iff_not_genericPoint (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsCoherent] (x : X) :
    IsEmbeddedAssociatedPoint F x ↔
      x ∈ Stacks.Divisors.associatedPoints F ∧
        ¬ ∃ Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (↥(SheafOfModules.supp F)),
          IsGenericPoint x (Subtype.val '' Z)
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isEmbeddedPoint_iff_not_genericPoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05AL, concluding assertion.** The embedded points of a locally Noetherian scheme
are precisely its non-generic associated points.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEmbeddedPoint_iff_not_genericPoint (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (x : X) :
    IsEmbeddedPoint X x ↔
      x ∈ Stacks.Divisors.schemeAssociatedPoints X ∧
        ¬ ∃ Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X, IsGenericPoint x Z
declarations.comment: embedded points of the scheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.associatedPoints_subset_weaklyAssociatedPoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05AM.** Every associated point of a sheaf of modules is weakly
associated.
declarations.statement:
lemma associatedPoints_subset_weaklyAssociatedPoints {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : X.Modules) :
    Stacks.Divisors.associatedPoints F ⊆ Stacks.Divisors.weaklyAssociatedPoints F
declarations.comment: associated points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.weaklyAssociatedPoints_subset_supp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05AM.** Every weakly associated point of a sheaf of modules belongs
to its support.
declarations.statement:
lemma weaklyAssociatedPoints_subset_supp {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : X.Modules) :
    Stacks.Divisors.weaklyAssociatedPoints F ⊆ SheafOfModules.supp F
declarations.comment: weakly associated points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.weaklyAssociatedPoints_subset_of_shortExact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05AN.** In a short exact sequence of quasi-coherent modules on a
scheme, the weakly associated points of the first module are weakly associated points of the
middle module.
declarations.statement:
theorem weaklyAssociatedPoints_subset_of_shortExact {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) [S.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₂.IsQuasicoherent]
    [S.X₃.IsQuasicoherent] (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    Stacks.Divisors.weaklyAssociatedPoints S.X₁ ⊆ Stacks.Divisors.weaklyAssociatedPoints S.X₂
declarations.comment: subsheaf_inclusion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.weaklyAssociatedPoints_subset_union_of_shortExact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05AN.** In a short exact sequence of sheaves of modules, every weakly
associated point of the middle term is weakly associated to an outer term.
declarations.statement:
theorem weaklyAssociatedPoints_subset_union_of_shortExact {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    Stacks.Divisors.weaklyAssociatedPoints S.X₂ ⊆
      Stacks.Divisors.weaklyAssociatedPoints S.X₁ ∪
        Stacks.Divisors.weaklyAssociatedPoints S.X₃
declarations.comment: middle_term_inclusion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isZero_iff_weaklyAssociatedPoints_eq_empty
declarations.doc: A quasi-coherent sheaf of modules is zero if and only if it has no weakly associated points.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_iff_weaklyAssociatedPoints_eq_empty {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] : IsZero F ↔ Stacks.Divisors.weaklyAssociatedPoints F = ∅

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_weaklyAssociatedPoints_of_mem_supp_of_specializes
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05AQ.** A point of the support of a quasi-coherent module which is not
a specialization of another point of the support is weakly associated to the module.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_weaklyAssociatedPoints_of_mem_supp_of_specializes (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] (x : X) (hx : x ∈ SheafOfModules.supp F)
    (hmin : ∀ y : X, y ∈ SheafOfModules.supp F → Specializes y x → y = x) :
    x ∈ Stacks.Divisors.weaklyAssociatedPoints F
declarations.comment: minimal point of the support

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_weaklyAssociatedPointsOfScheme_of_isGenericPoint_irreducibleComponent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05AQ.** Every generic point of an irreducible component of a scheme is
weakly associated to its structure sheaf.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_weaklyAssociatedPointsOfScheme_of_isGenericPoint_irreducibleComponent
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {Z : Set X} (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X) {x : X}
    (hx : IsGenericPoint x Z) :
    x ∈ Stacks.Divisors.schemeWeaklyAssociatedPoints X
declarations.comment: generic points of irreducible components

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_associatedPoints_iff_mem_weaklyAssociatedPoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05AR.** At a point whose local-ring maximal ideal is finitely
generated, associated and weakly associated membership of a sheaf of modules coincide.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_associatedPoints_iff_mem_weaklyAssociatedPoints {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : X.Modules)
    (x : X) (h : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)).FG) :
    x ∈ Stacks.Divisors.associatedPoints F ↔
      x ∈ Stacks.Divisors.weaklyAssociatedPoints F
declarations.comment: finite_generated_maximal_ideal

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.associatedPoints_eq_weaklyAssociatedPoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05AR.** On a locally Noetherian scheme, the associated points and
weakly associated points of a sheaf of modules coincide.
declarations.statement:
lemma associatedPoints_eq_weaklyAssociatedPoints (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (F : X.Modules) :
    Stacks.Divisors.associatedPoints F = Stacks.Divisors.weaklyAssociatedPoints F
declarations.comment: locally_noetherian

declarations.name: Stacks.Divisors.relativeAssassin
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05AT.** The *relative assassin* `Ass_{X/S}(F)` of an `𝒪_X`-module
along `f : X ⟶ S` is the union over the points of `S` of the images in `X` of the associated
points of the restriction of `F` to the scheme-theoretic fibre.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def relativeAssassin (f : X ⟶ S) (F : X.Modules) : Set X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.relativeWeaklyAssociatedPoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05AV.** The relative weak assassin of an `𝒪_X`-module `F` along
`f : X ⟶ S`, viewed as a set of points of `X`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev relativeWeaklyAssociatedPoints {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (F : X.Modules) : Set X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isGeometricallyRegularAt_of_flatAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05AW (pointwise statement).** Geometric regularity at a point
descends along a morphism which is flat at that point.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isGeometricallyRegularAt_of_flatAt {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (x : X)
    (hX : IsGeometricallyRegularAt (f ≫ g) x)
    (hf : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom x) :
    IsGeometricallyRegularAt g (f x)
declarations.comment: pointwise statement

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isGeometricallyRegular_of_flat_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05AW (global statement).** A flat surjective image of a
geometrically regular scheme over a field is geometrically regular.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isGeometricallyRegular_of_flat_surjective {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [Flat f] [Surjective f]
    (hX : IsGeometricallyRegular (f ≫ g)) :
    IsGeometricallyRegular g
declarations.comment: global statement

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smoothAt_of_flatAt
declarations.doc:
Smoothness over a field descends at a point through a morphism which is flat there, provided
both schemes are locally of finite type over the field.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smoothAt_of_flatAt
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (p : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType (f ≫ p)] [LocallyOfFiniteType p]
    (x : X) (hX : InfinitesimalLifting.SmoothAt (f ≫ p) x)
    (hf : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom x) :
    InfinitesimalLifting.SmoothAt p (f x)
declarations.comment: pointwise statement

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smooth_of_flat_of_surjective
declarations.doc:
A flat surjective image of a scheme smooth over a field is smooth, when both schemes are
locally of finite type over that field.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smooth_of_flat_of_surjective
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (p : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType p] [Smooth (f ≫ p)]
    [Flat f] [Surjective f] : Smooth p
declarations.comment: global consequence

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.FlatBaseChange.isFiniteType_of_pullback_fpqcCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05AZ.** Let `X` be a scheme and `M` a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module. If
`{f i : 𝒰.X i ⟶ X}` is an fpqc covering of `X` such that every pullback `(f i)^* M` is of finite
type, then `M` is of finite type.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteType_of_pullback_fpqcCover {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (𝒰 : X.Cover.{v} Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage)
    (h : ∀ i, ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (𝒰.f i)).obj M).IsFiniteType) : M.IsFiniteType

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFinitePresentation_of_pullback_fpqcCover
declarations.doc:
A quasi-coherent module whose pullback to every member of an fpqc covering is finitely
presented is itself finitely presented.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isFinitePresentation_of_pullback_fpqcCover
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (𝒰 : X.Cover.{v} Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage)
    (h : ∀ i, ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (𝒰.f i)).obj M).IsFinitePresentation) :
    M.IsFinitePresentation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFlat_of_pullback_fpqc
declarations.doc:
A quasi-coherent module whose pullback to each member of an fpqc covering family is flat is
itself flat.
declarations.statement:
public lemma isFlat_of_pullback_fpqc {S : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type v}
    {X : I → Scheme.{u}} (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ S)
    (hfpqc : Presieve.ofArrows X f ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage S)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing S.toRingedSpace)) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hF : ∀ i, SheafOfModules.IsFlat.{u, u, u, u} (O := (X i).toRingedSpace.sheaf)
      ((modulePullback (f i).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj F)) :
      SheafOfModules.IsFlat.{u, u, u, u} (O := S.toRingedSpace.sheaf) F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_pullback_fpqcCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05B2.** Let `M` be a quasi-coherent module on a scheme `X` and let
`𝒰` be an fpqc covering of `X`. If the pullback of `M` to every member of `𝒰` is finite locally
free, then `M` is finite locally free.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFiniteType_iff_pushforward_isFiniteType
declarations.doc:
A quasi-coherent module on the source of a finite morphism is of finite type if and only if
its direct image is of finite type.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteType_iff_pushforward_isFiniteType (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    F.IsFiniteType ↔ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F).IsFiniteType

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.FinitePushforwardCoherent.isFiniteType_pushforward_iff
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 05B3].** A quasi-coherent module on the source of a finite morphism is of
finite type if and only if its direct image is of finite type.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteType_pushforward_iff [IsFinite f] [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    F.IsFiniteType ↔ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F).IsFiniteType

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFinitePresentation_iff_pushforward_isFinitePresentation
declarations.doc:
A quasi-coherent module on the source of a finite morphism of finite presentation is
finitely presented if and only if its direct image is finitely presented.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isFinitePresentation_iff_pushforward_isFinitePresentation
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f]
    (hf : FinitePresentation f) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    F.IsFinitePresentation ↔
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F).IsFinitePresentation

declarations.name: Stacks.Smooth.smooth_of_comp_of_fppf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05B5 (smooth case).** Smoothness descends along a surjective flat
morphism which is locally of finite presentation: if `f : X ⟶ Y` is surjective, flat and locally
of finite presentation and `f ≫ q` is smooth, then `q : Y ⟶ S` is smooth.
declarations.statement:
theorem smooth_of_comp_of_fppf (f : X ⟶ Y) (q : Y ⟶ S) [Surjective f] [Flat f]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [Smooth (f ≫ q)] : Smooth q
declarations.comment: smooth_permanence

declarations.name: Stacks.Etale.etale_of_comp_of_fppf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05B5 (étale case).** Étaleness descends along a surjective flat
morphism which is locally of finite presentation: if `f : X ⟶ Y` is surjective, flat and locally
of finite presentation and `f ≫ q` is étale, then `q : Y ⟶ S` is étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem etale_of_comp_of_fppf (f : X ⟶ Y) (q : Y ⟶ S) [Surjective f] [Flat f]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [Etale (f ≫ q)] : Etale q
declarations.comment: etale_permanence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.syntomic_of_comp_of_fppf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05B7.** Syntomicity descends along a surjective flat morphism which is
locally of finite presentation: if `f : X ⟶ Y` is surjective, flat and locally of finite
presentation and `f ≫ q` is syntomic, then `q : Y ⟶ S` is syntomic.
declarations.statement:
theorem syntomic_of_comp_of_fppf (f : X ⟶ Y) (q : Y ⟶ S) [Surjective f] [Flat f]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (hp : Syntomic (f ≫ q)) : Syntomic q
declarations.comment: q_syntomic

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.syntomic_of_syntomic_comp_of_fppf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05B7.** A surjective flat morphism locally of finite presentation is
syntomic as soon as its composite with another morphism is syntomic.
declarations.statement:
theorem syntomic_of_syntomic_comp_of_fppf [Surjective f] [Flat f]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (hp : Syntomic (f ≫ q)) : Syntomic f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.syntomic_of_syntomic_comp_of_fppf
declarations.doc:
If `f : X ⟶ Y` is surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation and `f ≫ q` is
syntomic, then `f` is syntomic.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_open_preimage_le
declarations.doc:
For a finite morphism whose fibre over `y` is the singleton `x`, the inverse image of
some open neighbourhood of `y` is contained in any prescribed open neighbourhood of `x`.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_open_preimage_le {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f]
    (x : X) (y : Y) (hxy : f x = y) (hfiber : f ⁻¹' {y} = {x})
    (U : X.Opens) (hxU : x ∈ U) :
    ∃ V : Y.Opens, y ∈ V ∧ f ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ U
declarations.comment: inverse_image_neighbourhoods

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.finite_stalkMap_of_preimage_singleton
declarations.doc:
For a finite morphism with a singleton fibre at `x`, the induced map on the local rings at
`f x` and `x` is finite.
declarations.statement:
lemma finite_stalkMap_of_preimage_singleton
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f]
    (x : X) (hx : f ⁻¹' {f x} = {x}) :
    (f.stalkMap x).hom.Finite
declarations.comment: finite_local_ring_map

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.finitePresentation_stalkMap_of_preimage_singleton
declarations.doc:
If a finite morphism of finite presentation has a singleton fibre over
`f x`, its local-ring map at `x` is of finite presentation.
declarations.statement:
lemma finitePresentation_stalkMap_of_preimage_singleton
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f]
    (x : X) (hx : f ⁻¹' {f x} = {x}) (hfp : FinitePresentation f) :
    (f.stalkMap x).hom.FinitePresentation
declarations.comment: finitely_presented_local_ring_map

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_linearEquiv_stalkPushforward_of_finite_singleton_fiber
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be finite and suppose that the fibre over `f x` is the singleton `{x}`.
For a quasi-coherent `O_X`-module `F` we have `F_x = (f_* F)_{f x}` as `O_{Y,f x}`-modules:
the canonical map `TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPushforward` from the stalk of `f_* F` at `f x` to the
stalk of `F` at `x` (sending the germ of a section over `V` to the germ of the same section
over `f ⁻¹ V`) is an `O_{Y,f x}`-linear isomorphism, where `O_{Y,f x}` acts on `F_x` through
the stalk map. The statement provides a linear equivalence whose underlying function is this
canonical map.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_linearEquiv_stalkPushforward_of_finite_singleton_fiber
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f]
    (x : X) (hfiber : f ⁻¹' ({f x} : Set Y) = {x})
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) :=
      PresheafOfModules.instModuleCarrierStalkCommRingCatCarrierAbPresheafOpensCarrier
        (R := X.presheaf) F.val x
    letI : Module (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x))
        ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x) :=
      Module.compHom _ (f.stalkMap x).hom
    letI : Module (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x))
        ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F).val.presheaf (f x)) :=
      PresheafOfModules.instModuleCarrierStalkCommRingCatCarrierAbPresheafOpensCarrier
        (R := Y.presheaf) ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F).val (f x)
    ∃ e : ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F).val.presheaf (f x)) ≃ₗ[Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)]
        ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf x),
      ⇑e = ConcreteCategory.hom
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPushforward Ab f.base F.val.presheaf x)
declarations.comment: pushforward_stalk

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFlatOverAt_comp_iff_of_etale
declarations.doc:
Flatness of a quasi-coherent module at a point is unchanged when the base
is replaced by an étale intermediate scheme.
declarations.comment: pointwise statement

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFlatOver_comp_iff_of_etale
declarations.doc:
A quasi-coherent module is flat over the base if and only if it is flat
over an étale intermediate scheme.
declarations.comment: global statement

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.flat_stalk_iff_of_etale
declarations.doc:
Let `f : T ⟶ S` be étale, let `t : T` and let `M` be a module over `𝒪_{T,t}`. Then `M` is
flat over `𝒪_{S,f(t)}`, acting through the map of local rings, if and only if it is flat over
`𝒪_{T,t}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem flat_stalk_iff_of_etale [Etale f] (t : T) (M : Type*) [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module (T.presheaf.stalk t) M] :
    letI : Module (S.presheaf.stalk (f t)) M := Module.compHom M (f.stalkMap t).hom
    Module.Flat (S.presheaf.stalk (f t)) M ↔ Module.Flat (T.presheaf.stalk t) M

declarations.name: AdicCompletion.universallyInjective_directSumToPi
declarations.doc:
Let `R` be a Noetherian ring that is `I`-adically complete. Then the canonical map
`(⊕_{α ∈ A} R)^∧ → ∏_{α ∈ A} R` from the `I`-adic completion of a direct sum of copies of `R`
into the product of copies of `R` is universally injective.
declarations.statement:
theorem AdicCompletion.universallyInjective_directSumToPi
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (A : Type v)
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsAdicComplete I R] :
    UniversallyInjective (AdicCompletion.directSumToPi R I A)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_affine_locallyFinitePresentation_separation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05BD.** A closed subscheme of a base change `X ×_S T` avoiding the
fibre of `X ×_S T ⟶ T` over a point `t`, for `f : X ⟶ S` quasi-compact, can be separated from
that fibre already over an affine base locally of finite presentation over `S`: there is an
affine open `V ∋ t`, an affine `T'` locally of finite presentation over `S` with a factorization
of `V ⟶ T` through it, and a closed subscheme of `X ×_S T'` containing the restriction of the
given one and still avoiding the fibre over the image of `t`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_affine_locallyFinitePresentation_separation
    {X S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] (g : T ⟶ S)
    (t : T) (I : (pullback f g).IdealSheafData)
    (ht : t ∉ Set.image (pullback.snd f g) I.support.1) :
    ∃ (V : T.affineOpens) (htV : t ∈ V.1)
      (T' : Scheme.{u}) (_ : IsAffine T') (b : T' ⟶ S)
      (_ : LocallyOfFinitePresentation b) (a : V.1.toScheme ⟶ T')
      (_ : V.1.ι ≫ g = a ≫ b)
      (I' : (pullback f b).IdealSheafData)
      (p : pullback f (V.1.ι ≫ g) ⟶ pullback f g)
      (q : pullback f (V.1.ι ≫ g) ⟶ pullback f b),
      (p ≫ pullback.fst f g = pullback.fst f (V.1.ι ≫ g)) ∧
      (p ≫ pullback.snd f g = pullback.snd f (V.1.ι ≫ g) ≫ V.1.ι) ∧
      (q ≫ pullback.fst f b = pullback.fst f (V.1.ι ≫ g)) ∧
      (q ≫ pullback.snd f b = pullback.snd f (V.1.ι ≫ g) ≫ a) ∧
      (a ⟨t, htV⟩ ∉ Set.image (pullback.snd f b) I'.support.1) ∧
      (I'.comap q ≤ I.comap p)

declarations.name: Module.FinitePresentation.tensorProduct

**Stacks 05BS (2).** The tensor product of two finitely presented modules is finitely
presented.
declarations.statement:
instance Module.FinitePresentation.tensorProduct

    Module.FinitePresentation R (M ⊗[R] N)
