registrations.name: Algebra.QuasiFinite.finite_comap_preimage_singleton
registrations.comment: in the generality of a quasi-finite algebra

declarations.name: Algebra.IsGeometricallyIntegral
declarations.doc:
A `k`-algebra `S` is **geometrically integral over `k`** if every base change of
`Spec S ⟶ Spec k` along a field-valued point of `Spec k` is an integral scheme, equivalently
if for every field extension `k'/k` the ring `S ⊗[k] k'` is a domain
(`Algebra.isGeometricallyIntegral_iff_isDomain_tensorProduct`).
declarations.statement:
public abbrev Algebra.IsGeometricallyIntegral (k S : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra k S] : Prop

declarations.name: geometricallyIntegral_iff_irreducible_and_reduced
declarations.doc:
A `k`-algebra `S` is geometrically integral over `k` if and only if it is both
geometrically irreducible and geometrically reduced over `k`. This is Stacks tag 05DY.

`GeometricallyReduced` uses the convention `IsReduced (k' ⊗[k] S)` (extension on the
left). The local statements about `S ⊗[k] k'` (algebra on the left) are interchanged with
these via the canonical ring isomorphism `Algebra.TensorProduct.comm`.
declarations.statement:
theorem geometricallyIntegral_iff_irreducible_and_reduced
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (S : Type v) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] :
    GeometricallyIntegral.{u, v, w} k S ↔
      GeometricallyIrreducible.{u, v, w} k S ∧ GeometricallyReduced.{u, v, w} k S

declarations.name: Module.associatedPrimes.image_comap_associatedPrimes_eq_associatedPrimes
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05DZ.** Let `S` be an `R`-algebra and let `M` be an `S`-module, viewed as an
`R`-module through `algebraMap R S`. If `S` is Noetherian, then contracting ideals along
`algebraMap R S` — the map `Spec(φ)` on spectra — carries the associated primes of `M` over `S`
onto the associated primes of `M` over `R`: `Spec(φ)(Ass_S(M)) = Ass_R(M)`.

The inclusion `⊆` needs no Noetherian hypothesis (Stacks 05BW), and by Stacks 05BX the reverse
inclusion genuinely does.
declarations.statement:
public theorem Module.associatedPrimes.image_comap_associatedPrimes_eq_associatedPrimes
    {R S : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S] [Algebra R S] [IsNoetherianRing S]
    {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module S M] [Module R M] [IsScalarTower R S M] :
    Ideal.comap (algebraMap R S) '' associatedPrimes S M = associatedPrimes R M

declarations.name: weakAss_eq_comap_image_of_finite
declarations.doc:
For a finite ring map `φ : R → S` and an `S`-module `M`, the weakly associated primes of `M`
over `R` are exactly the contractions along `f = Spec(φ)` of the weakly associated primes of `M`
over `S`, i.e. `WeakAss_R(M) = f(WeakAss_S(M))` as subsets of `Spec(R)`.

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.contravariant_hom_ext_one_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05E2 (1).** For a short exact sequence `0 → X₁ → X₂ → X₃ → 0` and an object `N`,
the sequence
`0 → Hom(X₃, N) → Hom(X₂, N) → Hom(X₁, N) → Ext¹(X₃, N) → Ext¹(X₂, N) → Ext¹(X₁, N)`
is exact: the six-term sequence `Ext⁰(X₃, N) → ⋯ → Ext¹(X₁, N)` is exact and its first map,
precomposition with `X₂ → X₃`, is injective.
declarations.statement:
theorem contravariant_hom_ext_one_exact (N : C) :
    (contravariantSequence hS N 0 1 (add_zero 1)).Exact ∧
      Function.Injective ((mk₀ S.g).precomp N (zero_add 0))
declarations.comment:
(1), with Mathlib's derived-category `Ext` in place of Yoneda extensions and
`Hom(A, N)` as `Ext A N 0` (see `Ext.addEquiv₀`)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.covariant_hom_ext_one_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05E2 (2).** For a short exact sequence `0 → X₁ → X₂ → X₃ → 0` and an object `N`,
the sequence
`0 → Hom(N, X₁) → Hom(N, X₂) → Hom(N, X₃) → Ext¹(N, X₁) → Ext¹(N, X₂) → Ext¹(N, X₃)`
is exact: the six-term sequence `Ext⁰(N, X₁) → ⋯ → Ext¹(N, X₃)` is exact and its first map,
postcomposition with `X₁ → X₂`, is injective.
declarations.statement:
theorem covariant_hom_ext_one_exact (N : C) :
    (covariantSequence N hS 0 1 (zero_add 1)).Exact ∧
      Function.Injective ((mk₀ S.f).postcomp N (add_zero 0))
declarations.comment:
(2), with Mathlib's derived-category `Ext` in place of Yoneda extensions and
`Hom(N, A)` as `Ext N A 0` (see `Ext.addEquiv₀`)

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.contravariantSequence_exact
registrations.comment:
part (1): the contravariant long exact sequence of Ext groups attached to a
  short exact sequence.

declarations.name: IsIPowerTorsion
declarations.doc:
An `R`-module `M` is *`I`-power torsion* if for every `m ∈ M` there exists an
integer `n > 0` such that `Iⁿ m = 0`, i.e. `a • m = 0` for every `a ∈ Iⁿ`.
declarations.statement:
def IsIPowerTorsion (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] (M : Type*) [AddCommMonoid M]
    [Module R M] (I : Ideal R) : Prop

declarations.name: IsElementPowerTorsion
declarations.doc:
An `R`-module `M` is *`f`-power torsion* if every element is annihilated by some strictly
positive power of `f`.
declarations.statement:
def IsElementPowerTorsion (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] (M : Type*) [AddCommMonoid M]
    [Module R M] (f : R) : Prop

declarations.name: FormalGlueing.flat_and_faithful_on_ideal_torsion_tfae
declarations.statement:
public theorem flat_and_faithful_on_ideal_torsion_tfae
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] (I : Ideal R) :
    let q : R ⧸ I →+* S ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R S) :=
      Ideal.quotientMap (I.map (algebraMap R S)) (algebraMap R S) Ideal.le_comap_map
    List.TFAE
      [ Module.Flat R S ∧ RingHom.FaithfullyFlat q,
        Module.Flat R S ∧ Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap q),
        Module.Flat R S ∧
          ∀ (M N : Type (max u v)) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
            [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N],
            I ≤ Module.annihilator R M → I ≤ Module.annihilator R N →
              Function.Injective fun f : M →ₗ[R] N ↦ LinearMap.rTensor S f,
        Module.Flat R S ∧
          ∀ (M N : Type (max u v)) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
            [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N],
            IsIPowerTorsion R M I → IsIPowerTorsion R N I →
              Function.Injective fun f : M →ₗ[R] N ↦ LinearMap.rTensor S f ]

declarations.name: exists_directSum_quotient_resolution
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05E8.** An `I`-power torsion module admits an exact resolution whose terms are
direct sums of quotients of the ring by positive powers of `I`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_directSum_quotient_resolution
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (hM : IsIPowerTorsion R M I) :
    ∃ (α : ℕ → Type (max u v)) (n : ∀ i, α i → ℕ),
      (∀ i a, 0 < n i a) ∧
        ∃ (d : ∀ i,
            DirectSum (α (i + 1)) (fun a ↦ R ⧸ I ^ n (i + 1) a) →ₗ[R]
              DirectSum (α i) (fun a ↦ R ⧸ I ^ n i a))
          (ε : DirectSum (α 0) (fun a ↦ R ⧸ I ^ n 0 a) →ₗ[R] M),
          Function.Surjective ε ∧ Function.Exact (d 0) ε ∧
            ∀ i, Function.Exact (d (i + 1)) (d i)

registrations.name: IPowerTorsion.baseChange_bijective_iff_quotientMap_bijective
registrations.comment: the base-change criterion on ideal-power torsion modules

declarations.name: torsionBySet_eq_bot_iff_powers_eq_bot_iff_bigLambda_injective
declarations.doc:
For a finitely generated ideal `I`, the following are equivalent: no
nonzero element of `M` is annihilated by `I`; the same holds for every positive power of `I`;
and, for every finite generating family of `I`, the canonical map from `M` to the direct sum of
the localizations at those generators is injective.
declarations.statement:
theorem torsionBySet_eq_bot_iff_powers_eq_bot_iff_bigLambda_injective
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (hI : I.FG) :
    (Submodule.torsionBySet R M (I : Set R) = ⊥ ↔
      ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → Submodule.torsionBySet R M ((I ^ n : Ideal R) : Set R) = ⊥) ∧
    ((∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → Submodule.torsionBySet R M ((I ^ n : Ideal R) : Set R) = ⊥) ↔
      ∀ (t : ℕ) (f : Fin t → R), I = Ideal.span (Set.range f) →
        Function.Injective (bigLambda (M := M) t f))

declarations.name: torsionBySet_quotient_primaryComponent_eq_bot_and_isIPowerTorsion_of_exact
declarations.doc:
For a finitely generated ideal `I`, the quotient of any module by its
`I`-primary component has no nonzero elements annihilated by `I`. Moreover, in a short exact
sequence, if the first and third modules are `I`-power torsion, then so is the middle module.
declarations.statement:
theorem torsionBySet_quotient_primaryComponent_eq_bot_and_isIPowerTorsion_of_exact
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (hI : I.FG) :
    (∀ (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M],
      Submodule.torsionBySet R (M ⧸ (Ideal.primaryComponent M I)) (I : Set R) = ⊥) ∧
    ∀ (M₁ : Type v₁) (M₂ : Type v₂) (M₃ : Type v₃)
      [AddCommGroup M₁] [Module R M₁] [AddCommGroup M₂] [Module R M₂]
      [AddCommGroup M₃] [Module R M₃]
      (f : M₁ →ₗ[R] M₂) (g : M₂ →ₗ[R] M₃),
      Function.Injective f → Function.Exact f g → Function.Surjective g →
        IsIPowerTorsion R M₁ I →
        IsIPowerTorsion R M₃ I →
        IsIPowerTorsion R M₂ I

registrations.name: IPowerTorsion.baseChange_equiv_of_quotientMap_bijective
registrations.comment: the torsion-submodule isomorphism and the equivalence of subcategories

declarations.name: Stacks.RelationsOfSequence.short_exact
declarations.doc:
The sequence `0 → K → M → I → 0` is exact: the inclusion `K ↪ M` and `φ` are exact at `M`, and
the range of `φ` is the ideal `I = (f_1, …, f_n)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem short_exact :
    Function.Exact (K f).subtype (phi f) ∧
      LinearMap.range (phi f) = (idealI f).restrictScalars R

declarations.name: Stacks.RelationsOfSequence.K_annihilated
declarations.doc: The kernel `K = ker φ` is annihilated by the ideal `I = (f_1, …, f_n)`.
declarations.statement: theorem K_annihilated : ∀ a ∈ idealI f, ∀ k ∈ K f, a • k = 0

declarations.name: FormalGlueing.extOne_exact_firstRelationHomology_to_kernelHom
declarations.doc:
There is a canonical exact sequence
`0 → Ext¹_R(R / (f), N) → H₁(N, f) → Hom_R(K, N)`, where `K` is the kernel from
Stacks 05ED.
declarations.statement:
public theorem extOne_exact_firstRelationHomology_to_kernelHom
    (N : Type v) [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] :
    ∃ i : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext
        (ModuleCat.of R (ULift.{max u v} (R ⧸ Stacks.RelationsOfSequence.idealI f)))
        (ModuleCat.of R (ULift.{max u v} N)) 1 →ₗ[R] firstRelationHomology f N,
      (∀ g : Stacks.RelationsOfSequence.idealI f →ₗ[R] N,
          i (idealHomToExtOne f N g) = idealHomToFirstRelationHomology f N g) ∧
        Function.Injective i ∧ Function.Exact i (firstRelationHomologyToKernelHom f N) ∧
        ∀ j : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext
            (ModuleCat.of R (ULift.{max u v} (R ⧸ Stacks.RelationsOfSequence.idealI f)))
            (ModuleCat.of R (ULift.{max u v} N)) 1 →ₗ[R] firstRelationHomology f N,
          (∀ g : Stacks.RelationsOfSequence.idealI f →ₗ[R] N,
            j (idealHomToExtOne f N g) = idealHomToFirstRelationHomology f N g) → j = i

declarations.name: FormalGlueing.idealI_le_annihilator_firstRelationHomology
declarations.doc:
The ideal generated by a finite family annihilates its first relation
homology with coefficients in any module.
declarations.statement:
public theorem idealI_le_annihilator_firstRelationHomology
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → R)
    (N : Type v) [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] :
    Stacks.RelationsOfSequence.idealI f ≤ Module.annihilator R (FormalGlueing.firstRelationHomology
      f N)

declarations.name: FormalGlueing.exists_shortExactSequence_lift_of_flat_baseChange
declarations.doc:
A short exact sequence over `S` ending in the base change of an
`I`-power torsion module fits below a short exact sequence over `R`, provided `R → S` is flat
and induces an isomorphism modulo the finitely generated ideal `I`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_shortExactSequence_lift_of_flat_baseChange
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I.FG) (hflat : Module.Flat R S)
    (hq : Function.Bijective
      (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map (algebraMap R S)) (algebraMap R S) Ideal.le_comap_map))
    (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (N : Type x) [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    (hM : IsIPowerTorsion R M I)
    (E' : Type y) [AddCommGroup E'] [Module R E'] [Module S E'] [IsScalarTower R S E']
    (i : TensorProduct R S N →ₗ[S] E')
    (p : E' →ₗ[S] TensorProduct R S M)
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (hp : Function.Surjective p)
    (hexact : Function.Exact i p) :
    ∃ (E : Type (max x (max w y))) (_ : AddCommGroup E) (_ : Module R E)
      (a : N →ₗ[R] E) (b : E →ₗ[R] M) (c : E →ₗ[R] E'),
      Function.Injective a ∧ Function.Exact a b ∧ Function.Surjective b ∧
        c.comp a = (i.restrictScalars R).comp ((TensorProduct.mk R S N) 1) ∧
        ((TensorProduct.mk R S M) 1).comp b = (p.restrictScalars R).comp c

declarations.name: Dualizing.PowerTorsionBaseChange.bijective_extBaseChange_of_powerTorsion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05EH.** The canonical scalar-extension map on Ext groups from an
`I`-power-torsion module is bijective in every degree.
declarations.statement:
theorem bijective_extBaseChange_of_powerTorsion
    (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) (hflat : Module.Flat A B)
    (hquot : Function.Bijective
      (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map (algebraMap A B)) (algebraMap A B)
        Ideal.le_comap_map))
    (M N : ModuleCat.{max uA (max uR uM)} A) (hM : IsIPowerTorsion A M I) (i : ℕ) :
    let F := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{uR, uA, max uA (max uR uM)} (algebraMap A B)
    letI : F.IsLeftAdjoint :=
      (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj.{max uR uM, uR, uA}
        (algebraMap A B)).isLeftAdjoint
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits F :=
      preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat.{uR, uA, uM} A B hflat
    letI : F.Additive := F.additive_of_preserves_binary_products
    letI := CategoryTheory.HasExt.standard (ModuleCat.{max uA (max uR uM)} A)
    letI := CategoryTheory.HasExt.standard (ModuleCat.{max uA (max uR uM)} B)
    Function.Bijective (F.mapExtAddHom M N i)
declarations.comment: Ext

declarations.name: Dualizing.PowerTorsionBaseChange.isIso_derivedHomBaseChangeMate_of_powerTorsion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05EH.** Derived Hom from a complex with `I`-power-torsion cohomology is
unchanged under flat base change which is an isomorphism modulo `I`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedHomBaseChangeMate_of_powerTorsion
    (A : Type uR) (B : Type uA) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) (hflat : Module.Flat A B)
    (hquot : Function.Bijective
      (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map (algebraMap A B)) (algebraMap A B)
        Ideal.le_comap_map))
    :
    letI : (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{uR, uA, max uA (max uR uM)} (algebraMap A B)).IsLeftAdjoint :=
      (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj.{max uR uM, uR, uA}
        (algebraMap A B)).isLeftAdjoint
    letI : (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max uA (max uR uM), uR, uA}
        (algebraMap A B)).IsRightAdjoint :=
      (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj.{max uR uM, uR, uA}
        (algebraMap A B)).isRightAdjoint
    letI : (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max uA (max uR uM), uR, uA}
        (algebraMap A B)).IsLeftAdjoint :=
      (ModuleCat.restrictCoextendScalarsAdj.{max uR uM, uR, uA}
        (algebraMap A B)).isLeftAdjoint
    ∀ (F : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uA (max uR uM)} A) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uA (max uR uM)} B))
    (comparison : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ F ⟶
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{uR, uA, max uA (max uR uM)} (algebraMap A B)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    [F.IsLeftDerivedFunctor comparison
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{max uA (max uR uM)} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    (K L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max uA (max uR uM)} A)),
    Dualizing.derivedPowerTorsionProperty A I hI K →
    IsIso ((Stacks.DerivedHom.ExtensionOfScalars.derivedHomBaseChangeMate.{uR, uA, uM}
      (algebraMap A B) F comparison).app (Opposite.op K, L))
declarations.comment: derived Hom

declarations.name: FormalGlueing.glueingBeta_comp_glueingAlpha
declarations.doc:
The maps `glueingAlpha` and `glueingBeta` form the glueing complex of Stacks Project,
Tag 05EJ.
declarations.statement:
public theorem glueingBeta_comp_glueingAlpha :
    (glueingBeta S f M).comp (glueingAlpha S f M) = 0

declarations.name: FormalGlueing.glueingComplex_exact
declarations.doc:
If `R → S` is flat and induces an isomorphism modulo the ideal generated by `f`, then the
glueing complex of every `R`-module is exact, including at its initial term.
declarations.statement:
public theorem glueingComplex_exact
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → R) (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (hflat : Module.Flat R S)
    (hq : Function.Bijective
      (Ideal.quotientMap
        ((Ideal.span (Set.range f)).map (algebraMap R S))
        (algebraMap R S) Ideal.le_comap_map)) :
    Function.Injective (glueingAlpha S f M) ∧
      Function.Exact (glueingAlpha S f M) (glueingBeta S f M)

declarations.name: FormalGlueing.moduleGlueingConstruction
declarations.doc:
The category `Glue(R → S, f₁, …, fₜ)`, its canonical functor from `R`-modules, and its
compatible-sections functor `H⁰`.
declarations.statement: public noncomputable def moduleGlueingConstruction : ModuleGlueingConstruction S f

declarations.name: FormalGlueing.canonicalSectionsUnit_isIso
declarations.doc:
If a flat ring map is an isomorphism modulo the ideal generated by `f`, then compatible
sections are a left quasi-inverse to the canonical module glueing functor.
declarations.statement:
public theorem canonicalSectionsUnit_isIso
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → R) (hflat : Module.Flat R S)
    (hq : Function.Bijective
      (Ideal.quotientMap
        ((Ideal.span (Set.range f)).map (algebraMap R S))
        (algebraMap R S) Ideal.le_comap_map)) :
    let c := moduleGlueingConstruction.{u, v, w} S f
    letI := c.category
    IsIso c.canonicalSectionsUnit

declarations.name: FormalGlueing.moduleGlueingConstruction_abelian_exact_preservesColimits
declarations.doc:
For a flat ring map, the category of module glueing data is abelian, and the canonical
functor from modules is exact and preserves arbitrary colimits.
declarations.statement:
public theorem moduleGlueingConstruction_abelian_exact_preservesColimits
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (S : Type v) [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [Module.Flat R S]
    {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → R) :
    let c := moduleGlueingConstruction.{u, v, w} S f
    letI := c.category
    Nonempty (Abelian (ModuleGlueingDatum.{u, v, w} S f c.comparison)) ∧
      exactFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u v w} R)
        (ModuleGlueingDatum.{u, v, w} S f c.comparison) c.canonical ∧
      PreservesColimits c.canonical

declarations.name: FormalGlueing.canonicalFunctor_sections_areQuasiInverse_of_span_eq_top
declarations.doc:
If a finite family generates the unit ideal and `R → S` is flat, then the canonical module
glueing functor and compatible sections are quasi-inverse equivalences of categories.
declarations.statement:
public theorem canonicalFunctor_sections_areQuasiInverse_of_span_eq_top
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → R) (hflat : Module.Flat R S)
    (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤) :
    let c := moduleGlueingConstruction.{u, v, w} S f
    letI := c.category
    ∃ e : ModuleCat.{max u v w} R ≌ ModuleGlueingDatum.{u, v, w} S f c.comparison,
      e.functor = c.canonical ∧ e.inverse = c.sections

declarations.name: FormalGlueing.exists_baseChange_commuting_with_canonical_and_sections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05EQ.** Flat base change defines a functor on module glueing data which commutes,
up to natural isomorphism, with the canonical glueing-data functor and compatible global
sections. Its generic and local components, including their action on morphisms, are the
corresponding scalar-extension functors.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_baseChange_commuting_with_canonical_and_sections
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) (R' : Type x)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing R'] [Algebra R S] [Algebra R R']
    {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → R) (hR' : Module.Flat R R') :
    let upper := FormalGlueing.moduleGlueingConstruction.{u, v, max u v x w} S f
    let lower := FormalGlueing.moduleGlueingConstruction.{x, max v x, max u v x w}
      (TensorProduct R S R') (fun i ↦ algebraMap R R' (f i))
    letI := upper.category
    letI := lower.category
    let genericMap : S →+* TensorProduct R S R' :=
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom
    let localMap : ∀ i, Localization.Away (f i) →+*
        Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (f i)) := fun i ↦
      IsLocalization.Away.map (Localization.Away (f i))
        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (f i))) (algebraMap R R') (f i)
    ∃ (baseChange :
        FormalGlueing.ModuleGlueingDatum S f upper.comparison ⥤
          FormalGlueing.ModuleGlueingDatum (TensorProduct R S R')
            (fun i ↦ algebraMap R R' (f i)) lower.comparison)
      (genericIso : ∀ X, (baseChange.obj X).generic ≅
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars genericMap).obj X.generic)
      (localIso : ∀ X i, (baseChange.obj X).localPiece i ≅
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars (localMap i)).obj (X.localPiece i))
      (genericLocalizationIso : ∀ X i,
        LocalizedModule.Away
            (algebraMap R' (TensorProduct R S R') (algebraMap R R' (f i)))
            (baseChange.obj X).generic ≃ₗ[TensorProduct R S R']
          TensorProduct S (TensorProduct R S R')
            (LocalizedModule.Away (algebraMap R S (f i)) X.generic))
      (genericLocalTensorIso : ∀ X i,
        TensorProduct R' (TensorProduct R S R')
            (FormalGlueing.restrictFromAway
              (R := R') (fun i ↦ algebraMap R R' (f i)) i
              ((baseChange.obj X).localPiece i)) ≃ₗ[TensorProduct R S R']
          TensorProduct S (TensorProduct R S R')
            (TensorProduct R S
              (FormalGlueing.restrictFromAway (R := R) f i (X.localPiece i))))
      (localOverlapIso : ∀ X i j,
        Cech.cechMod (fun i ↦ algebraMap R R' (f i))
            (FormalGlueing.restrictFromAway
              (R := R') (fun i ↦ algebraMap R R' (f i)) i
              ((baseChange.obj X).localPiece i)) {j} ≃ₗ[R']
          TensorProduct R R'
            (Cech.cechMod f
              (FormalGlueing.restrictFromAway (R := R) f i (X.localPiece i)) {j})),
      (∀ {X Y} (g : X ⟶ Y),
        (lower.homEquiv (baseChange.obj X) (baseChange.obj Y)
              (baseChange.map g)).generic ≫ (genericIso Y).hom =
          (genericIso X).hom ≫
            (ModuleCat.extendScalars genericMap).map
              (upper.homEquiv X Y g).generic) ∧
        (∀ {X Y} (g : X ⟶ Y) i,
          (lower.homEquiv (baseChange.obj X) (baseChange.obj Y)
                (baseChange.map g)).localPiece i ≫ (localIso Y i).hom =
            (localIso X i).hom ≫
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (localMap i)).map
                ((upper.homEquiv X Y g).localPiece i)) ∧
        (∀ X i (m : X.generic) (t : TensorProduct R S R'),
          genericLocalizationIso X i
              (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap
                (Submonoid.powers
                  (algebraMap R' (TensorProduct R S R') (algebraMap R R' (f i)))) _
                ((genericIso X).inv (t ⊗ₜ[S] m))) =
            t ⊗ₜ[S]
              LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap
                (Submonoid.powers (algebraMap R S (f i))) _ m) ∧
        (∀ (X : FormalGlueing.ModuleGlueingDatum S f upper.comparison) i,
          letI : Module R (X.localPiece i) :=
            Module.compHom _ (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (f i)))
          ∀ (m : X.localPiece i) (t : TensorProduct R S R'),
          genericLocalTensorIso X i
              (t ⊗ₜ[R'] (localIso X i).inv
                ((1 : Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (f i)))
                  ⊗ₜ[Localization.Away (f i)] m)) =
            t ⊗ₜ[S] (1 ⊗ₜ[R] m)) ∧
        (∀ (X : FormalGlueing.ModuleGlueingDatum S f upper.comparison) i j,
          letI : Module R (X.localPiece i) :=
            Module.compHom _ (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (f i)))
          ∀ (m : X.localPiece i),
          localOverlapIso X i j
              (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap
                (Cech.cechSub (fun i ↦ algebraMap R R' (f i)) {j}) _
                ((localIso X i).inv
                  ((1 : Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (f i)))
                    ⊗ₜ[Localization.Away (f i)] m))) =
            1 ⊗ₜ[R]
              LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Cech.cechSub f {j}) _ m) ∧
        (∀ X i d,
          genericLocalTensorIso X i ((baseChange.obj X).alpha i d) =
            TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (X.alpha i).toLinearMap
              (genericLocalizationIso X i d)) ∧
        (∀ X i j d,
          localOverlapIso X j i ((baseChange.obj X).alphaIJ i j d) =
            TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (X.alphaIJ i j).toLinearMap
              (localOverlapIso X i j d)) ∧
        Nonempty
          (upper.canonical ⋙ baseChange ≅
            ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R R') ⋙ lower.canonical) ∧
        Nonempty
          (upper.sections ⋙ ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R R') ≅
            baseChange ⋙ lower.sections)

declarations.name: FormalGlueing.canonicalFunctor_sections_areQuasiInverse
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05ER.** For a flat ring map inducing an isomorphism modulo the ideal generated by
`f`, the canonical module glueing functor and compatible sections are quasi-inverse equivalences
of categories.
declarations.statement:
public theorem canonicalFunctor_sections_areQuasiInverse
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → R) (hflat : Module.Flat R S)
    (hq : Function.Bijective
      (Ideal.quotientMap
        ((Ideal.span (Set.range f)).map (algebraMap R S))
        (algebraMap R S) Ideal.le_comap_map)) :
    let c := moduleGlueingConstruction.{u, v, w} S f
    letI := c.category
    ∃ e : ModuleCat.{max u v w} R ≌ ModuleGlueingDatum.{u, v, w} S f c.comparison,
      e.functor = c.canonical ∧ e.inverse = c.sections

declarations.name: FormalGlueing.exists_canonicalModuleGlueingEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05ES.** For a flat ring map inducing an isomorphism modulo `(f)`, the canonical
functor from modules over the source to pairs of modules identified after localization is an
equivalence of categories.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_canonicalModuleGlueingEquivalence
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (f : R) (hflat : Module.Flat R S)
    (hq : Function.Bijective
      (Ideal.quotientMap
        ((Ideal.span {f}).map (algebraMap R S))
        (algebraMap R S) Ideal.le_comap_map)) :
    let Rf := Localization.Away f
    let Sf := Localization.Away (algebraMap R S f)
    let ρ := principalLocalizationMap R S f
    letI : Algebra Rf Sf := ρ.toAlgebra
    let generic := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, v, max u v w} (algebraMap R S)
    let localPiece := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, max u v w} (algebraMap R Rf)
    let genericOverlap := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{v, v, max u v w} (algebraMap S Sf)
    let localOverlap := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, v, max u v w} (algebraMap Rf Sf)
    ∃ comparison : generic ⋙ genericOverlap ≅ localPiece ⋙ localOverlap,
      (∀ (M : ModuleCat.{max u v w} R) (m : M),
        comparison.hom.app M
            ((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj.{max u v w, v, v}
              (algebraMap S Sf)).unit.app
              (generic.obj M)
              ((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj.{max u v w, u, v}
                (algebraMap R S)).unit.app M m)) =
          (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj.{max u v w, u, v}
            (algebraMap Rf Sf)).unit.app
            (localPiece.obj M)
            ((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj.{max u v w, u, u}
              (algebraMap R Rf)).unit.app M m)) ∧
      ((CategoricalPullback.CatCommSqOver.toFunctorToCategoricalPullback
        genericOverlap localOverlap (ModuleCat.{max u v w} R)).obj
        { fst := generic
          snd := localPiece
          iso := comparison }).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: FormalGlueing.exists_adicCompletionGlueingEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05ET.** Over a Noetherian ring, finitely generated modules are equivalent to
finitely generated modules on the adic completion and on the complementary principal open,
identified over their common localization.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_adicCompletionGlueingEquivalence
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (f : R) :
    let I := Ideal.span {f}
    let Rhat := AdicCompletion I R
    let Rf := Localization.Away f
    let Sf := Localization.Away (algebraMap R Rhat f)
    let ρ := FormalGlueing.principalLocalizationMap R Rhat f
    letI : Algebra Rf Sf := ρ.toAlgebra
    let completion := finiteAdicCompletion R I
    let localPiece := finiteExtensionOfScalars R Rf
    let completionOverlap := finiteExtensionOfScalars Rhat Sf
    let localOverlap := finiteExtensionOfScalars Rf Sf
    ∃ comparison : completion ⋙ completionOverlap ≅ localPiece ⋙ localOverlap,
      (∀ (M : FGModuleCat.{u} R) (m : M) (s : Sf),
        comparison.hom.app M
            (s ⊗ₜ[Rhat] AdicCompletion.of I M m) =
          s ⊗ₜ[Rf] ((1 : Rf) ⊗ₜ[R] m)) ∧
      ((CategoricalPullback.CatCommSqOver.toFunctorToCategoricalPullback
        completionOverlap localOverlap (FGModuleCat.{u} R)).obj
        { fst := completion
          snd := localPiece
          iso := comparison }).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: FormalGlueing.formalGlueing_preserves_moduleProperties_tensor_and_algebras
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05EU.** Formal glueing detects the standard finiteness and flatness properties,
is pointwise symmetric monoidal, and hence induces an equivalence on commutative algebra objects.
The final two clauses state property detection, pointwise symmetry, and the canonical commutative
algebra equivalence for the principal-localization and adic-completion functors of Tags 05ES
and 05ET.
declarations.statement:
public theorem formalGlueing_preserves_moduleProperties_tensor_and_algebras :
    (∀ (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
      (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → R), Module.Flat R S →
      Function.Bijective
        (Ideal.quotientMap
          ((Ideal.span (Set.range f)).map (algebraMap R S))
          (algebraMap R S) Ideal.le_comap_map) →
      let c := moduleGlueingConstruction.{u, v, w} S f
      letI := c.category
      let G := ModuleGlueingDatum.{u, v, w} S f c.comparison
      ∃ (sourceTensor : LargeModuleMonoidalStructure.{u, max u v w} R)
          (genericTensor : LargeModuleMonoidalStructure.{v, max u v w} S)
          (localTensor : ∀ i, LargeModuleMonoidalStructure.{u, max u v w}
            (Localization.Away (f i)))
          (glueingTensor : MonoidalCategory G)
          (e : ModuleCat.{max u v w} R ≌ G),
        letI := sourceTensor.monoidal
        letI := genericTensor.monoidal
        letI (i : Fin r) := (localTensor i).monoidal
        letI := sourceTensor.symmetric
        letI := genericTensor.symmetric
        letI (i : Fin r) := (localTensor i).symmetric
        letI := glueingTensor
        ∃ (_ : SymmetricCategory G)
            (_ : (genericProjection S f c).Braided)
            (_ : ∀ i, (localProjection S f c i).Braided)
            (_ : c.canonical.Braided) (_ : c.sections.Braided)
            (_ : e.functor.Braided) (_ : e.inverse.Braided) (_ : e.IsMonoidal),
          e.functor = c.canonical ∧ e.inverse = c.sections ∧
          (∀ M : ModuleCat.{max u v w} R,
            (Module.Finite R M ↔
              Module.Finite S (e.functor.obj M).generic ∧
                ∀ i, Module.Finite (Localization.Away (f i))
                  ((e.functor.obj M).localPiece i)) ∧
            (Module.FinitePresentation R M ↔
              Module.FinitePresentation S (e.functor.obj M).generic ∧
                ∀ i, Module.FinitePresentation (Localization.Away (f i))
                  ((e.functor.obj M).localPiece i)) ∧
            (Module.Flat R M ↔
              Module.Flat S (e.functor.obj M).generic ∧
                ∀ i, Module.Flat (Localization.Away (f i))
                  ((e.functor.obj M).localPiece i)) ∧
            (Module.Projective R M ↔
              Module.Projective S (e.functor.obj M).generic ∧
                ∀ i, Module.Projective (Localization.Away (f i))
                  ((e.functor.obj M).localPiece i))) ∧
          ∃ algebraEquivalence : CommMon (ModuleCat.{max u v w} R) ≌ CommMon G,
            algebraEquivalence = e.mapCommMon) ∧
    (∀ (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
      (f : R), Module.Flat R S →
      Function.Bijective
        (Ideal.quotientMap ((Ideal.span {f}).map (algebraMap R S))
          (algebraMap R S) Ideal.le_comap_map) →
      let Rf := Localization.Away f
      let Sf := Localization.Away (algebraMap R S f)
      let ρ := FormalGlueing.principalLocalizationMap R S f
      letI : Algebra Rf Sf := ρ.toAlgebra
      let generic := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, v, max u v w} (algebraMap R S)
      let localPiece := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, max u v w} (algebraMap R Rf)
      let genericOverlap := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{v, v, max u v w} (algebraMap S Sf)
      let localOverlap := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, v, max u v w} (algebraMap Rf Sf)
      ∃ comparison : generic ⋙ genericOverlap ≅ localPiece ⋙ localOverlap,
        (∀ (M : ModuleCat.{max u v w} R) (m : M),
          comparison.hom.app M
              ((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj.{max u v w, v, v}
                (algebraMap S Sf)).unit.app
                (generic.obj M)
                ((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj.{max u v w, u, v}
                  (algebraMap R S)).unit.app M m)) =
            (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj.{max u v w, u, v}
              (algebraMap Rf Sf)).unit.app
              (localPiece.obj M)
              ((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj.{max u v w, u, u}
                (algebraMap R Rf)).unit.app M m)) ∧
        let F := (CategoricalPullback.CatCommSqOver.toFunctorToCategoricalPullback
          genericOverlap localOverlap (ModuleCat.{max u v w} R)).obj
          { fst := generic, snd := localPiece, iso := comparison }
        ∃ (sourceTensor : LargeModuleMonoidalStructure.{u, max u v w} R)
            (genericTensor : LargeModuleMonoidalStructure.{v, max u v w} S)
            (localTensor : LargeModuleMonoidalStructure.{u, max u v w} Rf)
            (overlapTensor : LargeModuleMonoidalStructure.{v, max u v w} Sf)
            (glueingTensor : MonoidalCategory
              (CategoricalPullback genericOverlap localOverlap))
            (e : ModuleCat.{max u v w} R ≌
              CategoricalPullback genericOverlap localOverlap),
          letI := sourceTensor.monoidal
          letI := genericTensor.monoidal
          letI := localTensor.monoidal
          letI := overlapTensor.monoidal
          letI := sourceTensor.symmetric
          letI := genericTensor.symmetric
          letI := localTensor.symmetric
          letI := overlapTensor.symmetric
          letI := glueingTensor
          ∃ (_ : SymmetricCategory (CategoricalPullback genericOverlap localOverlap))
              (_ : generic.Braided) (_ : localPiece.Braided)
              (_ : genericOverlap.Braided) (_ : localOverlap.Braided)
              (_ : comparison.hom.IsMonoidal)
              (_ : (CategoricalPullback.π₁ genericOverlap localOverlap).Braided)
              (_ : (CategoricalPullback.π₂ genericOverlap localOverlap).Braided)
              (_ : F.Braided) (_ : e.functor.Braided) (_ : e.inverse.Braided)
              (_ : e.IsMonoidal),
            e.functor = F ∧
            (∀ M : ModuleCat.{max u v w} R,
              (Module.Finite R M ↔ Module.Finite S (F.obj M).fst ∧
                Module.Finite Rf (F.obj M).snd) ∧
              (Module.FinitePresentation R M ↔
                Module.FinitePresentation S (F.obj M).fst ∧
                  Module.FinitePresentation Rf (F.obj M).snd) ∧
              (Module.Flat R M ↔ Module.Flat S (F.obj M).fst ∧
                Module.Flat Rf (F.obj M).snd) ∧
              (Module.Projective R M ↔ Module.Projective S (F.obj M).fst ∧
                Module.Projective Rf (F.obj M).snd)) ∧
            ∃ algebraEquivalence : CommMon (ModuleCat.{max u v w} R) ≌
                CommMon (CategoricalPullback genericOverlap localOverlap),
              algebraEquivalence = e.mapCommMon) ∧
    (∀ (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (f : R),
      let I := Ideal.span {f}
      let Rhat := AdicCompletion I R
      let Rf := Localization.Away f
      let Sf := Localization.Away (algebraMap R Rhat f)
      let ρ := FormalGlueing.principalLocalizationMap R Rhat f
      letI : Algebra Rf Sf := ρ.toAlgebra
      let completion := FormalGlueing.finiteAdicCompletion R I
      let localPiece := FormalGlueing.finiteExtensionOfScalars R Rf
      let completionOverlap := FormalGlueing.finiteExtensionOfScalars Rhat Sf
      let localOverlap := FormalGlueing.finiteExtensionOfScalars Rf Sf
      ∃ comparison : completion ⋙ completionOverlap ≅ localPiece ⋙ localOverlap,
        (∀ (M : FGModuleCat.{u} R) (m : M) (s : Sf),
          comparison.hom.app M (s ⊗ₜ[Rhat] AdicCompletion.of I M m) =
            s ⊗ₜ[Rf] ((1 : Rf) ⊗ₜ[R] m)) ∧
        let F := (CategoricalPullback.CatCommSqOver.toFunctorToCategoricalPullback
          completionOverlap localOverlap (FGModuleCat.{u} R)).obj
          { fst := completion, snd := localPiece, iso := comparison }
        ∃ (glueingTensor : MonoidalCategory
              (CategoricalPullback completionOverlap localOverlap))
            (e : FGModuleCat.{u} R ≌
              CategoricalPullback completionOverlap localOverlap),
          letI := glueingTensor
          ∃ (_ : SymmetricCategory (CategoricalPullback completionOverlap localOverlap))
              (_ : completion.Braided) (_ : localPiece.Braided)
              (_ : completionOverlap.Braided) (_ : localOverlap.Braided)
              (_ : comparison.hom.IsMonoidal)
              (_ : (CategoricalPullback.π₁ completionOverlap localOverlap).Braided)
              (_ : (CategoricalPullback.π₂ completionOverlap localOverlap).Braided)
              (_ : F.Braided) (_ : e.functor.Braided) (_ : e.inverse.Braided)
              (_ : e.IsMonoidal),
            e.functor = F ∧
            (∀ M : FGModuleCat.{u} R,
              (Module.Finite R M ↔ Module.Finite Rhat (F.obj M).fst ∧
                Module.Finite Rf (F.obj M).snd) ∧
              (Module.FinitePresentation R M ↔
                Module.FinitePresentation Rhat (F.obj M).fst ∧
                  Module.FinitePresentation Rf (F.obj M).snd) ∧
              (Module.Flat R M ↔ Module.Flat Rhat (F.obj M).fst ∧
                Module.Flat Rf (F.obj M).snd) ∧
              (Module.Projective R M ↔ Module.Projective Rhat (F.obj M).fst ∧
                Module.Projective Rf (F.obj M).snd)) ∧
            ∃ algebraEquivalence : CommMon (FGModuleCat.{u} R) ≌
                CommMon (CategoricalPullback completionOverlap localOverlap),
              algebraEquivalence = e.mapCommMon)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.weaklyAssociatedPoints_pushforward_subset_image
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05EX.** Every weakly associated point of the pushforward along an
affine morphism is the image of a weakly associated point of the original module.
declarations.statement:
theorem weaklyAssociatedPoints_pushforward_subset_image
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsAffineHom f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    Stacks.Divisors.weaklyAssociatedPoints ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) ⊆
      f '' Stacks.Divisors.weaklyAssociatedPoints F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.image_associatedPoints_eq_associatedPoints_pushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05EY.** The associated points of a quasi-coherent pushforward along
an affine morphism are the images of the associated points on the locally Noetherian
source.
declarations.statement:
theorem image_associatedPoints_eq_associatedPoints_pushforward
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsAffineHom f] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    f '' Stacks.Divisors.associatedPoints F =
      Stacks.Divisors.associatedPoints ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)
declarations.comment: associated points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.associatedPoints_pushforward_eq_weaklyAssociatedPoints_pushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05EY.** The associated and weakly associated points of the pushforward
along an affine morphism agree when the source is locally Noetherian.
declarations.statement:
theorem associatedPoints_pushforward_eq_weaklyAssociatedPoints_pushforward
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsAffineHom f] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    Stacks.Divisors.associatedPoints ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) =
      Stacks.Divisors.weaklyAssociatedPoints ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)
declarations.comment: associated and weakly associated points of the pushforward

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.weaklyAssociatedPoints_pushforward_eq_image_of_isAffineHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05EY.** The weakly associated points of a quasi-coherent pushforward
along an affine morphism are the images of the weakly associated points on the locally
Noetherian source.
declarations.statement:
theorem weaklyAssociatedPoints_pushforward_eq_image_of_isAffineHom
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsAffineHom f] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    Stacks.Divisors.weaklyAssociatedPoints ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) =
      f '' Stacks.Divisors.weaklyAssociatedPoints F
declarations.comment: weakly associated points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.weaklyAssociatedPoints_pushforward_eq_image_of_isFinite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05EZ.** For a finite morphism, the weakly associated points of the
pushforward of a quasi-coherent module are the images of its weakly associated points.
declarations.statement:
theorem weaklyAssociatedPoints_pushforward_eq_image_of_isFinite
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsFinite f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    Stacks.Divisors.weaklyAssociatedPoints ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) =
      f '' Stacks.Divisors.weaklyAssociatedPoints F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_pullback_of_isGenericPoint_fiber
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05F0.** A point which is generic in its fibre and at which a
morphism is flat is weakly associated to the pullback of a module whenever
its image is weakly associated to the original module.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_pullback_of_isGenericPoint_fiber
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (G : S.Modules) (x : X)
    (hflat : IsFlatAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom x)
    (hgeneric : f.asFiber x ∈ genericPoints (f.fiber (f x)))
    (hweak : Stacks.Divisors.IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint G (f x)) :
    Stacks.Divisors.IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G) x

declarations.name: Stacks.Divisors.IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint.pullback_of_isGenericPoint_fiber
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05F0.** A point which is generic in its fibre and at which a
morphism is flat is weakly associated to the pullback of a module whenever its image is weakly
associated to the original module.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint.pullback_of_isGenericPoint_fiber
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (G : S.Modules) (x : X)
    (hflat : IsFlatAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom x)
    (hgeneric : f.asFiber x ∈ genericPoints (f.fiber (f x)))
    (hweak : IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint G (f x)) :
    IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G) x

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeAssassin.exists_open_closure_genericPoints_fibre_mem_relativeAssassin
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05F1.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally of finite type, let `F` be a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module of finite type and let `ξ` be a point of `Ass_{X/S}(F)`. There is a
nonempty open `V` of the closure of `ξ` such that for every `s` in the image of `V` the generic
points of the fibre `V_s` lie in `Ass_{X/S}(F)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_open_closure_genericPoints_fibre_mem_relativeAssassin
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFiniteType]
    (ξ : X) (hξ : ξ ∈ Stacks.Divisors.relativeAssassin f F) :
    ∃ V : Set (closure ({ξ} : Set X)), IsOpen V ∧ V.Nonempty ∧
      ∀ s ∈ f '' (Subtype.val '' V),
        ∀ η : genericPoints ((f.fiberι s) ⁻¹' (Subtype.val '' V) : Set (f.fiber s)),
          f.fiberι s η.1.1 ∈ Stacks.Divisors.relativeAssassin f F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.relativeWeaklyAssociatedPoints_eq_relativeAssassin
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05F2.** For a morphism locally of finite type the relative weak
assassin of a module is its relative assassin.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeWeaklyAssociatedPoints_eq_relativeAssassin {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (F : X.Modules) :
    relativeWeaklyAssociatedPoints f F = Stacks.Divisors.relativeAssassin f F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.eventually_isEmpty_pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05F3.** If the base change of a quasi-compact scheme to the limit of a
directed inverse system is empty, then its base change to every sufficiently late stage is
empty.
declarations.statement:
lemma eventually_isEmpty_pullback
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (D : DescentSituation.{u, u} I)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace T]
    (t : T ⟶ D.system.obj (Opposite.op D.base))
    (hT : IsEmpty
      (pullback t (D.limitCone.π.app (Opposite.op D.base)) : Scheme)) :
    ∀ᶠ i in Filter.atTop, ∀ h : D.base ≤ i,
      IsEmpty (pullback t (D.system.map (homOfLE h).op) : Scheme)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.eventually_range_transition_subset_of_isLocallyConstructible
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05F4.** A locally constructible subset of a stage in a directed inverse
system contains the images of all sufficiently large stages if it contains the image of the
limit.
declarations.statement:
lemma eventually_range_transition_subset_of_isLocallyConstructible
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (D : DescentSituation.{u, u} I)
    (E : Set (D.system.obj (op D.base)))
    (hE : Topology.IsLocallyConstructible E)
    (hlim : Set.range (D.limitCone.π.app (op D.base)).base ⊆ E) :
    ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ∃ h : D.base ≤ i,
      Set.range (D.system.map (homOfLE h).op).base ⊆ E

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_nonempty_open_surjective_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05F5.** A finite type morphism to an irreducible scheme
with nonempty generic fibre is surjective over some nonempty open subscheme of
the target.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_nonempty_open_surjective_baseChange
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IrreducibleSpace Y]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (η : Y) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ) (h : Nonempty (f.fiber η)) :
    ∃ V : Y.Opens, (V : Set Y).Nonempty ∧ Surjective (pullback.snd f V.ι)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_nonempty_open_fiberDimension_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05F7.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of finite type with `Y`
irreducible with generic point `η`. If the generic fibre has dimension `n`, then the fibres over
some nonempty open subset of `Y` all have dimension `n`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_nonempty_open_fiberDimension_eq {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IrreducibleSpace Y] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] (n : ℕ) (η : Y)
    (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ) (hdim : f.fiberDimension η = (n : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ V : Y.Opens, (V : Set Y).Nonempty ∧ ∀ y ∈ V, f.fiberDimension y = (n : WithBot ℕ∞)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.fiberDimension
declarations.doc:
The dimension-of-fibres function of a morphism of schemes assigns to a point of the target
the dimension of the scheme-theoretic fibre over it. Points outside the image of the morphism
have empty fibre, hence dimension `⊥`.
declarations.statement: public noncomputable def fiberDimension (f : X ⟶ Y) : Y → WithBot ℕ∞
declarations.comment: the function `n_{X/Y}`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.fiberDimension_eq_of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05F8.** The dimension-of-fibres function of a morphism locally of
finite type is unchanged by base change: for a pullback square with `f` locally of finite type,
the dimension-of-fibres function of the base change is the composite of that of `f` with the
morphism of bases.
declarations.comment: the base-change formula `n_{X'/Y'} = n_{X/Y} ∘ g`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallyConstructible_fiberDimension_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05F9.** For a morphism of schemes of finite presentation, every level
set of the dimension-of-fibres function is locally constructible in the target.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finiteTypeAffineModel
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05FB.** An affine morphism of finite presentation between affine
schemes admits an affine finite-type model over a base of finite type over `ℤ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finiteTypeAffineModel {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) (hf : FinitePresentation f) :
    Nonempty (FiniteTypeAffineModel ⊤ f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finiteTypeAffineModel_isCoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05FC.** A quasi-coherent module of finite presentation on the source of
a morphism of affine schemes of finite presentation descends to a coherent module on an affine
finite-type model of that morphism over a base of finite type over `ℤ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finiteTypeAffineModel_isCoherent
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) (hf : FinitePresentation f)
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ (m : FiniteTypeAffineModel ⊤ f) (F₀ : m.X₀.Modules),
      F₀.IsCoherent ∧ Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback m.toSource).obj F₀ ≅ F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finiteTypeAffineModel_isCoherent_isFlatOver
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05FD.** A quasi-coherent module of finite presentation on the source of
a morphism of affine schemes of finite presentation which is moreover flat over the target
descends to a coherent module, flat over the base, on an affine finite-type model of that
morphism over a base of finite type over `ℤ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finiteTypeAffineModel_isCoherent_isFlatOver
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) (hf : FinitePresentation f)
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hF : IsFlatOver f.toLRSHom.toShHom F) :
    ∃ (m : FiniteTypeAffineModel ⊤ f) (F₀ : m.X₀.Modules),
      F₀.IsCoherent ∧ Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback m.toSource).obj F₀ ≅ F) ∧
        IsFlatOver m.f₀.toLRSHom.toShHom F₀

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_flat_finiteTypeAffineModel
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05FE.** A flat morphism of finite presentation between affine
schemes admits an affine finite-type model whose modeled morphism is flat.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_flat_finiteTypeAffineModel
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine S] (f : X ⟶ S)
    (hf : FinitePresentation f) [Flat f] :
    Nonempty (FiniteTypeAffineModel @Flat f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_smooth_finiteTypeAffineModel
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05FF.** A smooth morphism between affine schemes
admits an affine finite-type model whose modeled morphism is smooth.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_smooth_finiteTypeAffineModel
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine S] (f : X ⟶ S) [Smooth f] :
    Nonempty (FiniteTypeAffineModel @Smooth f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finiteTypeAffineModel_geometricallyReduced
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05FG.** A morphism of affine schemes of finite presentation with
geometrically reduced fibres admits an affine finite-type model over a base of finite type over
`ℤ` whose fibres are geometrically reduced as well.

The limit argument is `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finiteTypeAffineModel_fiberwise`, applied to the
locus of geometrically reduced fibres. Its compatibility with base change is Tag 0576,
`AlgebraicGeometry.geometricallyReduced_fiber_set_eq_preimage_of_isPullback`, and its local
constructibility over an affine Noetherian base is Tag 0579,
`AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallyConstructible_geometricallyReduced_fiber_of_isAffine`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finiteTypeAffineModel_geometricallyReduced

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_pullback_iff_of_finite_flat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05FN.** A point is weakly associated to the pullback of a
quasi-coherent module along a finite flat morphism if and only if its image is weakly
associated to the original module.

    {T S : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S) [IsFinite g] [Flat g]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.schemeWeaklyAssociatedPoints_eq_preimage_of_etale
declarations.doc:

the weakly associated points of a scheme etale over another, at the structure

declarations.name: Module.Flat.rTensor_injective_of_projective_of_mem_maximalIdeal_smul_top
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05FQ.** Let `(R, 𝔪)` be a local ring and let `u : M →ₗ[R] N` be a map of `R`-modules
with `M` projective and `N` flat. If the reduction `M/𝔪M → N/𝔪N` is injective -- that is, if
`u x ∈ 𝔪 • ⊤` forces `x ∈ 𝔪 • ⊤` -- then `u` is universally injective, i.e. `u ⊗ id_Q` is
injective for every `R`-module `Q`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem Module.Flat.rTensor_injective_of_projective_of_mem_maximalIdeal_smul_top
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [Small.{v} R] {M N : Type v} [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module R M] [Module.Projective R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module.Flat R N]
    (u : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hu : ∀ x : M, u x ∈ maximalIdeal R • (⊤ : Submodule R N) →
      x ∈ maximalIdeal R • (⊤ : Submodule R M)) :
    ∀ (Q : Type v) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q], Function.Injective (u.rTensor Q)
declarations.comment:
the hypothesis spells out injectivity of `M/𝔪M → N/𝔪N` as
`u x ∈ 𝔪 • ⊤ → x ∈ 𝔪 • ⊤`, the form `Submodule.injective_mapQ_smul_top_iff` shows it to be
equivalent to; the conclusion spells out universal injectivity, which `Mathlib` has no name for,
as in Stacks 0AS5, 05CJ and 05CM.

declarations.name: Module.Flat.rTensor_injective_of_projective_of_injective_mapQ_maximalIdeal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05FQ.** Let `(R, 𝔪)` be a local ring and let `u : M →ₗ[R] N` be a map of `R`-modules
with `M` projective and `N` flat. If the induced map `M/𝔪M → N/𝔪N` is injective, then `u` is
universally injective, i.e. `u ⊗ id_Q` is injective for every `R`-module `Q`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem Module.Flat.rTensor_injective_of_projective_of_injective_mapQ_maximalIdeal
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [Small.{v} R] {M N : Type v} [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module R M] [Module.Projective R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module.Flat R N]
    (u : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hu : Function.Injective ((maximalIdeal R • (⊤ : Submodule R M)).mapQ
      (maximalIdeal R • (⊤ : Submodule R N)) u
      (Submodule.smul_top_le_comap_smul_top (maximalIdeal R) u))) :
    ∀ (Q : Type v) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q], Function.Injective (u.rTensor Q)
declarations.comment:
`M/𝔪M` is `M ⧸ 𝔪 • ⊤` and the reduction of `u` is `Submodule.mapQ` along `u`, as in
Stacks 0AS5 and 046Y; the conclusion spells out universal injectivity, which `Mathlib` has no
name for.

declarations.name: Stacks.UniversalInjectivity.universallyInjective_lsmul_of_mem_nonZeroSMulDivisors_quotient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05FR.** An element which acts injectively on the closed fibre of a
projective module acts universally injectively on the module over the local base ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem universallyInjective_lsmul_of_mem_nonZeroSMulDivisors_quotient
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {N : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing R] [Algebra R S]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module R N] [IsScalarTower R S N]
    [IsNoetherianRing
      (S ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R))]
    [Module.Finite
      (S ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R))
      (N ⧸ (Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) •
        (⊤ : Submodule S N)))]
    [Module.Projective R N]
    {s : S}
    (hs : s ∈ nonZeroSMulDivisors S
      (N ⧸ (Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) •
        (⊤ : Submodule S N)))) :
    UniversallyInjective ((LinearMap.lsmul S N s).restrictScalars R)
declarations.comment: elementwise_universal_injectivity

declarations.name: Stacks.UniversalInjectivity.universallyInjective_localizedModule_mkLinearMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05FR.** If a module is projective over a local base ring, its
canonical map to the localization at the elements acting injectively on its closed fibre is
universally injective over the base.
declarations.statement:
theorem universallyInjective_localizedModule_mkLinearMap
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {N : Type (max v w)} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing R]
    [Algebra R S] [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module R N] [IsScalarTower R S N]
    [Module.Projective R N]
    [IsNoetherianRing
      (S ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R))]
    [Module.Finite
      (S ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R))
      (N ⧸ (Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) •
        (⊤ : Submodule S N)))] :
    UniversallyInjective
      ((LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap
        (nonZeroSMulDivisors S
          (N ⧸ (Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) •
            (⊤ : Submodule S N)))) N).restrictScalars R)
declarations.comment: localization_universal_injectivity

declarations.name: Module.Flat.projective_of_finiteType_of_geometricallyIntegral_fibres

**Stacks Project, Tag 05FS.** A flat finite type algebra over a Noetherian ring whose fibres
are geometrically integral is projective as a module over its base ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem Module.Flat.projective_of_finiteType_of_geometricallyIntegral_fibres
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra.FiniteType R S] [Module.Flat R S]
    (h : ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime],
      letI : Algebra p.ResidueField (S ⊗[R] p.ResidueField) :=
        Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra

declarations.name: Algebra.projective_of_geometricallyIntegral_fibres
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05FT.** Let `R → S` be flat and of finite presentation and suppose that
every fibre ring `S ⊗[R] κ(p)` is geometrically integral over `κ(p)`. Then `S` is a projective
`R`-module.

This is `Algebra.projective_of_geometricallyIntegral_fibres_of_isConstructible_reduced` with its
hypothesis — constructibility of the geometrically reduced fibre locus over a Noetherian base,
the affine case of Stacks 0579 — discharged by
`Algebra.isConstructible_geometricallyReducedFibreLocus'`. The irreducible half was
discharged by `Algebra.isConstructible_geometricallyIrreducibleFibreLocus_of_finiteType`, the
affine case of the level set `n = 1` of Stacks 055B.
declarations.statement:
public theorem projective_of_geometricallyIntegral_fibres {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra.FinitePresentation R S] [Module.Flat R S]
    (h : ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime],
      letI : Algebra p.ResidueField (S ⊗[R] p.ResidueField) :=
        Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
      Algebra.IsGeometricallyIntegral p.ResidueField (S ⊗[R] p.ResidueField)) :
    Module.Projective R S

declarations.name: Stacks.PureModules.associatedPrime_add_map_maximalIdeal_ne_top
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05FV.** Under the finite Noetherian closed-fibre hypotheses, an
associated prime of any fibre of a projective module meets the closed fibre of a local base.
declarations.statement:
lemma associatedPrime_add_map_maximalIdeal_ne_top
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [IsLocalRing R]
    (N : Type w) [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module R N] [IsScalarTower R S N]
    [Module.Projective R N]
    [IsNoetherianRing (S ⧸ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R S))]
    [Module.Finite (S ⧸ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R S))
      (N ⧸ ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R S) • (⊤ : Submodule S N)))]
    (q : PrimeSpectrum S)
    (hq : IsAssociatedPrimeStacks S
      (N ⊗[R] (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) q).asIdeal.ResidueField) q.asIdeal) :
    q.asIdeal + (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R S) ≠ ⊤

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_impurity_locallyOfFinitePresentation_closedPoint
declarations.doc:

locally of finite presentation over the base, with its specialized point closed in the fibre over
the distinguished point.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_impurity_locallyOfFinitePresentation_closedPoint (P : PrePureSituation.{u})

declarations.name: Stacks.Examples.RaynaudGruson.exists_flat_at_prime_not_flat_on_neighborhood
declarations.doc:
**The Raynaud--Gruson example.** There is a local ring `A`, a finite type ring map `A → B`
and a prime `q` of `B` over the maximal ideal of `A` such that `B_q` is flat over `A` while for
every `g ∈ B` outside `q` the ring `B_g` is neither of finite presentation nor flat over `A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_flat_at_prime_not_flat_on_neighborhood :
    ∃ (A B : Type) (_ : CommRing A) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : IsLocalRing A) (φ : A →+* B)
      (q : Ideal B) (_ : q.IsPrime),
      φ.FiniteType ∧ q.comap φ = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A ∧
        ((algebraMap B (Localization.AtPrime q)).comp φ).Flat ∧
        ∀ g : B, g ∉ q →
          ¬ ((algebraMap B (Localization.Away g)).comp φ).FinitePresentation ∧
          ¬ ((algebraMap B (Localization.Away g)).comp φ).Flat

declarations.name: Module.relativeAssassin_comparison_annihilator
declarations.doc:
Let `R → S` be a ring map and let `N` be an `S`-module. A prime `𝔮` of `S` is associated to an
`S`-module `P` when it is the annihilator of some element of `P`, that is
`(⊥ : Submodule S P).colon {m} = 𝔮` for some `m : P`. With `𝔭 = R ∩ 𝔮`, let `A` be the set of
primes `𝔮` associated to `N ⊗_R κ(𝔭)`, `A'` the set of contractions of the primes of the fibre
ring `S ⊗_R κ(𝔭)` associated to `(S ⊗_R κ(𝔭)) ⊗_S N ≅ N ⊗_R κ(𝔭)` over the fibre ring, `A_fin`
the set of primes associated to `N / 𝔭N`, `A'_fin` the set of primes associated to `N / 𝔭'N`
for some prime `𝔭'` of `R`, `B` the set of primes associated to `N ⊗_R M` for some `R`-module
`M`, and `B_fin` the same with `M` finite. Then (1) `A = A'`; (2) `A_fin ⊆ A`, `B_fin ⊆ B`,
`A_fin ⊆ A'_fin ⊆ B_fin` and `A ⊆ B`; (3) if `S` is Noetherian then `A = A_fin` and
`B = B_fin`; (4) if `N` is flat over `R` then `A = A_fin = A'_fin` and `B = B_fin`; (5) if `R`
is Noetherian and `N` is flat over `R` then all six sets are equal.
declarations.statement:
public theorem _root_.Module.relativeAssassin_comparison_annihilator (R : Type u) (S : Type v)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] (N : Type w) [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N]
    [Module R N] [IsScalarTower R S N] {A A' Afin A'fin B Bfin : Set (PrimeSpectrum S)}
    (hA : A = {q | ∃ m : N ⊗[R] (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) q).asIdeal.ResidueField,
      (⊥ : Submodule S
        (N ⊗[R] (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) q).asIdeal.ResidueField)).colon {m} =
        q.asIdeal})
    (hA' : A' = {q | ∃ Q : PrimeSpectrum
        (S ⊗[R] (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) q).asIdeal.ResidueField),
        (∃ m : (S ⊗[R] (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) q).asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗[S] N,
          (⊥ : Submodule (S ⊗[R] (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) q).asIdeal.ResidueField)
            ((S ⊗[R] (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) q).asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗[S]
              N)).colon {m} = Q.asIdeal) ∧
        PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap S
          (S ⊗[R] (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) q).asIdeal.ResidueField)) Q = q})
    (hAfin : Afin = {q | ∃ w : N ⧸ ((PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) q).asIdeal.map
        (algebraMap R S) • (⊤ : Submodule S N)),
      (⊥ : Submodule S (N ⧸ ((PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) q).asIdeal.map
        (algebraMap R S) • (⊤ : Submodule S N)))).colon {w} = q.asIdeal})
    (hA'fin : A'fin = {q | ∃ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
      ∃ w : N ⧸ (p.asIdeal.map (algebraMap R S) • (⊤ : Submodule S N)),
        (⊥ : Submodule S (N ⧸ (p.asIdeal.map (algebraMap R S) • (⊤ : Submodule S N)))).colon
          {w} = q.asIdeal})
    (hB : B = {q | ∃ (M : Type (max u v)) (_ : AddCommGroup M) (_ : Module R M),
      ∃ z : N ⊗[R] M, (⊥ : Submodule S (N ⊗[R] M)).colon {z} = q.asIdeal})
    (hBfin : Bfin = {q | ∃ (M : Type (max u v)) (_ : AddCommGroup M) (_ : Module R M)
      (_ : Module.Finite R M),
      ∃ z : N ⊗[R] M, (⊥ : Submodule S (N ⊗[R] M)).colon {z} = q.asIdeal}) :
    A = A' ∧
    (Afin ⊆ A ∧ Bfin ⊆ B ∧ Afin ⊆ A'fin ∧ A'fin ⊆ Bfin ∧ A ⊆ B) ∧
    (IsNoetherianRing S → A = Afin ∧ B = Bfin) ∧
    (Module.Flat R N → A = Afin ∧ Afin = A'fin ∧ B = Bfin) ∧
    (IsNoetherianRing R → Module.Flat R N →
      A = A' ∧ A' = Afin ∧ Afin = A'fin ∧ A'fin = Bfin ∧ Bfin = B)

declarations.name: Module.relativeAssassin
declarations.doc:
The **relative assassin** `Ass_{S/R}(N)` of an `S`-module `N` over a ring map `R → S`: the
set of primes `𝔮` of `S` which, with `𝔭 = R ∩ 𝔮` the contraction of `𝔮` to `R`, are associated
primes over `S` of the fibre module `N ⊗_R κ(𝔭)`, that is, are the annihilator of some element
of it. This is the set `A` of `Module.relativeAssassin_comparison_annihilator`.
declarations.statement: public def relativeAssassin : Set (PrimeSpectrum S)

declarations.name: LinearMap.surjectivityLocus_eq_and_isOpen_and_surjective_away
declarations.doc:
Let `R` be a ring and let `φ : M →ₗ[R] N` be a map of `R`-modules with `N` a finite
`R`-module. Let `U` be the set of primes `p` such that `φ_p : M_p → N_p` is surjective. Then `U`
is the set of primes `p` such that `φ ⊗ κ(p) : M ⊗_R κ(p) → N ⊗_R κ(p)` is surjective, `U` is open
in `Spec R`, and for every `f : R` with `D(f) ⊆ U` the map `M_f → N_f` is surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem surjectivityLocus_eq_and_isOpen_and_surjective_away (φ : M →ₗ[R] N)
    [Module.Finite R N] :
    {p : PrimeSpectrum R | Function.Surjective (LocalizedModule.map p.asIdeal.primeCompl φ)} =
        {p | Function.Surjective (φ.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField)} ∧
      IsOpen {p : PrimeSpectrum R |
        Function.Surjective (LocalizedModule.map p.asIdeal.primeCompl φ)} ∧
      ∀ f : R, (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) ⊆
          {p | Function.Surjective (LocalizedModule.map p.asIdeal.primeCompl φ)} →
        Function.Surjective (LocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers f) φ)

declarations.name: LinearMap.isOpen_setOf_localizedMap_atPrime_bijective
declarations.doc:
Let `R` be a ring and let `φ : M →ₗ[R] N` be a map of `R`-modules with `M` a finite
`R`-module and `N` a finitely presented `R`-module. Then the set of primes `p` of `R` such that
the localized map `φ_p : M_p → N_p` is an isomorphism is an open subset of `Spec(R)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem LinearMap.isOpen_setOf_localizedMap_atPrime_bijective
    {R M N : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N) [Module.Finite R M] [Module.FinitePresentation R N] :
    IsOpen {p : PrimeSpectrum R |
      Function.Bijective (LocalizedModule.map p.asIdeal.primeCompl φ)}

declarations.name: completion_noetherian
declarations.doc:
Let `I` be an ideal of a commutative ring `R` with `R / I` Noetherian and `I` finitely
generated.  Then the `I`-adic completion `R^∧ = AdicCompletion I R` is a Noetherian ring, and
it is complete with respect to `I R^∧ = I.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion I R))`.
declarations.statement:
theorem completion_noetherian
    (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    (h1 : IsNoetherianRing (R ⧸ I)) (h2 : I.FG) :
    IsNoetherianRing (AdicCompletion I R) ∧
    IsAdicComplete (I.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion I R))) (AdicCompletion I R)

declarations.name: AdicCompletion.isUnit_of_isUnit_evalOneₐ_and_isUnit_one_add_and_le_jacobson_bot
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05GI.** Let `R` be a ring, let `I ⊆ R` be an ideal, and let `R^∧ = lim R/Iⁿ`.
Then (1) any element of `R^∧` which maps to a unit of `R/I` is a unit, (2) any element of `1 + I`
maps to an invertible element of `R^∧`, (3) any element of `1 + IR^∧` is invertible in `R^∧`, and
(4) the ideals `IR^∧` and `Ker(R^∧ → R/I)` are contained in the Jacobson radical of `R^∧`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isUnit_of_isUnit_evalOneₐ_and_isUnit_one_add_and_le_jacobson_bot
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) :
    (∀ x : AdicCompletion I R, IsUnit (evalOneₐ I x) → IsUnit x) ∧
      (∀ a ∈ I, IsUnit (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion I R) (1 + a))) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ I.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion I R)), IsUnit (1 + x)) ∧
      I.map (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion I R)) ≤ (⊥ : Ideal (AdicCompletion I R)).jacobson ∧
      RingHom.ker (evalOneₐ I).toRingHom ≤ (⊥ : Ideal (AdicCompletion I R)).jacobson
declarations.comment: All four parts, for an arbitrary ideal of an arbitrary commutative ring.

declarations.name: Module.exists_finite_isLocalizedModule_comp_atPrime
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05GJ.** Let `R` be a ring, `p ⊆ R` a prime ideal, `M` an `R`-module and
`f : M → Mₚ` a localization of `M` at `p.primeCompl`, over a localization `Rₚ` of `R` at `p`.

1. If `Mₚ` is a finite `Rₚ`-module, then there is a finite `R`-module `M'` and an `R`-linear map
   `φ : M' → M` inducing an isomorphism `M'ₚ ≅ Mₚ`, spelled
   `IsLocalizedModule p.primeCompl (f ∘ₗ φ)`.
2. If `Mₚ` is moreover a finitely presented `Rₚ`-module, then `M'` is of finite presentation
   over `R`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finite_isLocalizedModule_comp_atPrime {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime]
    (Rₚ : Type v) [CommRing Rₚ] [Algebra R Rₚ] [IsLocalization.AtPrime Rₚ p]
    {M : Type w} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {Mₚ : Type t} [AddCommGroup Mₚ] [Module R Mₚ] [Module Rₚ Mₚ] [IsScalarTower R Rₚ Mₚ]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] Mₚ) [IsLocalizedModule p.primeCompl f] [Module.Finite Rₚ Mₚ] :
    ∃ (M' : Type u) (_ : AddCommGroup M') (_ : Module R M') (φ : M' →ₗ[R] M),
      Module.Finite R M' ∧ IsLocalizedModule p.primeCompl (f ∘ₗ φ) ∧
        (Module.FinitePresentation Rₚ Mₚ → Module.FinitePresentation R M')
declarations.comment:
The case `S = p.primeCompl` of 05N6
(`Module.exists_finite_isLocalizedModule_comp`), stated in the same shape: localizations are
abstract, the induced isomorphism `M'ₚ → Mₚ` is pinned as
`IsLocalizedModule p.primeCompl (f ∘ₗ φ)`, `M'` is produced in the universe of `R`, and items (1)
and (2) are the two conjuncts, (2) as an implication about the same `M'`.

declarations.name: IsAutoAssociated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05GM.** A commutative ring is *auto-associated* if it is local and its maximal
ideal is weakly associated to the ring as a module over itself.
declarations.statement: def IsAutoAssociated (R : Type u) [CommRing R] : Prop

declarations.name: annihilator_ne_bot_of_isAutoAssociated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05GN.** Every proper finitely generated ideal in an auto-associated ring has a
nonzero annihilator.
declarations.statement:
theorem annihilator_ne_bot_of_isAutoAssociated {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (hR : IsAutoAssociated R) (I : Ideal R) (hI : I.FG) (hI_ne : I ≠ ⊤) :
    I.annihilator ≠ ⊥

declarations.name: universallyInjective_iff_injective_of_projective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05GP.** Over a ring in which every proper finitely generated ideal has a nonzero
annihilator, a homomorphism between projective modules is universally injective if and only if it
is injective.
declarations.statement:
theorem universallyInjective_iff_injective_of_projective
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (hR : ∀ I : Ideal R, I.FG → I ≠ ⊤ → I.annihilator ≠ ⊥)
    {N M : Type v} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module.Projective R N]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Projective R M] (f : N →ₗ[R] M) :
    UniversallyInjective f ↔ Function.Injective f

declarations.name: annihilator_projective_splitting_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05GQ.** For a commutative ring `R`, the following are equivalent: every proper
finitely generated ideal has a nonzero annihilator; every injection between projective modules is
universally injective; the cokernel of every injection between finite projective modules is finite
projective; every finite projective submodule of a finite projective module is a direct summand;
and every injection from `R` to a finite-rank free module splits. The quantified module universe
contains the ring universe, so the finite free modules in the last condition can be lifted into
the preceding conditions.
declarations.statement:
theorem annihilator_projective_splitting_tfae {R : Type u} [CommRing R] :
    [ (∀ I : Ideal R, I.FG → I ≠ ⊤ → I.annihilator ≠ ⊥),
      (∀ (N M : Type (max u v)) [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module.Projective R N]
        [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Projective R M] (f : N →ₗ[R] M),
        Function.Injective f → UniversallyInjective f),
      (∀ (N M : Type (max u v)) [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module.Finite R N]
        [Module.Projective R N] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]
        [Module.Projective R M] (f : N →ₗ[R] M), Function.Injective f →
        Module.Finite R (M ⧸ LinearMap.range f) ∧ Module.Projective R (M ⧸ LinearMap.range f)),
      (∀ (M : Type (max u v)) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]
        [Module.Projective R M] (N : Submodule R M) [Module.Finite R N]
        [Module.Projective R N], ∃ p : M →ₗ[R] N, p.comp N.subtype = LinearMap.id),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : R →ₗ[R] (Fin n → R)), Function.Injective f →
        ∃ p : (Fin n → R) →ₗ[R] R, p.comp f = LinearMap.id) ].TFAE

declarations.name: exists_universallyInjective_nonSplit_freeModule_endomorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05GR.** Let `R = k[x₁, x₂, …]/(xᵢ²)`. The endomorphism of the countable free
`R`-module given on basis vectors by `eᵢ ↦ eᵢ - xᵢ eᵢ₊₁` is injective and universally
injective, but is neither surjective nor split. After specializing every variable to zero it
becomes an isomorphism. Its cokernel is countably generated and flat, but is not projective and
not Mittag--Leffler. The ring `R` is auto-associated and satisfies the annihilator condition of
Stacks 05GQ.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_universallyInjective_nonSplit_freeModule_endomorphism
    (k : Type u) [Field k] :
    let P := MvPolynomial ℕ k
    let I : Ideal P := Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i : ℕ ↦ MvPolynomial.X i ^ 2))
    let R := P ⧸ I
    let x : ℕ → R := fun i ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk I (MvPolynomial.X i)
    ∃ ν : (ℕ →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (ℕ →₀ R),
      (∀ i, ν (Finsupp.single i 1) =
        Finsupp.single i 1 - x i • Finsupp.single (i + 1) 1) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, LinearIndependent R (fun i : Fin n ↦ ν (Finsupp.single i 1))) ∧
      IsAutoAssociated R ∧
      (∀ J : Ideal R, J.FG → J ≠ ⊤ → J.annihilator ≠ ⊥) ∧
      Function.Injective ν ∧
      UniversallyInjective ν ∧
      (∃ ε : R →ₐ[k] k, (∀ i, ε (x i) = 0) ∧
        letI := ε.toRingHom.toAlgebra
        Function.Bijective (ν.rTensor k)) ∧
      ¬ Function.Surjective ν ∧
      ¬ (∃ p : (ℕ →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (ℕ →₀ R), p.comp ν = LinearMap.id) ∧
      Module.Flat R ((ℕ →₀ R) ⧸ LinearMap.range ν) ∧
      Module.CountablyGenerated R ((ℕ →₀ R) ⧸ LinearMap.range ν) ∧
      ¬ Module.Projective R ((ℕ →₀ R) ⧸ LinearMap.range ν) ∧
      ¬ IsMittagLeffler.{u, u, u, u, u} R ((ℕ →₀ R) ⧸ LinearMap.range ν)

declarations.name: hasFiniteDetectingPrimes_of_standard_conditions
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 05GS.** Let `R` be a commutative ring.  If `R` is local, Noetherian, a domain,
reduced with finitely many minimal primes, or has finitely many weakly associated primes, then
finitely many prime localizations jointly detect elements of `R`, so that Tags 053A, 053B and
053D apply to `R`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasFiniteDetectingPrimes_of_standard_conditions
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (h : IsLocalRing R ∨ IsNoetherianRing R ∨ IsDomain R ∨
      (IsReduced R ∧ (minimalPrimes R).Finite) ∨
      {p : Ideal R | ∃ x : R, p ∈ (R ∙ x).annihilator.minimalPrimes}.Finite) :
    HasFiniteDetectingPrimes R

declarations.name: Stacks.ClosedPointsFibre.exists_quotient_isLocalization_quasiFinite_of_isOpen
declarations.doc:
An open of the spectrum of an essentially finite type local algebra which meets the
complement of the closed fibre contains a prime whose quotient is a localization of a
quasi-finite algebra.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_quotient_isLocalization_quasiFinite_of_isOpen
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing A] [IsLocalRing B]
    [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (f : A →+* B) (hf : IsLocalHom f)
    (heft : IsEssentiallyOfFiniteType A B f)
    (hres : letI : IsLocalHom f := hf;
      letI := (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map f).toAlgebra;
      Module.Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B))
    (V : Set (PrimeSpectrum B)) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hne : ∃ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
      q ∈ V ∧ q.asIdeal.comap f ≠ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :
    ∃ q : PrimeSpectrum B, q ∈ V ∧
      q.asIdeal.comap f ≠ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A ∧
      letI := f.toAlgebra;
      ∃ (C : Type u) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : Algebra A C)
        (_ : Algebra.FiniteType A C) (_ : Algebra.QuasiFinite A C)
        (M : Submonoid C) (_ : Algebra C (B ⧸ q.asIdeal)),
        IsScalarTower A C (B ⧸ q.asIdeal) ∧ IsLocalization M (B ⧸ q.asIdeal)

declarations.name: Stacks.ClosedPointsFibre.exists_closedSubscheme_quasiFiniteAt_meeting_open
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally of finite type with `S` locally Noetherian, and let `x` be closed
in its fibre. If some point of the open `U` specializes to `x` and lies over a point other than
`f x`, then there are a closed immersion `i : Z ⟶ X` and a point `xZ` of `Z` over `x` at which
`i ≫ f` is quasi-finite, together with a generalization `zZ` of `xZ` mapping into `U` and lying
over a point other than `f x`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_closedSubscheme_quasiFiniteAt_meeting_open
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (x : X) (U : X.Opens)
    (hx : IsClosed ({f.asFiber x} : Set (f.fiber (f x))))
    (hU : ∃ x' : X, x' ∈ U.1 ∧ x' ⤳ x ∧ f x' ≠ f x) :
    ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (i : Z ⟶ X), IsClosedImmersion i ∧
      ∃ xZ : Z, i xZ = x ∧ quasiFiniteAt (i ≫ f) xZ ∧
        ∃ zZ : Z, i zZ ∈ U.1 ∧ zZ ⤳ xZ ∧ f (i zZ) ≠ f x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.closure_closedPoints_between_fiber_eq_of_isLocallyNoetherian
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 053U for a locally Noetherian base.** For `f : X ⟶ S` locally of finite type with
`S` locally Noetherian, `x ⤳ x'` with `x'` closed in its fibre and `f x ≠ f x'` (or `x = x'`),
the points of `X_{f x}` closed in `X_{f x}` and lying between `x` and `x'` are dense in the
closure of `x` in `X_{f x}`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem closure_closedPoints_between_fiber_eq_of_isLocallyNoetherian {X S : Scheme.{u}}
