declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ElementaryEtaleFlatness.exists_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood_open_flat_along_fibre
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05KV.** Flatness of a finite type quasi-coherent module along
a fibre spreads to an open neighbourhood of that fibre after passing to the local scheme
of an elementary étale neighbourhood of the base point.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood_open_flat_along_fibre
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFiniteType] (s : S)
    (hF : ∀ x : X, f x = s → AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOverAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom F x) :
    ∃ (U : AlgebraicGeometry.EtaleNeighborhood S s) (_ : U.IsElementary),
      let g := U.scheme.fromSpecStalk U.point ≫ U.toBase
      let P : Scheme.{u} := pullback f g
      ∃ (V : P.Opens),
        (∀ z : P, pullback.snd f g z = IsLocalRing.closedPoint _ → z ∈ V) ∧
          AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOver
            (((V.ι : V.toScheme ⟶ P) ≫ pullback.snd f g).toLRSHom.toShHom)
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
              ((V.ι : V.toScheme ⟶ P) ≫ pullback.fst f g)).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood_projective_sections_image_contains_fibre
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05KW.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be of finite presentation, let `F` be a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module of finite presentation and let `s ∈ S` be such that `F` is flat over
`S` at every point of the fibre `X_s`. Then there is an elementary étale neighbourhood
`(S', s') ⟶ (S, s)` and a commutative square
```
  X ←g— X'
  ↓      ↓ h
  S ←—— S'
```
such that `g` is étale, the image of the induced morphism `X' ⟶ X ×_S S'` contains the fibre
`(X ×_S S')_{s'}`, the schemes `X'` and `S'` are affine, and `Γ(X', g^*F)` is a projective
`Γ(S', 𝒪_{S'})`-module.

The fibre `(X ×_S S')_{s'}` is the set of points of `X ×_S S'` whose second projection is `s'`.
The statement also records the equivalent pointwise form: every point of `X_s` is `g` of a point
of `X'` lying over `s'`. The `Γ(S', 𝒪_{S'})`-module structure on `Γ(X', g^*F)` is restriction of
scalars along the map on global sections induced by `h`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood_projective_sections_image_contains_fibre
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (F : X.Modules) (s : S)
    (hf : FinitePresentation f)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hflat : ∀ x : f.fiber s,
      IsFlatOverAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom F (f.fiberι s x)) :
    ∃ (U : EtaleNeighborhood S s) (X' : Scheme.{u})
      (h : X' ⟶ U.scheme) (g : X' ⟶ X) (hc : g ≫ f = h ≫ U.toBase),
      U.IsElementary ∧ IsAffine U.scheme ∧ IsAffine X' ∧ Etale g ∧
      pullback.snd f U.toBase ⁻¹' {U.point} ⊆ Set.range (pullback.lift g h hc) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ f ⁻¹' {s}, ∃ y : X', g y = x ∧ h y = U.point) ∧
      (let N := Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F, ⊤)
       letI : Module Γ(U.scheme, ⊤) N := Module.compHom N h.appTop.hom
       Module.Projective Γ(U.scheme, ⊤) N)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood_projective_structureSheafSections_along_fibre
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05KX.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be of finite presentation and let `s : S` be a
point at which `X` is flat over `S` at every point of the fibre `X_s`. Then there are an
elementary étale neighbourhood `(S', s') ⟶ (S, s)` and a commutative square
```
  X  ←ᵍ  X'
  ↓      ↓
  S  ←   S'
```
with `g` étale, `X_s ⊆ g(X')`, with `X'` and `S'` affine, and with `Γ(X', 𝒪_{X'})` a projective
`Γ(S', 𝒪_{S'})`-module.

This is the case `ℱ = 𝒪_X` of Tag 05KW, as in the source. The flatness hypothesis is converted
from the morphism to the structure sheaf by
`AlgebraicGeometry.isFlatOverAt_unit_iff_isFlatAt`, and the conclusion is converted back from
`Γ(X', g^*𝒪_X)` to `Γ(X', 𝒪_{X'})` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackUnitSectionsLinearEquiv`; the finite presentation of
`𝒪_X` as a module, which Tag 05KW requires of `ℱ`, is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.unitModule_isFinitePresentation`. Tag 05KW enters as
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood_projective_sections_along_fibre`, which is
unconditional, so nothing is assumed here beyond the source's hypotheses.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood_projective_structureSheafSections_along_fibre
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (s : S) (hf : FinitePresentation f)
    (hflat : ∀ x : f.fiber s, IsFlatAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom (f.fiberι s x)) :
    ∃ (U : EtaleNeighborhood S s) (X' : Scheme.{u})
      (h : X' ⟶ U.scheme) (g : X' ⟶ X),
      U.IsElementary ∧ IsAffine U.scheme ∧ IsAffine X' ∧ Etale g ∧
      g ≫ f = h ≫ U.toBase ∧
      f ⁻¹' {s} ⊆ Set.range g ∧
      (letI : Module Γ(U.scheme, ⊤) Γ(X', ⊤) := Module.compHom Γ(X', ⊤) h.appTop.hom
       Module.Projective Γ(U.scheme, ⊤) Γ(X', ⊤))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_etale_neighborhood_with_free_globalSections_of_isFiniteType
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05KY.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally of finite presentation, let `F` be a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module of finite type and let `x ∈ X` be a point at which `F` is flat over
`S`. Then there is an elementary étale neighbourhood `(S', s') ⟶ (S, s)` of the image `s` of `x`
and a commutative diagram of pointed schemes
```
  (X, x) ← (X', x')
    ↓         ↓
  (S, s) ← Spec 𝒪_{S', s'}
```
such that `X' ⟶ X ×_S Spec 𝒪_{S', s'}` is étale, `κ(x) = κ(x')`, `X'` is affine and of finite
presentation over `𝒪_{S', s'}`, `g^*F` is of finite presentation, and `Γ(X', g^*F)` is a free
`𝒪_{S', s'}`-module.

The two inputs are Tag 05ID,
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood_projective_sections_of_isFlatOverAt`, and
Tag 05I5, `AlgebraicGeometry.existsElementaryEtaleNeighborhoodFinitePresentationFlatOver`. The
flatness of `F` at `x` is used only through Tag 05I5, and projectivity of the sections becomes
freeness over the local ring `𝒪_{S', s'}` by Tag 0593.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etale_neighborhood_with_free_globalSections_of_isFiniteType
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFiniteType]
    (x : X) (hflat : IsFlatOverAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom F x) :
    ∃ (U : EtaleNeighborhood S (f x)) (_ : U.IsElementary)
      (X' : Scheme.{u}) (x' : X')
      (g : X' ⟶ X)
      (q : X' ⟶ Spec (.of (U.scheme.presheaf.stalk U.point)))
      (_ : g x' = x)
      (_ : q x' = IsLocalRing.closedPoint (U.scheme.presheaf.stalk U.point))
      (hcomm : g ≫ f = q ≫ U.scheme.fromSpecStalk U.point ≫ U.toBase)
      (_ : Etale (pullback.lift g q hcomm))
      (_ : IsIso (g.residueFieldMap x'))
      (_ : IsAffine X')
      (_ : FinitePresentation q)
      (_ : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F).IsFinitePresentation),
      letI : Module (U.scheme.presheaf.stalk U.point)
          Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F, ⊤) :=
        Module.compHom _
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (U.scheme.presheaf.stalk U.point))).inv ≫ q.appTop).hom
      Module.Free (U.scheme.presheaf.stalk U.point)
        Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F, ⊤)
declarations.comment: f locally of finite presentation, F quasi-coherent of finite type, F flat at x over S: an elementary étale neighbourhood (S', s') of (S, s) and (X', x') over Spec O_{S',s'} with X' → X ×_S Spec O_{S',s'} étale, κ(x) = κ(x'), X' affine of finite presentation over O_{S',s'}, g^*F of finite presentation and Γ(X', g^*F) free over O_{S',s'}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_etale_neighborhood_with_free_globalSections_of_locallyOfFiniteType
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05KZ.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally of finite type, let `F` be a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module of finite type and let `x : X` be a point at which `F` is flat over
`S`. Then there is an elementary étale neighbourhood `(S', s') ⟶ (S, s)` of the image `s` of `x`
and a commutative diagram of pointed schemes
```
  (X, x) ← (X', x')
    ↓         ↓
  (S, s) ← Spec 𝒪_{S', s'}
```
such that `X' ⟶ X ×_S Spec 𝒪_{S', s'}` is étale, `κ(x) = κ(x')`, `X'` is affine, and
`Γ(X', g^*F)` is a free `𝒪_{S', s'}`-module.

This is Tag 05KY with the finite-presentation hypothesis on `f` weakened to finite type, by the
source's embedding into affine space: an affine neighbourhood `V` of `x` is a closed subscheme
`i : V ⟶ A` of an affine space `A` over an affine open of `S`, with `A ⟶ S` locally of finite
presentation, and Tag 05KY applies to `A ⟶ S`, to the direct image `i_*(F|_V)` and to the point
`i x`. The chart `Y ⟶ A` it returns is pulled back to `X' = V ×_A Y`. The embedding is
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_closedImmersion_affineSpace_of_locallyOfFiniteType`, the flatness
transfer across `i` is `AlgebraicGeometry.isFlatOverAt_pushforward_finite_iff`, and the
comparison of sections is `AlgebraicGeometry.affinePushforwardBaseChangeIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etale_neighborhood_with_free_globalSections_of_locallyOfFiniteType
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFiniteType]
    (x : X) (hflat : IsFlatOverAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom F x) :
    ∃ (U : EtaleNeighborhood S (f x)) (_ : U.IsElementary)
      (X' : Scheme.{u}) (x' : X')
      (g : X' ⟶ X)
      (q : X' ⟶ Spec (.of (U.scheme.presheaf.stalk U.point)))
      (_ : g x' = x)
      (_ : q x' = IsLocalRing.closedPoint (U.scheme.presheaf.stalk U.point))
      (hcomm : g ≫ f = q ≫ U.scheme.fromSpecStalk U.point ≫ U.toBase)
      (_ : Etale (pullback.lift g q hcomm))
      (_ : IsIso (g.residueFieldMap x'))
      (_ : IsAffine X'),
      letI : Module (U.scheme.presheaf.stalk U.point)
          Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F, ⊤) :=
        Module.compHom _
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (U.scheme.presheaf.stalk U.point))).inv ≫ q.appTop).hom
      Module.Free (U.scheme.presheaf.stalk U.point)
        Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F, ⊤)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood_free_sections_along_fibre
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05L0.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be of finite presentation, let `F` be a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module of finite type and let `s : S` be such that `F` is flat over `S` at
every point of the fibre `X_s`. Then there are an elementary étale neighbourhood
`(S', s') ⟶ (S, s)` and a commutative diagram
```
  X  ←ᵍ  X'
  ↓      ↓
  S  ←  Spec 𝒪_{S', s'}
```
such that `X' ⟶ X ×_S Spec 𝒪_{S', s'}` is étale, `X_s = g((X')_{s'})`, `X'` is affine and of
finite presentation over `𝒪_{S', s'}`, `g^*F` is of finite presentation, and `Γ(X', g^*F)` is a
free `𝒪_{S', s'}`-module.

The inputs are Tag 05KY,
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_etale_neighborhood_with_free_globalSections_of_isFiniteType`, applied at
every point of the fibre, and Tag 057B, which makes the elementary étale neighbourhoods of
`(S, s)` cofiltered so that the finitely many neighbourhoods surviving the quasi-compactness of
the fibre are dominated by one of them.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood_free_sections_along_fibre
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (F : X.Modules) (hfp : FinitePresentation f)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFiniteType] (s : S)
    (hflat : ∀ x : f.fiber s, IsFlatOverAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom F (f.fiberι s x)) :
    ∃ (U : EtaleNeighborhood S s) (_ : U.IsElementary)
      (X' : Scheme.{u})
      (q : X' ⟶ Spec (.of (U.scheme.presheaf.stalk U.point)))
      (g : X' ⟶ X)
      (hcomm : g ≫ f = q ≫ U.scheme.fromSpecStalk U.point ≫ U.toBase)
      (_ : Etale (pullback.lift g q hcomm))
      (_ : f ⁻¹' {s} = g '' (q ⁻¹' {IsLocalRing.closedPoint _}))
      (_ : IsAffine X')
      (_ : FinitePresentation q)
      (_ : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F).IsFinitePresentation),
      letI : Module (U.scheme.presheaf.stalk U.point)
          Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F, ⊤) :=
        Module.compHom _
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (U.scheme.presheaf.stalk U.point))).inv ≫ q.appTop).hom
      Module.Free (U.scheme.presheaf.stalk U.point)
        Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F, ⊤)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood_free_sections_along_fibre_of_finiteType
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05L1.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be of finite type, let `F` be a quasi-coherent
`𝒪_X`-module of finite type and let `s : S` be such that `F` is flat over `S` at every point of
the fibre `X_s`. Then there are an elementary étale neighbourhood `(S', s') ⟶ (S, s)` and a
commutative diagram

  ↓      ↓

such that `X' ⟶ X ×_S Spec 𝒪_{S', s'}` is étale, `X_s = g((X')_{s'})`, `X'` is affine, and
`Γ(X', g^*F)` is a free `𝒪_{S', s'}`-module.

This differs from Tag 05L0 only in assuming `f` of finite type rather than of finite
presentation, the input at each point of the fibre being Tag 05KZ,
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_etale_neighborhood_with_free_globalSections_of_locallyOfFiniteType`,
in place of Tag 05KY; correspondingly the two finite-presentation clauses are dropped from the

declarations.statement:
theorem exists_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood_free_sections_along_fibre_of_finiteType
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (F : X.Modules)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFiniteType] (s : S)
    (hflat : ∀ x : f.fiber s, IsFlatOverAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom F (f.fiberι s x)) :
    ∃ (U : EtaleNeighborhood S s) (_ : U.IsElementary)
      (X' : Scheme.{u})
      (q : X' ⟶ Spec (.of (U.scheme.presheaf.stalk U.point)))

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeAssassin.exists_specializes_mem_associatedPoints_fibre
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05L3: a criterion for purity.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally of finite
type and `F` a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module of finite type which is flat over `S` at every point
of the fibre `X_s`. A point of `Ass_{X/S}(F)` which specializes to some point of `X_s`
specializes to a point of `X_s` associated to the restriction of `F` to `X_s`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_specializes_mem_associatedPoints_fibre
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFiniteType] (s : S)
    (hflat : ∀ t : f.fiber s, IsFlatOverAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom F (f.fiberι s t))
    {x' : X} (hx' : x' ∈ Stacks.Divisors.relativeAssassin f F)
    (hmeets : ∃ t : f.fiber s, x' ⤳ f.fiberι s t) :
    ∃ x : f.fiber s, x' ⤳ f.fiberι s x ∧
      x ∈ Stacks.Divisors.associatedPoints
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.fiberι s)).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPureAlong_iff_relativeAssassin_specializing_mem_range_of_associatedPoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05L4.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be of finite type, let `ℱ` be a finite type
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module and let `s ∈ S`. Let `(S', s') ⟶ (S, s)` be an elementary étale
neighbourhood and let `g : X' ⟶ X` and `p : X' ⟶ S'` form a commutative square over `S' ⟶ S`.
Assume

1. `ℱ` is flat over `S` at all points of `X_s`,
2. `p : X' ⟶ S'` is of finite type,
3. `g^*ℱ` is pure along `X'_{s'}`,
4. `g : X' ⟶ X` is étale, and
5. `g(X'_{s'})` contains `Ass_{X_s}(ℱ_s)`.

Then `ℱ` is pure along `X_s` if and only if the image of `X' ⟶ X ×_S S'` contains the points of
`Ass_{X ×_S S'/S'}(ℱ ×_S S')` lying over points of `S'` which specialize to `s'`.

The source states (5) as `g(X') ⊇ Ass_{X_s}(ℱ_s)`. With that reading the statement is false, by
`Stacks.Examples.not_forall_isPureAlong_iff_of_associatedPoints_subset_range`: take
`X = S`, `ℱ = 𝒪_S`, `S' = S ⨿ S` with `s'` in the first copy and `X' = S` mapping onto the second
copy. The proof of the source, which first replaces `S` by `S'`, uses (5) for the fibre over `s'`,
as stated here.

Hypothesis (5) is moved to the fibre of `X ×_S S'` over `s'` by Tag 05DC
(`AlgebraicGeometry.mem_relativeAssassin_pullback_iff`), and a point of that fibre is pinned down
by its image in `X` (`AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackLift_eq_fiberι_of_fst_eq`).
declarations.statement:
public theorem isPureAlong_iff_relativeAssassin_specializing_mem_range_of_associatedPoints
    {X S X' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFiniteType] [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (s : S) (U : EtaleNeighborhood S s) (hU : U.IsElementary)
    (p : X' ⟶ U.scheme) [LocallyOfFiniteType p] [QuasiCompact p]
    (g : X' ⟶ X) [Etale g] (hcomm : g ≫ f = p ≫ U.toBase)
    (hflat : ∀ x : f.fiber s, IsFlatOverAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom F (f.fiberι s x))
    (hpure' : IsPureAlong
      ({ S := U.scheme
         X := X'
         f := p
         F := (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F
         isFiniteType := SheafOfModules.pullback_isFiniteType g.toLRSHom.toShHom F
         isQuasicoherent := by
           have hF : F.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
           exact @SheafOfModules.modulePullback_isQuasicoherent X'.toRingedSpace
             X.toRingedSpace g.toLRSHom.toShHom F hF
         s := U.point } : PrePureSituation.{u}))
    (hass : ∀ z : f.fiber s,
      z ∈ Stacks.Divisors.associatedPoints ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.fiberι s)).obj F) →
        f.fiberι s z ∈ g '' (p ⁻¹' {U.point})) :
    IsPureAlong ({ S := S, X := X, f := f, F := F, s := s } : PrePureSituation.{u}) ↔
      ∀ x : pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) f U.toBase,
        x ∈ Stacks.Divisors.relativeAssassin (pullback.snd f U.toBase)
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst f U.toBase)).obj F) →
          pullback.snd f U.toBase x ⤳ U.point →
            x ∈ Set.range (pullback.lift g p hcomm)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isUniversallyPureAlong_of_isPureAlong
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05L5.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be of finite type, let `ℱ` be a finite type
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module, and let `s : S`. If `ℱ` is flat over `S` at every point of the fibre
`X_s` and pure along `X_s`, then `ℱ` is universally pure along `X_s`.

The inputs are Tag 05L1, which produces an affine étale chart of the whole fibre with free
sections after an elementary étale localization of the base, Tag 05K6, which makes that chart
universally pure over the local base, Tag 05L4, which converts the resulting containment of the
relative assassin into purity after an arbitrary base change, the unconditional half of Tag 05KL,
which propagates that containment along a base change, and Tags 05J7 and 05J9, which transport
purity and universal purity along the elementary étale neighbourhood and the localization.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isUniversallyPureAlong_of_isPureAlong
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFiniteType] [F.IsQuasicoherent] (s : S)
    (hflat : ∀ x : f.fiber s, IsFlatOverAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom F (f.fiberι s x))
    (hpure : IsPureAlong ({ S := S, X := X, f := f, F := F, s := s } : PrePureSituation.{u})) :
    IsUniversallyPureAlong ({ S := S, X := X, f := f, F := F, s := s } :
      PrePureSituation.{u})

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPureRelative_of_isUniversallyPureRelative
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05L6**, the implication which needs no hypothesis on the base: a
finite type quasi-coherent module which is universally pure relative to the base is pure
relative to the base, there being fewer impurity diagrams to exclude.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPureRelative_of_isUniversallyPureRelative {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsFiniteType] [F.IsQuasicoherent] (h : IsUniversallyPureRelative f F) :
    IsPureRelative f F
declarations.comment:
the implication universally pure relative to S implies pure relative to S, with
no flatness and no Noetherian hypothesis

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isUniversallyPureRelative_of_isPureRelative
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05L6**, the harder implication. Let `f : X ⟶ S` be of finite type and
let `ℱ` be a finite type quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module which is flat over `S`. If `ℱ` is pure
relative to `S` then it is universally pure relative to `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isUniversallyPureRelative_of_isPureRelative {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsFiniteType] [F.IsQuasicoherent] (hflat : IsFlatOver f.toLRSHom.toShHom F)
    (h : IsPureRelative f F) :
    IsUniversallyPureRelative f F
declarations.comment:
the implication pure relative to S implies universally pure relative to S, for a
module flat over S, with no hypothesis on S

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPureRelative_iff_isUniversallyPureRelative
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05L6.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be of finite type and let `ℱ` be a finite type
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module which is flat over `S`. Then `ℱ` is pure relative to `S` if and only
if it is universally pure relative to `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPureRelative_iff_isUniversallyPureRelative {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsFiniteType] [F.IsQuasicoherent] (hflat : IsFlatOver f.toLRSHom.toShHom F) :
    IsPureRelative f F ↔ IsUniversallyPureRelative f F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPureRelative_iff_isUniversallyPureRelative_of_isLocallyNoetherian
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05L6** over a locally Noetherian base, where the flatness hypothesis
is unnecessary. Let `f : X ⟶ S` be of finite type and let `ℱ` be a finite type quasi-coherent
`𝒪_X`-module. If `S` is locally Noetherian then `ℱ` is pure relative to `S` if and only if it is
universally pure relative to `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPureRelative_iff_isUniversallyPureRelative_of_isLocallyNoetherian
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFiniteType] [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    IsPureRelative f F ↔ IsUniversallyPureRelative f F
declarations.comment:
a strengthening over a locally Noetherian base: Tag 05J8 replaces Tag 05L5 and
needs no flatness, so the flatness hypothesis of the source is dropped here

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.forall_injective_stalkLinearMap_associatedPoints_iff_mono
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05L8.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a morphism of finite type, let `ℱ` be a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module of finite type, and let `s` be a point of `S` to which every point
of `S` specializes — for instance the closed point of a local base. Assume `ℱ` is pure along the
fibre `X_s` and flat over `S`. Then a map `φ : ℱ ⟶ 𝒢` of quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-modules is
injective if and only if the stalk map `φ_x` is injective at every point `x` of `X_s` associated
to the restriction `ℱ_s`.

One direction is immediate: the stalk maps of a monomorphism are injective at every point. For
the other, the kernel of `φ` has no weakly associated point — such a point would lie in
`Ass_{X/S}(ℱ)` by flatness, would specialize into `X_s` by purity, and the hypothesis at the
associated point of `ℱ_s` it specializes to by Tag 05L3 would put that point outside the support
of the kernel, which is stable under specialization.
declarations.statement:
theorem forall_injective_stalkLinearMap_associatedPoints_iff_mono
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (F G : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFiniteType] [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    (s : S) (hclosed : ∀ t : S, t ⤳ s)
    (hpure : IsPureAlong ({ S := S, X := X, f := f, F := F, s := s } : PrePureSituation.{u}))
    (hflat : IsFlatOver f.toLRSHom.toShHom F) (φ : F ⟶ G) :
    (∀ x : f.fiber s,
        x ∈ Stacks.Divisors.associatedPoints ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.fiberι s)).obj F) →
          Function.Injective (stalkLinearMap F G φ (f.fiberι s x))) ↔ Mono φ
declarations.comment: the equivalence, both directions; `S` local with closed point `s` is rendered by the hypothesis that every point of `S` specializes to `s`, which is what a local base supplies

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.relativelyRepresentable_diagonal
declarations.doc:
The diagonal of a representable transformation of presheaves on the big fppf site over `S` is
representable.
declarations.statement:
public theorem relativelyRepresentable_diagonal
    (B : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {F G : (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_diagonal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05LA.** The relative diagonal of a transformation representable
by algebraic spaces is representable by algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_diagonal
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (a : F ⟶ G) (ha : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS a) :

declarations.name: Stacks.Examples.exists_flat_finiteType_not_finitePresentation_of_curve_fibers
declarations.doc:
A flat algebra of finite type with geometrically
connected and geometrically reduced one-dimensional complete-intersection fibres need not be
of finite presentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_flat_finiteType_not_finitePresentation_of_curve_fibers :
    ∃ (R : Type u) (A : Type v) (_ : CommRing R) (_ : CommRing A)
      (_ : Algebra R A),
      Module.Flat R A ∧ Algebra.FiniteType R A ∧ ¬ Algebra.FinitePresentation R A ∧
        (∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime],
          Algebra.IsGeometricallyConnected p.ResidueField (p.Fiber A) ∧
          Algebra.IsGeometricallyReduced p.ResidueField (p.Fiber A) ∧
          ringKrullDim (p.Fiber A) = 1 ∧
          IsGlobalCompleteIntersection p.ResidueField (p.Fiber A))

declarations.name: Stacks.Examples.exists_proper_flat_not_finitePresentation_with_nodal_or_line_fibers
declarations.doc:
There is a proper flat morphism of schemes, not locally of finite presentation, each of whose
fibres is either a projective line or the vanishing locus of `X₁X₂` in the projective plane over
the residue field of its point.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_proper_flat_not_finitePresentation_with_nodal_or_line_fibers :
    ∃ (R : Type u) (_ : CommRing R) (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)),
      IsProper f ∧ AlgebraicGeometry.Flat f ∧ ¬ LocallyOfFinitePresentation f ∧
        ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime],
          (∃ g : projectiveSpaceOverRing 1 (CommRingCat.of p.ResidueField) ⟶ X,
            IsPullback g
              (projectiveSpaceOverRing 1 (CommRingCat.of p.ResidueField) ↘
                Spec (CommRingCat.of p.ResidueField))
              f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R p.ResidueField)))) ∨
          (∃ g : monomialPairLocus p.ResidueField 2 1 (Fin.last 2) ⟶ X,
            IsPullback g (monomialPairLocusToSpec p.ResidueField 2 1 (Fin.last 2)) f
              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R p.ResidueField))))

declarations.name: Stacks.Examples.exists_proper_flat_not_finitePresentation_with_projectiveSpace_fibers
declarations.doc:
There is a proper flat morphism of schemes, not locally of finite presentation, each of whose
fibres is either a projective line or a projective plane over the residue field of its point.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_proper_flat_not_finitePresentation_with_projectiveSpace_fibers :
    ∃ (R : Type u) (_ : CommRing R) (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)),
      IsProper f ∧ AlgebraicGeometry.Flat f ∧ ¬ LocallyOfFinitePresentation f ∧
        ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime],
          (∃ g : projectiveSpaceOverRing 1 (CommRingCat.of p.ResidueField) ⟶ X,
            IsPullback g
              (projectiveSpaceOverRing 1 (CommRingCat.of p.ResidueField) ↘
                Spec (CommRingCat.of p.ResidueField))
              f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R p.ResidueField)))) ∨
          (∃ g : projectiveSpaceOverRing 2 (CommRingCat.of p.ResidueField) ⟶ X,
            IsPullback g
              (projectiveSpaceOverRing 2 (CommRingCat.of p.ResidueField) ↘
                Spec (CommRingCat.of p.ResidueField))
              f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R p.ResidueField))))

declarations.name: Stacks.Examples.exists_flat_finiteType_not_finitePresentation_with_completeIntersection_fibers
declarations.doc:
A flat ring map of finite type can have geometrically irreducible complete-intersection
fibres without being of finite presentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_flat_finiteType_not_finitePresentation_with_completeIntersection_fibers :
    ∃ (R S : Type u) (_ : CommRing R) (_ : CommRing S) (f : R →+* S),
      f.Flat ∧ f.FiniteType ∧ ¬ f.FinitePresentation ∧
        (letI := f.toAlgebra
         ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime],
           letI : Algebra p.ResidueField (S ⊗[R] p.ResidueField) :=
             Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
           Algebra.IsGeometricallyIrreducible p.ResidueField
               (S ⊗[R] p.ResidueField) ∧
             IsGlobalCompleteIntersection p.ResidueField
               (S ⊗[R] p.ResidueField))

declarations.name: Stacks.Examples.DimensionSheaf.exists_sheaf_detecting_dimension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05LE.** For every big étale site and every natural number `n` there is a sheaf of
abelian groups `G` on it whose sections over `X` are zero when `\dim(X) < n`, are nonzero when
`\dim(X) \ge n`, and restrict isomorphically along a thickening `X \subset X'`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_sheaf_detecting_dimension (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ G : Sheaf B.topology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1},
      (∀ X : B.Scheme, topologicalKrullDim ((B.inclusion).obj X) < (n : WithBot ℕ∞) →
          Subsingleton (G.obj.obj (Opposite.op X))) ∧
        (∀ X : B.Scheme, (n : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim ((B.inclusion).obj X) →
          Nontrivial (G.obj.obj (Opposite.op X))) ∧
        (∀ (X X' : B.Scheme) (i : X ⟶ X'),
          Stacks.Thickenings.IsThickening ((B.inclusion).map i) →
            IsIso (G.obj.map i.op))

declarations.name: Stacks.Examples.ConstructibleFunctionSheaf.exists_nonzero_limitPreserving_sheaf_vanishing_on_fields
declarations.doc:
A nonzero limit-preserving étale sheaf of abelian groups which vanishes on fields
and whose restriction maps along thickenings are isomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_nonzero_limitPreserving_sheaf_vanishing_on_fields
    (B : BigEtaleSite.{u}) [UnivLE.{max v w, u}] :
    ∃ G : Sheaf B.topology AddCommGrpCat.{u},
      (∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] (hk : B.Contains (Spec (.of k))),
        IsZero (G.obj.obj (Opposite.op (B.obj (Spec (.of k)) hk)))) ∧
      AlgebraicGeometry.LimitPreserving.{u, u, v, w, u + 1, u}
        B.inclusion (G.obj ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ∧
      (∀ (X X' : Scheme.{u}) (hX : B.Contains X) (hX' : B.Contains X')
        (i : X ⟶ X'), Stacks.Thickenings.IsThickening i →
          IsIso (G.obj.map (ObjectProperty.homMk i :
            B.obj X hX ⟶ B.obj X' hX').op)) ∧
      (∃ X : B.Scheme, ¬ IsZero (G.obj.obj (Opposite.op X)))

declarations.name: Stacks.FinitePresentation.ColimitDescent.statement_two
declarations.doc:
**Statement (2).** If `N` is a finite `A`-module and `u : M → N` has
surjective base change to `R`, then its base change to some `R_i` is surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem statement_two
    (htrans : TransitionSystem φ) (hcocone : IsCoconeAlg φ ψ)
    (hcolimN : IsModuleColimit φ ψ N)
    (hN : Module.Finite A N)
    (u : M →ₗ[A] N)
    (h : Function.Surjective (LinearMap.baseChange S u)) :
    ∃ i : ι, Function.Surjective (LinearMap.baseChange (R i) u)

declarations.name: Stacks.FinitePresentation.ColimitDescent.statement_three
declarations.doc:
**Statement (3).** If `N` is a finitely presented `A`-module and
`v : N ⊗_A R → M ⊗_A R` is an `R`-module map, then there is some `i` and an
`R_i`-module map `v_i : N ⊗_A R_i → M ⊗_A R_i` whose base change along
`ψ i : R_i → S` (i.e. composition with the canonical identification maps)
recovers `v`.  Concretely, `v` composed with the canonical map for `N` equals
the canonical map for `M` composed with `v_i`.
declarations.statement:
theorem statement_three
    (htrans : TransitionSystem φ) (hcocone : IsCoconeAlg φ ψ)
    (hcolimM : IsModuleColimit φ ψ M)
    (hN : Module.FinitePresentation A N)
    (v : S ⊗[A] N →ₗ[S] S ⊗[A] M) :
    ∃ (i : ι) (vi : (R i) ⊗[A] N →ₗ[R i] (R i) ⊗[A] M),
      (v.restrictScalars A) ∘ₗ (canonMod ψ N i)
        = (canonMod ψ M i) ∘ₗ (vi.restrictScalars A)

declarations.name: Stacks.FinitePresentation.ColimitDescent.statement_four
declarations.doc:
**Statement (4).** If `M` is finite, `N` is finitely presented, and
`u : M → N` has base change to `R` an isomorphism, then its base change to some
`R_i` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem statement_four
    (htrans : TransitionSystem φ) (hcocone : IsCoconeAlg φ ψ)
    (hcolimM : IsModuleColimit φ ψ M) (hcolimN : IsModuleColimit φ ψ N)
    (hM : Module.Finite A M) (hN : Module.FinitePresentation A N)
    (u : M →ₗ[A] N)
    (h : Function.Bijective (LinearMap.baseChange S u)) :
    ∃ i : ι, Function.Bijective (LinearMap.baseChange (R i) u)

declarations.name: Stacks.FinitePresentation.ColimitDescent.statement_one
declarations.doc:
**Statement (1).** If `M` is a finite `A`-module and `u, u' : M → N` are
`A`-module maps whose base changes to `R` agree, then their base changes to some
`R_i` already agree.
declarations.statement:
theorem statement_one
    (hcolimN : IsModuleColimit φ ψ N)
    (hM : Module.Finite A M)
    (u u' : M →ₗ[A] N)
    (h : LinearMap.baseChange S u = LinearMap.baseChange S u') :
    ∃ i : ι, LinearMap.baseChange (R i) u = LinearMap.baseChange (R i) u'

declarations.name: Module.FlatAlongZeroLocus.of_baseChange
declarations.doc:
Flatness along the inverse image of a closed subset descends after a
base change which is surjective onto that closed subset and whose local rings there are flat
over the original base.
declarations.statement:
theorem Module.FlatAlongZeroLocus.of_baseChange
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) (R' : Type w) (M : Type x)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing R'] [Algebra R S] [Algebra R R']
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module S M] [IsScalarTower R S M]
    (I : Ideal R) (I' : Ideal R')
    (_hmap : I.map (algebraMap R R') ≤ I')
    (hsurj : ∀ (p : Ideal R), p.IsPrime → I ≤ p →
      ∃ (p' : Ideal R'), p'.IsPrime ∧ I' ≤ p' ∧
        p'.comap (algebraMap R R') = p)
    (hflat : ∀ (p' : Ideal R') [p'.IsPrime], I' ≤ p' →
      Module.Flat R (Localization.AtPrime p')) :
    letI := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra (R := R) (A := S) (B := R')
    Module.FlatAlongZeroLocus R' (S ⊗[R] R') I'
      ((S ⊗[R] R') ⊗[S] M) →
      Module.FlatAlongZeroLocus R S I M

declarations.name: Module.exists_flatAlongZeroLocus_baseChange_of_colimit
declarations.doc:
Flatness of a finitely presented module along the closed subset defined
by a compatible family of ideals in a directed system descends from the colimit to one stage.
declarations.statement:
theorem Module.exists_flatAlongZeroLocus_baseChange_of_colimit
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation R S]
    (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module S M] [IsScalarTower R S M]
    [Module.FinitePresentation S M]
    (Λ : Type u) [Preorder Λ] [Nonempty Λ] [IsDirected Λ (· ≤ ·)]
    (A : Λ ⥤ CommAlgCat.{u} R) (I : ∀ i, Ideal (A.obj i))
    (hI : ∀ {i j : Λ} (hij : i ≤ j),
      Ideal.map (A.map (homOfLE hij)).hom.toRingHom (I i) ≤ I j)
    (hflat :
      let R' := (colimit A : CommAlgCat.{u} R)
      let S' := S ⊗[R] R'
      letI : Algebra R' S' := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
      Module.FlatAlongZeroLocus
        R' S'
        (⨆ i, Ideal.map (colimit.ι A i).hom.toRingHom (I i))
        (S' ⊗[S] M)) :
    ∃ i : Λ,
      let Sᵢ := S ⊗[R] (A.obj i)
      letI : Algebra (A.obj i) Sᵢ := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
      Module.FlatAlongZeroLocus
        (A.obj i) Sᵢ (I i) (Sᵢ ⊗[S] M)

declarations.name: Module.FlatteningSituation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 05LP.** The fixed data for flattening over closed subsets of source and base:
a ring map `R → S`, an ideal `J ⊆ S`, and an `S`-module `M`.
declarations.statement: structure Module.FlatteningSituation

declarations.name: Module.IsFlatAtPrimesOver
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 05LQ.** Condition (15.19.1): the base change of `M` along `R → R'` is flat over
`R'` at every prime of `S ⊗[R] R'` containing the extensions of both `I'` and `J`. The module
denoted `M ⊗_R R'` in the source is represented by the canonically equivalent extension of
scalars `(S ⊗[R] R') ⊗[S] M`.
declarations.statement:
def Module.IsFlatAtPrimesOver {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S] (J : Ideal S) {M : Type w} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Module S M] [IsScalarTower R S M] (R' : Type x) [CommRing R'] [Algebra R R']
    (I' : Ideal R') : Prop

declarations.name: Module.IsFlatAtPrimesOver.baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 05LR.** Flatness at all primes over the extensions of `I'` and `J` is preserved
by a further base change `R' → R''` and by replacing the extension of `I'` with a larger
ideal `I''`.
declarations.statement:
lemma Module.IsFlatAtPrimesOver.baseChange
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (J : Ideal S) {M : Type w} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module S M]
    [IsScalarTower R S M]
    (R' : Type x) [CommRing R'] [Algebra R R']
    (R'' : Type y) [CommRing R''] [Algebra R R''] [Algebra R' R'']
    [IsScalarTower R R' R'']
    (I' : Ideal R') (I'' : Ideal R'')
    (hI : Ideal.map (algebraMap R' R'') I' ≤ I'')
    (hflat : Module.IsFlatAtPrimesOver (R := R) (S := S) J (M := M) R' I') :
    Module.IsFlatAtPrimesOver (R := R) (S := S) J (M := M) R'' I''

declarations.name: Module.IsFlatAtPrimesOver.of_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 05LS.** Flatness along the closed subsets determined by `I'` and `J` descends
from `R''` to `R'` when `V(I'') → V(I')` is surjective and the localizations of `R''` at primes
containing `I''` are flat over `R'`.
declarations.statement:
lemma Module.IsFlatAtPrimesOver.of_baseChange
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (J : Ideal S) {M : Type w} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module S M]
    [IsScalarTower R S M]
    {R' : Type x} {R'' : Type y} [CommRing R'] [CommRing R'']
    [Algebra R R'] [Algebra R R''] [Algebra R' R''] [IsScalarTower R R' R'']
    (I' : Ideal R') (I'' : Ideal R'')
    (_hI : Ideal.map (algebraMap R' R'') I' ≤ I'')
    (hsurj : ∀ (p' : Ideal R'), p'.IsPrime → I' ≤ p' →
      ∃ p'' : Ideal R'', p''.IsPrime ∧ I'' ≤ p'' ∧
        Ideal.comap (algebraMap R' R'') p'' = p')
    (hflat : ∀ (p'' : Ideal R'') [p''.IsPrime], I'' ≤ p'' →
      Module.Flat R' (Localization p''.primeCompl))
    (h : Module.IsFlatAtPrimesOver (R := R) (M := M) J R'' I'') :
    Module.IsFlatAtPrimesOver (R := R) (M := M) J R' I'

declarations.name: Module.exists_isFlatAtPrimesOver_of_isColimit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 05LT.** Let `R → S` be essentially of finite presentation, let `J ⊆ S` be an
ideal and let `M` be a finitely presented `S`-module. Let `F` be a filtered system of
`R`-algebras whose colimit cocone `c` is preserved by the forgetful functor to types, and let
`I lambda ⊆ F.obj lambda` be a compatible family of ideals. If the flatness condition
`Module.IsFlatAtPrimesOver` holds over the colimit `c.pt` and the supremum of the images of the
`I lambda`, then it already holds at some stage `lambda`.

Preservation of the colimit by the forgetful functor expresses the source's directed colimit of
rings elementwise: every element and every finite equation in `c.pt` comes from a stage. It is
required explicitly because the index universes and the ring universe are independent.
declarations.statement:
theorem Module.exists_isFlatAtPrimesOver_of_isColimit
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {M : Type w} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module S M] [IsScalarTower R S M]
    [Module.FinitePresentation S M] (J : Ideal S)
    (hS : (algebraMap R S).EssentiallyOfFinitePresentation)
    {Lambda : Type y} [Category.{z} Lambda] [IsFiltered Lambda]
    (F : Lambda ⥤ CommAlgCat.{x} R) [PreservesColimit F (forget (CommAlgCat.{x} R))]
    (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (I : (lambda : Lambda) → Ideal (F.obj lambda))
    (hI : ∀ {lambda mu : Lambda} (f : lambda ⟶ mu),
      Ideal.map (F.map f).hom.toRingHom (I lambda) ≤ I mu)
    (hflat : Module.IsFlatAtPrimesOver (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) J (c.pt : Type x)
      (⨆ lambda, Ideal.map (c.ι.app lambda).hom.toRingHom (I lambda))) :
    ∃ lambda, Module.IsFlatAtPrimesOver (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) J
      (F.obj lambda) (I lambda)

declarations.name: Module.flat_localizedModule_atPrime_of_flat_quotient_pow
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 05LU.** Let `R → S` be a map of Noetherian rings, let `J ⊆ S` and `I ⊆ R` be
ideals, and let `M` be a finite `S`-module. If, at every prime `q` containing `J + IS`, the
localization `(M / IⁿM)_q` is flat over `R / Iⁿ` for every `n ≥ 1`, then `M_q` is flat over `R`
at every such prime.
declarations.statement:
theorem Module.flat_localizedModule_atPrime_of_flat_quotient_pow
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing S]
    {M : Type w} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module S M] [IsScalarTower R S M]
    [Module.Finite S M] (J : Ideal S) (I : Ideal R)
    (hflat : ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : Ideal S) (_ : q.IsPrime),
      J + I.map (algebraMap R S) ≤ q →
        let K := (I ^ (n + 1)).map (algebraMap R S) • (⊤ : Submodule S M)
        let Q := M ⧸ K
        let hQ : Module.IsTorsionBySet R Q ((I ^ (n + 1) : Ideal R) : Set R) := by
          intro z r
          induction z using Quotient.inductionOn' with
          | _ m =>
            change (Submodule.Quotient.mk ((r : R) • m) : M ⧸ K) = 0
            exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero K).mpr
              (show (r : R) • m ∈ K by
                rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul S (r : R) m]
                exact Submodule.smul_mem_smul
                  (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap R S) r.2) Submodule.mem_top)
        let N := LocalizedModule q.primeCompl Q
        let hN : Module.IsTorsionBySet R N ((I ^ (n + 1) : Ideal R) : Set R) := by
          intro z r
          obtain ⟨⟨z, s⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.mk'_surjective q.primeCompl
            (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap q.primeCompl Q) z
          change (r : R) • IsLocalizedModule.mk'
            (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap q.primeCompl Q) z s = 0
          rw [← IsLocalizedModule.mk'_smul, hQ]
          exact IsLocalizedModule.mk'_zero _ _
        letI := hN.module
        Module.Flat (R ⧸ I ^ (n + 1)) N) :
    ∀ (q : Ideal S) (_ : q.IsPrime), J + I.map (algebraMap R S) ≤ q →
      Module.Flat R (LocalizedModule q.primeCompl M)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_nhds_of_isLocallyConstructible_of_specializes_subset

**Stacks Project, Tag 05LW.** A locally constructible subset of a scheme that contains every

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IsLimitPreserving
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05LX.** A functor on schemes over `S` is *limit preserving* when for every
cofiltered inverse system `{T_i}` of affine schemes over `S` with limit `T` the canonical map
`colim_i F(T_i) → F(T)` is bijective.
declarations.statement: def IsLimitPreserving (S : Scheme.{u}) (F : (Over S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v) : Prop
declarations.comment: limit preserving functors

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.locallyOfFinitePresentation_iff_isLimitPreserving_yoneda
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01ZC in the terminology of limit preserving functors.** A scheme `X` over `S` is
locally of finite presentation over `S` if and only if its functor of points
`h_X = Mor_S(-, X)` is limit preserving.
declarations.statement:
theorem locallyOfFinitePresentation_iff_isLimitPreserving_yoneda {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) :
    LocallyOfFinitePresentation f ↔ IsLimitPreserving S (yoneda.obj (Over.mk f))
declarations.comment: locally of finite presentation iff the functor of points is limit preserving

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.eventually_isFlatOver_modulePullback
declarations.doc:
If a finitely presented quasi-coherent module at one stage of a cofiltered
inverse system becomes flat over the base-changed target at the limit, it is
flat over that target after passing to some later stage.
declarations.statement:
theorem eventually_isFlatOver_modulePullback
    {I : Type v} [Category.{w} I] [IsCofiltered I] [EssentiallySmall.{u} I]
    (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ {i j : I} (e : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map e)]
    [∀ i : I, CompactSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ i : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    (i : I) (X Y : Over (D.obj i))
    (hX : FinitePresentation X.hom) (hY : FinitePresentation Y.hom)
    (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.left.toRingedSpace))
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hflat : IsFlatOver
      ((Over.pullback (c.π.app i)).map f).left.toLRSHom.toShHom
      ((modulePullback
        (pullback.fst X.hom (c.π.app i)).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj F)) :
    ∃ (j : I) (e : j ⟶ i), IsFlatOver
      ((Over.pullback (D.map e)).map f).left.toLRSHom.toShHom
      ((modulePullback
        (pullback.fst X.hom (D.map e)).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_surjective_isClosedImmersion_projectiveSpace_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**The square of [Stacks, Tag 05LZ].** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be proper and admit a Chow
modification. Then there are an `n`, a scheme `X'`, a proper **surjective** morphism
`π : X' ⟶ X` and a **closed immersion** `i : X' ⟶ ℙⁿ_S` with
`π ≫ f = i ≫ (ℙⁿ_S ↘ S)`, that is, a commutative square

```
X' ---i---> ℙⁿ_S
|            |
π            |
v            v
X ----f----> S
```

over `S` whose left vertical morphism is surjective and whose top morphism is a closed immersion
into projective space over `S`.

Chow's lemma supplies the square with `i` merely an immersion; properness of `f` upgrades it to a
closed immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_surjective_isClosedImmersion_projectiveSpace_of_isProper (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f]
    (hf : HasChowModification f) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (X' : Scheme.{u}) (π : X' ⟶ X) (i : X' ⟶ ProjectiveSpace n S),
      IsProper π ∧ Surjective π ∧ IsClosedImmersion i ∧
        π ≫ f = i ≫ (ProjectiveSpace n S ↘ S)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_projectiveSpace_square_isProper_iff_isClosedImmersion
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be quasi-compact and quasi-separated and let `f : X ⟶ S` be separated and of finite
type. Then there are an `n`, a scheme `X'`, a proper surjective morphism `π : X' ⟶ X` and an
immersion `i : X' ⟶ ℙⁿ_S` with `π ≫ f = i ≫ (ℙⁿ_S ↘ S)`. Moreover `f` is proper if and only if
`i` is a closed immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_projectiveSpace_square_isProper_iff_isClosedImmersion {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [QuasiCompact f] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (X' : Scheme.{u}) (π : X' ⟶ X) (i : X' ⟶ ProjectiveSpace n S),
      IsProper π ∧ Surjective π ∧ IsImmersion i ∧ π ≫ f = i ≫ (ProjectiveSpace n S ↘ S) ∧
        (IsProper f ↔ IsClosedImmersion i)

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.HasChowModification
registrations.comment: the displayed diagram, as the predicate HasChowModification

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_forall_topologicalKrullDim_fiber_le_of_isLimit_of_essentiallySmall
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05M5**, for an index category that is essentially small relative to
the universe of the schemes: a uniform bound on the dimensions of the fibres of a morphism
between inverse limits already holds at some stage.
declarations.statement:
public lemma exists_forall_topologicalKrullDim_fiber_le_of_isLimit_of_essentiallySmall
    {I : Type v} [Category.{w} I] [IsCofiltered I] [EssentiallySmall.{u} I]
    (X S : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ S)
    [∀ {i j : I} (g : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (S.map g)]
    [∀ i : I, CompactSpace (S.obj i)] [∀ i : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (S.obj i)]
    [∀ i : I, LocallyOfFiniteType (f.app i)] [∀ i : I, QuasiCompact (f.app i)]
    [∀ {i j : I} (g : i ⟶ j),
      IsClosedImmersion (pullback.lift (X.map g) (f.app i) (f.naturality g))]
    (cX : Cone X) (hcX : IsLimit cX) (cS : Cone S) (hcS : IsLimit cS) (d : ℕ)
    (hdim : ∀ s : cS.pt,
      topologicalKrullDim
        ((hcS.lift ((Cone.postcompose f).obj cX)).fiber s) ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ i : I, ∀ s : S.obj i,
      topologicalKrullDim ((f.app i).fiber s) ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finitePresentation_closedImmersion_of_forall_topologicalKrullDim_fiber_le
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05M6.** Let `S` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, let
`f : X ⟶ S` be a morphism of finite presentation and let `d` be a natural number.  A closed
subscheme `Z ⊆ X`, given by the closed immersion `i`, all of whose fibres over `S` have
dimension at most `d`, is contained in a closed subscheme `Z' ⊆ X`, given by the closed
immersion `j`, such that `j` is of finite presentation and all fibres of `Z'` over `S` still
have dimension at most `d`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finitePresentation_closedImmersion_of_forall_topologicalKrullDim_fiber_le
    {S X Z : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) (hf : FinitePresentation f) (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (d : ℕ)
    (hdim : ∀ s : S, topologicalKrullDim ((i ≫ f).fiber s) ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ (Z' : Scheme.{u}) (j : Z' ⟶ X) (h : Z ⟶ Z'),
      IsClosedImmersion j ∧ IsClosedImmersion h ∧ i = h ≫ j ∧ FinitePresentation j ∧
        ∀ s : S, topologicalKrullDim ((j ≫ f).fiber s) ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞)

declarations.name: Module.FiniteLength.determinantFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05M7.** The determinant of a finite-length module over a local
ring, together with the maps induced by module isomorphisms, is a functor to the groupoid
of one-dimensional vector spaces over the residue field.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def determinantFunctor (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] :
    DeterminantFunctor.{u, v} R

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isOpen_isFlatOverAt_fiber
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05M9** for a morphism locally of finite presentation: in every fibre of
`f`, the locus where a finite type quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module is flat over the base is open.

The source states this for `f` locally of finite type, and deduces it from Tag 05I5, which
assumes locally of finite presentation. For `f` only locally of finite type the same argument
needs Tag 05KT in place of Tag 05I5; that deduction is
`AlgebraicGeometry.isOpen_isFlatOverAt_fiber_of_exists`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpen_isFlatOverAt_fiber {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFiniteType]
    (s : S) :
    IsOpen {w : f.fiber s | IsFlatOverAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom F (f.fiberι s w)}
declarations.comment: for f locally of finite presentation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isOpen_isFlatOverAt_fiber_of_locallyOfFiniteType
declarations.doc:
In every fibre of a morphism locally of finite type, the locus where a quasi-coherent module of
finite type is flat over the base is open.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_stage_isPureAlong_of_isLimit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05MA.** Let `(S_i)` be an inverse system of affine schemes over a
directed index with limit `S`, let `s ∈ S` with images `s_i`, let `f : X ⟶ S` be of finite
presentation and let `ℱ` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module of finite presentation which is pure
along `X_s` and flat over `S` at every point of `X_s`. Then the whole situation descends to a
finite stage: some `i` carries a finite-presentation morphism `X_i ⟶ S_i` and a finitely
presented quasi-coherent module `ℱ_i` which is pure along `(X_i)_{s_i}` and flat over `S_i` at
every point of that fibre, with `X = X_i ×_{S_i} S` and `ℱ` the pullback of `ℱ_i`.

The descent of the morphism, the module, the open flat locus and the flatness, which is Stacks
Limits 01ZM, 01ZR, 01ZS and 05LY, is the hypothesis `hdescend`; the passage of purity to a
finite stage, which is the second half of the proof of the source and uses Stacks 05KW, 05K6,
05L4, 05KR and Limits 05F4, is the hypothesis `hstage`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_stage_isPureAlong_of_isLimit
    {I : Type u} [Category.{u} I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ i : I, IsAffine (D.obj i)] (c : Cone D) (_hc : IsLimit c)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ c.pt)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation] [F.IsFiniteType] (s : c.pt)
    (_hpure : IsPureAlong ({ S := c.pt, X := X, f := f, F := F,
                             s := s } : PrePureSituation.{u}))
    (_hflat : ∀ x : f.fiber s, IsFlatOverAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom F (f.fiberι s x))
    (hdescend : ∃ (i : I) (Xi : Scheme.{u}) (fi : Xi ⟶ D.obj i)
      (_ : LocallyOfFinitePresentation fi) (_ : QuasiCompact fi) (_ : QuasiSeparated fi)
      (Fi : Xi.Modules) (_ : Fi.IsFiniteType) (_ : Fi.IsQuasicoherent)
      (_ : Fi.IsFinitePresentation) (a : X ⟶ Xi),
      IsPullback a f fi (c.π.app i) ∧ Nonempty (F ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback a).obj Fi) ∧
        ∀ x : fi.fiber (c.π.app i s),
          IsFlatOverAt fi.toLRSHom.toShHom Fi (fi.fiberι (c.π.app i s) x))
    (hstage : ∀ (i : I) (Xi : Scheme.{u}) (fi : Xi ⟶ D.obj i)
      (_ : LocallyOfFinitePresentation fi) (_ : QuasiCompact fi) (_ : QuasiSeparated fi)
      (Fi : Xi.Modules) (_ : Fi.IsFiniteType) (_ : Fi.IsQuasicoherent)
      (_ : Fi.IsFinitePresentation) (a : X ⟶ Xi), IsPullback a f fi (c.π.app i) →
      Nonempty (F ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback a).obj Fi) →
      (∀ x : fi.fiber (c.π.app i s),
        IsFlatOverAt fi.toLRSHom.toShHom Fi (fi.fiberι (c.π.app i s) x)) →
      ∃ (j : I) (e : j ⟶ i) (_ : LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback.snd fi (D.map e)))
        (_ : QuasiCompact (pullback.snd fi (D.map e)))
        (_ : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst fi (D.map e))).obj Fi).IsFiniteType)
        (_ : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst fi (D.map e))).obj Fi).IsQuasicoherent),
        IsPureAlong ({ S := D.obj j, X := pullback fi (D.map e),
                       f := pullback.snd fi (D.map e),
                       F := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst fi (D.map e))).obj Fi,
                       s := c.π.app j s } : PrePureSituation.{u})) :
    ∃ (i : I) (Xi : Scheme.{u}) (fi : Xi ⟶ D.obj i) (_ : LocallyOfFinitePresentation fi)
      (_ : QuasiCompact fi) (_ : QuasiSeparated fi) (Fi : Xi.Modules) (_ : Fi.IsFiniteType)
      (_ : Fi.IsQuasicoherent) (_ : Fi.IsFinitePresentation) (a : X ⟶ Xi),
      IsPullback a f fi (c.π.app i) ∧ Nonempty (F ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback a).obj Fi) ∧
        (∀ x : fi.fiber (c.π.app i s),
          IsFlatOverAt fi.toLRSHom.toShHom Fi (fi.fiberι (c.π.app i s) x)) ∧
        IsPureAlong ({ S := D.obj i, X := Xi, f := fi, F := Fi,
                       s := c.π.app i s } : PrePureSituation.{u})
declarations.comment: assuming the limit descent as hdescend and the purity step as hstage

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_stage_isPureAlong_of_isLimit_directed
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05MA.** Let `I` be a directed set, let `(S_k)` be an inverse system of
affine schemes indexed by `I` with limit `S`, let `s` be a point of `S` with images `s_k`, let
`f : X ⟶ S` be of finite presentation and let `ℱ` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module of finite
presentation which is pure along `X_s` and flat over `S` at every point of `X_s`. Then the whole
situation descends to a finite stage: some `k` carries a finite-presentation morphism
`X_k ⟶ S_k` and a finitely presented quasi-coherent module `ℱ_k` which is pure along
`(X_k)_{s_k}` and flat over `S_k` at every point of that fibre, with `X = X_k ×_{S_k} S` and `ℱ`
the pullback of `ℱ_k`.

The descent of the morphism, of the module and of the flatness over the open locus where it
holds — Stacks Limits 01ZM, 01ZR, 01Z4 and 05LY — is
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_stage_isFlatOverAt_fiber_of_isLimit`; the passage of purity to a finite
stage, which is the rest of the proof of the source, is
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_stage_isPureAlong`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_stage_isPureAlong_of_isLimit_directed {I : Type u} [Preorder I]
    [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I] (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ k : Iᵒᵖ, IsAffine (D.obj k)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ c.pt)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] [F.IsQuasicoherent] (s : c.pt)
    (hpure : IsPureAlong ({ S := c.pt, X := X, f := f, F := F, s := s } : PrePureSituation.{u}))
    (hflat : ∀ x : f.fiber s,
      IsFlatOverAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom F (f.fiberι s x)) :
    ∃ (k : I) (Xk : Scheme.{u}) (fk : Xk ⟶ D.obj (op k))
      (_ : LocallyOfFinitePresentation fk) (_ : QuasiCompact fk) (_ : QuasiSeparated fk)
      (Fk : Xk.Modules) (_ : Fk.IsQuasicoherent) (_ : Fk.IsFinitePresentation)
      (_ : Fk.IsFiniteType) (a : X ⟶ Xk),
      IsPullback a f fk (c.π.app (op k)) ∧ Nonempty (F ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback a).obj Fk) ∧
        (∀ x : fk.fiber (c.π.app (op k) s),
          IsFlatOverAt fk.toLRSHom.toShHom Fk (fk.fiberι (c.π.app (op k) s) x)) ∧
        IsPureAlong ({ S := D.obj (op k), X := Xk, f := fk, F := Fk,
                       s := c.π.app (op k) s } : PrePureSituation.{u})

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isOpen_setOf_isPureAlong
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05MC.** For a morphism `f : X ⟶ S` of finite presentation and a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module `ℱ` of finite presentation which is flat over `S`, the set of points
`s ∈ S` at which `ℱ` is pure along the fibre `X_s` is open in `S`.

The local constructibility of the fibrewise containment locus, Tag 05KR, which the argument
applies to the base change of `f`, is proved outright in this library.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isOpen_setOf_isPureAlong
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation] [F.IsFiniteType]
    (hflat : ∀ x : X, IsFlatOverAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom F x) :
    IsOpen {s : S | IsPureAlong ({ S := S, X := X, f := f, F := F,
                                   s := s } : PrePureSituation.{u})}
declarations.comment: using Stacks 05KR, proved outright in this library

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallyProjective_pushforward_iff_isPureRelative
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05MD**, the scheme form. For an affine morphism of finite presentation
and a quasi-coherent module of finite presentation which is flat over the base, the direct image
is locally projective exactly when the module is pure relative to the base.

The implication from local projectivity to purity is
`AlgebraicGeometry.isPureRelative_of_isLocallyProjective_pushforward`, which needs neither
flatness nor finite presentation; the converse is
`AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallyProjective_pushforward_of_isPureRelative`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyProjective_pushforward_iff_isPureRelative {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [IsAffineHom f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hflat : IsFlatOver f.toLRSHom.toShHom F) :
    letI : F.IsFiniteType := SheafOfModules.instIsFiniteTypeOfIsFinitePresentation F
    Scheme.Modules.IsLocallyProjective ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) ↔
      IsPureRelative f F
declarations.comment: the scheme criterion, as a biconditional

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.projective_iff_isPureRelative_tilde
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05MD**, the ring form. Let `A → B` be of finite presentation and let `N`
be a finitely presented `B`-module which is flat over `A`. Then `N` is projective over `A` exactly
when the sheaf `Ñ` on `Spec B` is pure relative to `Spec A`.

Both directions come from the scheme form applied to `Spec B ⟶ Spec A`: the direct image of `Ñ`
is the sheaf associated to `N` viewed as an `A`-module (Tag 01I9,
`AlgebraicGeometry.pushforwardTildeIso`), so local projectivity of the direct image is
projectivity of that `A`-module by Tag 05JQ
(`AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallyProjective_tilde_iff_projective`).
declarations.statement:
theorem projective_iff_isPureRelative_tilde (A B N : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra A B] [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] [Module B N] [IsScalarTower A B N]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation A B] [Module.FinitePresentation B N] [Module.Flat A N] :
    Module.Projective A N ↔
      IsPureRelative (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)))
        (tilde (ModuleCat.of (CommRingCat.of B) N))
declarations.comment: the affine ring specialization, as a biconditional

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPureRelative_of_isLocallyProjective_pushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05MD**, the implication from (1) to (2). For an affine morphism of
finite type, a finite type quasi-coherent module whose direct image is locally projective on the
base is pure relative to the base.

This implication of Tag 05MD assumes neither flatness over the base nor finite presentation,
which the statement of that tag assumes for the converse: it is Tag 05K6, whose conclusion is
universal purity relative to the base, followed by the fact that universal purity along a fibre
is purity along it with the étale and elementary hypotheses on the base change dropped.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPureRelative_of_isLocallyProjective_pushforward
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsAffineHom f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFiniteType] [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hF : Scheme.Modules.IsLocallyProjective ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)) :
    IsPureRelative f F
declarations.comment:
the implication from local projectivity of the direct image to relative purity,
in the scheme form

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPureRelative_tilde_of_projective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05MD**, the ring specialization of the implication from (1) to (2).
Let `A → B` be a ring map of finite presentation and let `N` be a finitely presented
`B`-module. If `N` is projective as an `A`-module, then the sheaf `Ñ` on `Spec B` is pure
relative to `Spec A`.

As in the scheme form, flatness of `N` over `A` — which the statement of Tag 05MD assumes for
the converse — is not needed for this implication. The direct image of `Ñ` along
`Spec B ⟶ Spec A` is the sheaf associated to `N` viewed as an `A`-module, by Tag 01I9, so local
projectivity of the direct image is projectivity of that `A`-module by Tag 05JQ.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPureRelative_tilde_of_projective
    (A B N : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] [Module B N] [IsScalarTower A B N]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation A B] [Module.FinitePresentation B N]
    (hproj : Module.Projective A N) :
    IsPureRelative (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)))
      (tilde (ModuleCat.of (CommRingCat.of B) N))
declarations.comment:
the implication from projectivity to relative purity, in the ring form of the
final assertion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_affineOpen_projective_sections_of_chart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05ME.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally of finite presentation, let `F` be a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module of finite presentation, and let `x ∈ X` lie over `s ∈ S` with `F` flat
over `S` at `x`. Then there are an affine elementary étale neighbourhood `(S', s') ⟶ (S, s)` and
an affine open `U' ⊆ X ×_S S'` containing `x' = (x, s')` such that `Γ(U', F|_{U'})` is a
projective `Γ(S', 𝒪_{S'})`-module.

The chart whose name this declaration carries is the one of Tag 05KW, built inside
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_openImmersion_projective_sections_of_affine` after `X` has been shrunk
twice: by openness of the flat locus, Tag 0399 (`AlgebraicGeometry.isOpen_setOf_flatOverAt`), and
by finiteness of the associated points of the fibre, Tag 05AF
(`AlgebraicGeometry.associatedPoints_inter_finite`), which removes the ones not generalizing `x`.
The affine open produced over the shrunken `X` is transported to `X ×_S S'` along the resulting
open immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_affineOpen_projective_sections_of_chart
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (s : S) (x : X) (hxs : f x = s) (hflat : IsFlatOverAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom F x) :
    ∃ (N : EtaleNeighborhood S s) (_ : N.IsElementary) (_ : IsAffine N.scheme)
      (x' : (pullback f N.toBase : Scheme.{u}))
      (_ : pullback.fst f N.toBase x' = x)
      (_ : pullback.snd f N.toBase x' = N.point)
      (U' : (pullback f N.toBase : Scheme.{u}).Opens)
      (_ : IsAffineOpen U') (_ : x' ∈ U'),
      let G := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst f N.toBase)).obj F
      letI : Module Γ(N.scheme, ⊤) Γ(G, U') :=
        Module.compHom Γ(G, U') ((pullback.snd f N.toBase).appLE ⊤ U' (by simp)).hom
      Module.Projective Γ(N.scheme, ⊤) Γ(G, U')

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood_free_sections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05MF.** A finite-type quasi-coherent module which is flat over the base
at a point has free sections on an affine neighbourhood of the lifted point after base change to
the local scheme of an affine elementary étale neighbourhood.

The obligation `hproj` is Lemma 05ME composed with Proposition 05I5: the same existential with
`Module.Projective` in place of `Module.Free`, and with nothing asserted about the image of `x'`
in `Spec 𝒪_{S', s'}`. Projectivity becomes freeness by Kaplansky's theorem (Tag 0593), and the
image of `x'` is the distinguished point automatically, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.EtaleNeighborhood.fromSpecStalk_snd_eq_point`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood_free_sections
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFiniteType] (x : X)
    (hflat : IsFlatOverAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom F x)
    (hproj : IsFlatOverAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom F x →
      ∃ (N : EtaleNeighborhood S (f x)),
        N.IsElementary ∧ IsAffine N.scheme ∧
          let g := N.scheme.fromSpecStalk N.point ≫ N.toBase
          let P := pullback f g
          ∃ (x' : P) (W : P.Opens),
            pullback.fst f g x' = x ∧
              IsAffineOpen W ∧ x' ∈ W ∧
                let F' := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F
                letI : Module (N.scheme.presheaf.stalk N.point) Γ(F', W) :=
                  Module.compHom Γ(F', W)
                    (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (N.scheme.presheaf.stalk N.point))).inv ≫
                      (pullback.snd f g).appLE ⊤ W (by simp)).hom)
                Module.Projective (N.scheme.presheaf.stalk N.point) Γ(F', W)) :
    ∃ (N : EtaleNeighborhood S (f x)),
      N.IsElementary ∧ IsAffine N.scheme ∧
        let g := N.scheme.fromSpecStalk N.point ≫ N.toBase
        let P := pullback f g
        ∃ (x' : P) (W : P.Opens),
          pullback.fst f g x' = x ∧
            N.scheme.fromSpecStalk N.point (pullback.snd f g x') = N.point ∧
            IsAffineOpen W ∧ x' ∈ W ∧
              let F' := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F
              letI : Module (N.scheme.presheaf.stalk N.point) Γ(F', W) :=
                Module.compHom Γ(F', W)
                  (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (N.scheme.presheaf.stalk N.point))).inv ≫
                    (pullback.snd f g).appLE ⊤ W (by simp)).hom)
              Module.Free (N.scheme.presheaf.stalk N.point) Γ(F', W)
declarations.comment:
RESTRICTED: carries hproj, this same existential with Module.Projective in place of
Module.Free and the clause on the image of x' in Spec 𝒪_{S', s'} dropped, which is the 05ME half
of the source's proof (Lemma 05ME composed with Proposition 05I5)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood_free_sections_of_finitePresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05MF** for a morphism locally of finite presentation and a module of
finite presentation, with no hypothesis beyond flatness at the point.

Under those hypotheses the obligation `hproj` of
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood_free_sections` is Lemma 05ME base changed to
the local scheme of the neighbourhood it produces, which is
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_affineOpen_projective_sections_stalk`. The source states Tag 05MF for
`f` locally of finite *type* and `F` of finite type, and reaches the hypotheses used here by a
closed immersion into affine space and by Proposition 05I5; those two reductions are what the
general statement still waits on.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood_free_sections_of_finitePresentation
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation] (x : X)
    (hflat : IsFlatOverAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom F x) :
    ∃ (N : EtaleNeighborhood S (f x)),
      N.IsElementary ∧ IsAffine N.scheme ∧
        let g := N.scheme.fromSpecStalk N.point ≫ N.toBase
        let P := pullback f g
        ∃ (x' : P) (W : P.Opens),
          pullback.fst f g x' = x ∧
            N.scheme.fromSpecStalk N.point (pullback.snd f g x') = N.point ∧
            IsAffineOpen W ∧ x' ∈ W ∧
              let F' := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F
              letI : Module (N.scheme.presheaf.stalk N.point) Γ(F', W) :=
                Module.compHom Γ(F', W)
                  (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (N.scheme.presheaf.stalk N.point))).inv ≫
                    (pullback.snd f g).appLE ⊤ W (by simp)).hom)
              Module.Free (N.scheme.presheaf.stalk N.point) Γ(F', W)
declarations.comment: for f locally of finite presentation and F of finite presentation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood_free_sections_of_finiteType
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05MF.** A finite-type quasi-coherent module which is flat over the
base at a point has free sections on an affine neighbourhood of the lifted point after base
change to the local scheme of an affine elementary étale neighbourhood.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood_free_sections_of_finiteType
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFiniteType] (x : X)
    (hflat : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOverAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom F x) :
    ∃ (N : AlgebraicGeometry.EtaleNeighborhood S (f x)),
      N.IsElementary ∧ IsAffine N.scheme ∧
        let g := N.scheme.fromSpecStalk N.point ≫ N.toBase
        let P := pullback f g
        ∃ (x' : P) (W : P.Opens),
          pullback.fst f g x' = x ∧
            N.scheme.fromSpecStalk N.point (pullback.snd f g x') = N.point ∧
            IsAffineOpen W ∧ x' ∈ W ∧
              let F' := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F
              letI : Module (N.scheme.presheaf.stalk N.point) Γ(F', W) :=
                Module.compHom Γ(F', W)
                  (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (N.scheme.presheaf.stalk N.point))).inv ≫
                    (pullback.snd f g).appLE ⊤ W (by simp)).hom)
              Module.Free (N.scheme.presheaf.stalk N.point) Γ(F', W)

transition morphism of base changes is then flat, so pulling back along it preserves
monomorphisms, and the comparison isomorphism carries the base-changed homomorphism over `T`
to the one over `T'`.
