declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_baseAssociatedModule_iff
declarations.doc:
**Descent, Lemma 05VG for Modules on Sites, Definition 03DL (2), on the big site, as an
equivalence.**  A quasi-coherent `𝒪_S`-module `𝓗` is finite locally free on the small Zariski
site of `S` if and only if `𝓗ᵃ` is finite locally free as an `𝒪`-module on `(Sch/S)_τ`, for
every `τ ∈ {Zariski, étale, smooth, syntomic, fppf}`.

The `only if` half is
`BigFppfOver.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_baseAssociatedModule_of_isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite`,
valid at every `τ`.  The `if` half is proved at `τ = fppf` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_of_associatedModule`, and carried to the
four coarser topologies by the monotonicity
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_of_comparisonPushforward` through the key to
Stacks 0GNE, `AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.restrictTopologyAssociatedModuleIso`, which exhibits
`𝓗ᵃ` on `(Sch/S)_τ` as `𝓗ᵃ` on `(Sch/S)_fppf` read for the coarser topology.

This is clause 03DL (2) of 05VG at the **big** site `(Sch/S)_τ`, at every `τ`; the small sites
`S_τ` for `τ ∈ {Zariski, étale}`, which Stacks 03DU (4) also treats, are not covered.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_baseAssociatedModule_iff (τ : SiteKind) (𝓗 : S.Modules)
    [h𝓗 : 𝓗.IsQuasicoherent] :
    SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite (R := S.ringCatSheaf) 𝓗 ↔
      SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite ((baseAssociatedModule B S hS τ).obj 𝓗)
declarations.comment: finite locally free (03DL (2)), big site (Sch/S)_τ at every τ, at the comparison functor of 03DX itself

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isFinitePresentation_baseAssociatedModule_iff
declarations.doc:
**Descent, Lemma 05VG for Modules on Sites, Definition 03DL (7), on the big site, as an
equivalence.**  A quasi-coherent `𝒪_S`-module `𝓗` is of finite presentation on the small Zariski
site of `S` if and only if `𝓗ᵃ` is of finite presentation as an `𝒪`-module on `(Sch/S)_τ`, for
every `τ ∈ {Zariski, étale, smooth, syntomic, fppf}`.

The forward half is
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isFinitePresentation_baseAssociatedModule_of_isFinitePresentation`,
proved at every `τ` and needing no quasi-coherence.  The reverse half is proved at `τ = fppf` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isFinitePresentation_of_associatedModule`, and carried to the four
coarser topologies by the monotonicity
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation_of_comparisonPushforward` through the key to
Stacks 0GNE, `AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.restrictTopologyAssociatedModuleIso`, which exhibits
`𝓗ᵃ` on `(Sch/S)_τ` as `𝓗ᵃ` on `(Sch/S)_fppf` read for the coarser topology.

The clause string records the scope: this is clause 03DL (7) of 05VG, at the **big** site
`(Sch/S)_τ` and at every `τ`.  The small sites are
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isFinitePresentation_associatedModule_iff` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallZariski.isFinitePresentation_iff_associatedModule`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isFinitePresentation_baseAssociatedModule_iff (τ : SiteKind) (𝓗 : S.Modules)
    [h𝓗 : 𝓗.IsQuasicoherent] :
    SheafOfModules.IsFinitePresentation (R := S.ringCatSheaf) 𝓗 ↔
      ((baseAssociatedModule B S hS τ).obj 𝓗).IsFinitePresentation
declarations.comment: finite presentation (03DL (7)), big site (Sch/S)_τ at every τ, at the comparison functor of 03DX itself

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isLocallyGeneratedByOnSite_baseAssociatedModule_iff
declarations.doc:
**Descent, Lemma 05VG for Modules on Sites, Definition 03DL (4), on the big site, as an
equivalence.**  A quasi-coherent `𝒪_S`-module `𝓗` is locally generated by `r` sections on the
small Zariski site of `S` if and only if `𝓗^a` is locally generated by `r` sections as an
`𝒪`-module on `(Sch/S)_τ`, for every `τ ∈ {Zariski, étale, smooth, syntomic, fppf}`.

The `only if` half is
`BigFppfOver.isLocallyGeneratedByOnSite_baseAssociatedModule_of_isLocallyGeneratedByOnSite`,
proved at every `τ` and needing no quasi-coherence.  The `if` half is proved at `τ = fppf` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isLocallyGeneratedByOnSite_of_associatedModule`, and carried to the
four coarser topologies by the monotonicity
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.isLocallyGeneratedByOnSite_of_comparisonPushforward` through the key to
Stacks 0GNE, `AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.restrictTopologyAssociatedModuleIso`, which exhibits
`𝓗^a` on `(Sch/S)_τ` as `𝓗^a` on `(Sch/S)_fppf` read for the coarser topology.  Quasi-coherence
is used by that half alone, and it is the hypothesis the source's clause carries.

The clause string records the scope: this is clause 03DL (4) of 05VG, at the **big** site
`(Sch/S)_τ` and at every `τ`.  The small sites are
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isLocallyGeneratedByOnSite_associatedModule_iff` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallZariski.isLocallyGeneratedByOnSite_iff_associatedModule`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isLocallyGeneratedByOnSite_baseAssociatedModule_iff (τ : SiteKind)
    (𝓗 : S.Modules) [h𝓗 : 𝓗.IsQuasicoherent] (r : ℕ) :
    SheafOfModules.IsLocallyGeneratedByOnSite (R := S.ringCatSheaf) 𝓗 r ↔
      SheafOfModules.IsLocallyGeneratedByOnSite ((baseAssociatedModule B S hS τ).obj 𝓗) r
declarations.comment: locally generated by r sections (03DL (4)), big site (Sch/S)_τ at every τ, at the comparison functor of 03DX itself

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isFiniteType_baseAssociatedModule_iff
declarations.doc:
**Descent, Lemma 05VG for Modules on Sites, Definition 03DL (5), on the big site, as an
equivalence.**  A quasi-coherent `𝒪_S`-module `𝓗` is of finite type if and only if `𝓗^a` is of
finite type as an `𝒪`-module on `(Sch/S)_τ`, for every
`τ ∈ {Zariski, étale, smooth, syntomic, fppf}`.

The `only if` half is
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isFiniteType_baseAssociatedModule_of_isFiniteType`, proved at every
`τ` and needing no quasi-coherence.  The `if` half is proved at `τ = fppf` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isFiniteType_of_associatedModule`, and carried to the four coarser
topologies by the monotonicity
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.isFiniteType_of_comparisonPushforward` through
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.restrictTopologyAssociatedModuleIso`.  Quasi-coherence is used by
that half alone, and it is the hypothesis the source's clause carries.

The clause string records the scope: this is clause 03DL (5) of 05VG, at the **big** site
`(Sch/S)_τ` and at every `τ`.  The small sites are
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isFiniteType_associatedModule_iff` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallZariski.isFiniteType_iff_associatedModule`, both of which hold without
quasi-coherence; at the big site the descent is fpqc descent of finite type, Stacks 05AZ, which
is stated for a quasi-coherent module.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isFiniteType_baseAssociatedModule_iff (τ : SiteKind) (𝓗 : S.Modules)
    [h𝓗 : 𝓗.IsQuasicoherent] :
    SheafOfModules.IsFiniteType (R := S.ringCatSheaf) 𝓗 ↔
      SheafOfModules.IsFiniteType ((baseAssociatedModule B S hS τ).obj 𝓗)
declarations.comment: finite type (03DL (5)), big site (Sch/S)_τ at every τ, at the comparison functor of 03DX itself

registrations.comment: finite type; local properties, with the comparison of 03DX carried as an equivalence of ringed topoi rather than of quasi-coherent modules alone

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.universallyInjective_unramified_tfae
declarations.doc:
The equivalent characterizations of an unramified universally injective morphism of
schemes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem universallyInjective_unramified_tfae {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) :
    List.TFAE
      [ Unramified f ∧ Mono f,
        Unramified f ∧ UniversallyInjective f,
        LocallyOfFiniteType f ∧ Mono f,
        UniversallyInjective f ∧
          (LocallyOfFiniteType f ∧ FormallyUnramified f),
        LocallyOfFiniteType f ∧
          ∀ s : S, IsEmpty (f.fiber s) ∨ IsIso (f.fiberToSpecResidueField s) ]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isOpen_setOf_isFlatOverAt_of_locallyOfFiniteType
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05VJ (open locus).** For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of schemes over a base
with `X` locally of finite presentation over the base and `Y` locally of finite type over it, the
locus where a finitely presented quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module is flat over `Y` is open, because `f`
is then itself locally of finite presentation.
declarations.comment: open locus

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.setOf_isFlatOverAt_modulePullback_of_isFlatOver
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05VJ (base change).** For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of schemes over a base
`S` with `X` locally of finite presentation over `S` and `Y` locally of finite type over `S`, and
a finitely presented quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module flat over `S`, the locus where the module is flat
over `Y` commutes with an arbitrary base change `S' ⟶ S`: the corresponding locus upstairs is the
preimage of the original one.
declarations.comment: base change

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isOpen_setOf_isFlatAt_of_locallyOfFinitePresentation_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05VK (open locus).** For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of schemes over a base
with `X` locally of finite presentation over the base and `Y` locally of finite type over it, the
locus of points of `X` at which `f` is flat is open.

Flatness of `X` over the base, which the source assumes, is not needed here: the two finiteness
hypotheses already make `f` locally of finite presentation, so Tag 0399 applies to `f` itself.
declarations.comment: open locus

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.setOf_isFlatAt_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05VK (base change).** For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of schemes over a base
`S` with `X` locally of finite presentation and flat over `S` and `Y` locally of finite type over
`S`, the locus of points at which `f` is flat commutes with an arbitrary base change `S' ⟶ S`:
the corresponding locus upstairs is the preimage of the original one.
declarations.comment: base change

declarations.name: flat_tfae_henselization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05VL, conditions (1)--(3).** A module over a henselization with
extended residue field is flat over the original local ring if and only if it is flat over the
henselization with unchanged residue field, if and only if it is flat over the
extended-residue-field henselization. A strict henselization is the case where `K` is a separable
closure of the residue field.
declarations.statement:
theorem flat_tfae_henselization {Msh : Type y} [AddCommGroup Msh] [Module Rsh Msh] :
    letI : Module Rh Msh := Module.compHom Msh (algebraMap Rh Rsh)
    letI : Module R Msh := Module.compHom Msh (algebraMap R Rsh)
    List.TFAE [Module.Flat R Msh, Module.Flat Rh Msh, Module.Flat Rsh Msh]
declarations.comment: conditions (1)--(3)

declarations.name: flat_tfae_baseChange_henselization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05VL, conditions (1)--(5).** If the module over the
extended-residue-field henselization is obtained from an `Rh`-module by extension of scalars, its
three flatness conditions are also equivalent to flatness of the original module over `R` and
over `Rh`.
declarations.statement:
theorem flat_tfae_baseChange_henselization {Mh : Type y} [AddCommGroup Mh] [Module Rh Mh] :
    letI : Module R Mh := Module.compHom Mh (algebraMap R Rh)
    letI : Module Rsh (Rsh ⊗[Rh] Mh) := TensorProduct.leftModule
    letI : Module Rh (Rsh ⊗[Rh] Mh) := Module.compHom (Rsh ⊗[Rh] Mh) (algebraMap Rh Rsh)
    letI : Module R (Rsh ⊗[Rh] Mh) := Module.compHom (Rsh ⊗[Rh] Mh) (algebraMap R Rsh)
    List.TFAE [Module.Flat R (Rsh ⊗[Rh] Mh), Module.Flat Rh (Rsh ⊗[Rh] Mh),
      Module.Flat Rsh (Rsh ⊗[Rh] Mh), Module.Flat R Mh, Module.Flat Rh Mh]
declarations.comment: conditions (1)--(5)

declarations.name: flat_tfae_iteratedBaseChange_henselization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05VL, conditions (1)--(6).** If the `Rh`-module is in turn obtained from
an `R`-module by extension of scalars, all five flatness conditions after base change are
equivalent to flatness of the original module over `R`.
declarations.statement:
theorem flat_tfae_iteratedBaseChange_henselization {M : Type y} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] :
    letI : Module Rh (Rh ⊗[R] M) := TensorProduct.leftModule
    letI : Module R (Rh ⊗[R] M) := Module.compHom (Rh ⊗[R] M) (algebraMap R Rh)
    letI : Module Rsh (Rsh ⊗[Rh] (Rh ⊗[R] M)) := TensorProduct.leftModule
    letI : Module Rh (Rsh ⊗[Rh] (Rh ⊗[R] M)) :=
      Module.compHom (Rsh ⊗[Rh] (Rh ⊗[R] M)) (algebraMap Rh Rsh)
    letI : Module R (Rsh ⊗[Rh] (Rh ⊗[R] M)) :=
      Module.compHom (Rsh ⊗[Rh] (Rh ⊗[R] M)) (algebraMap R Rsh)
    List.TFAE [Module.Flat R (Rsh ⊗[Rh] (Rh ⊗[R] M)), Module.Flat Rh (Rsh ⊗[Rh] (Rh ⊗[R] M)),
      Module.Flat Rsh (Rsh ⊗[Rh] (Rh ⊗[R] M)), Module.Flat R (Rh ⊗[R] M),
      Module.Flat Rh (Rh ⊗[R] M), Module.Flat R M]
declarations.comment: conditions (1)--(6)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallySurjective_of_representable_flat_locallyOfFinitePresentation_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 05VM.** A representable map of sheaves whose scheme-valued base
changes are surjective, flat, and locally of finite presentation is locally surjective for the
fppf topology.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallySurjective_of_representable_flat_locallyOfFinitePresentation_surjective
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {F G : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Type u)} (a : F ⟶ G)
    (ha : (MorphismProperty.presheaf
      (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        ((fun _ _ f => Flat f ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation f ∧ Surjective f) :
          MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) a.hom) :
    Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective a

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_geometricPoint_lift_of_isEtale
declarations.doc:
A geometric point lifts along an étale morphism of algebraic spaces to any
specified point of the source above its image, without extending its field.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_geometricPoint_lift_of_isEtale
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {U X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hU : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS U)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (φ : U ⟶ X) (hφ : IsEtale B S hS φ)
    (xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS X)
    (u : points B S hS U)
    (hu : pointsMap B S hS U φ u = xbar.image) :
    ∃ ubar : GeometricPoint B S hS U,
      ubar.LiesOver u ∧
        FieldValuedPoint.map B S hS U φ ubar.val = xbar.val

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartLocalRingToEtaleLocalRing_germ_open
declarations.doc:
**The comparison map `𝒪_{U, u} → 𝒪_{X, x̄}` on germs of functions on an open of the
chart.**  The ordinary germ at `u` of a regular function on a Zariski open `W ∋ u` of the chart
is sent to the germ at `x̄` of the same function, read on the small étale neighbourhood
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartOpenNeighborhood` given by `W`.  This extends
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartLocalRingToEtaleLocalRing_germ`, which is the case `W = ⊤`.
declarations.statement:
theorem chartLocalRingToEtaleLocalRing_germ_open {x : GeometricPoint B S hS X}
    (V : SmallEtaleNeighborhood x) (W : (chartScheme V.chart).Opens)
    (hw : chartPoint B S hS X V ∈ W) (a : Γ(chartScheme V.chart, W)) :
    chartLocalRingToEtaleLocalRing B S hS X hX V
        ((chartScheme V.chart).presheaf.germ W (chartPoint B S hS X V) hw a) =
      etaleLocalRingGerm B S hS X x (op (chartOpenNeighborhood B S hS V W hw))
        (W.topIso.inv a)
declarations.comment: the comparison map on germs of functions on an open of the chart

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartLocalRingToEtaleLocalRing_germ_open'
declarations.doc:
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartLocalRingToEtaleLocalRing_germ_open` with the restricted
function written through `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartRestrictionRingHom`, the form in which
the sections of a module on the algebraic space carry their scalars over an open of the
chart.
declarations.statement:
theorem chartLocalRingToEtaleLocalRing_germ_open' {x : GeometricPoint B S hS X}
    (V : SmallEtaleNeighborhood x) (W : (chartScheme V.chart).Opens)
    (hw : chartPoint B S hS X V ∈ W) (a : Γ(chartScheme V.chart, W)) :
    chartLocalRingToEtaleLocalRing B S hS X hX V
        ((chartScheme V.chart).presheaf.germ W (chartPoint B S hS X V) hw a) =
      etaleLocalRingGerm B S hS X x (op (chartOpenNeighborhood B S hS V W hw))
        (((chartRestrictionRingHom B S hS hX V.chart).app (op W)).hom a)
declarations.comment: the comparison map on germs, through the chart restriction of functions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartStalkTensorComparison
declarations.doc:
The comparison map from the Zariski stalk `(φ^* F)_u` of the restriction of an `𝒪_X`-module
to an étale scheme chart, base changed along the canonical map `𝒪_{U, u} → 𝒪_{X, x̄}`, to the
stalk `F_{x̄}` of `F` at the geometric point.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def chartStalkTensorComparison {x : GeometricPoint B S hS X}
    (V : SmallEtaleNeighborhood x) (F : Modules.{u, m} B S hS X hX) :
    chartStalkTensorEtaleLocalRing B S hS X hX V F ⟶
      geometricModuleStalk B S hS ⟨X, hX⟩ x F
declarations.comment: the comparison map (phi^* F)_u tensor O_{U, u} O_{X, xbar} to F_xbar

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartStalkTensorComparison_germ
declarations.doc:
The comparison map `(φ^* F)_u ⊗_{𝒪_{U, u}} 𝒪_{X, x̄} → F_{x̄}` sends the base change of the
Zariski germ at `u` of a section of `F` over a Zariski open `W` of the chart containing `u` to the
germ at `x̄` of the same section, read on the small étale neighbourhood `W`.
declarations.statement:
theorem chartStalkTensorComparison_germ {x : GeometricPoint B S hS X}
    (V : SmallEtaleNeighborhood x) (F : Modules.{u, m} B S hS X hX)
    (W : (etaleChartScheme B S hS V.chart).Opens) (hw : chartPoint B S hS X V ∈ W)
    (s : F.val.obj (op ((chartOpens B S hS V.chart).obj W))) :
    chartStalkTensorComparison B S hS hX V F
        ((1 : ↥(etaleLocalRing B S hS X x)) ⊗ₜ[↥(chartLocalRing B S hS X V),
            chartLocalRingToEtaleLocalRing B S hS X hX V]
          chartZariskiSectionGerm B S hS hX V F W hw s :
          chartStalkTensorEtaleLocalRing B S hS X hX V F) =
      geometricModuleStalkGerm B S hS ⟨X, hX⟩ x F
        (chartOpenNeighborhood B S hS V W hw) s
declarations.comment: the comparison map is the identity on germs of sections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_chartStalkTensorComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05VP.**  Let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module on an algebraic space `X`, let
`x̄` be a geometric point of `X` and let `φ : (U, ū) → (X, x̄)` be an étale neighbourhood whose
chart `U` is a scheme.  Then the canonical comparison map

`(φ^* F)_u ⊗_{𝒪_{U, u}} 𝒪_{X, x̄} → F_{x̄}`

is an isomorphism.

The hypothesis of quasi-coherence is necessary: for a general `𝒪_X`-module the comparison map
is not even surjective.  The statement is at module universe `m = u`, that is for
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.Modules.{u, u}`, which is where the cartesian criterion of Stacks
03DX(2) that quasi-coherence is used through is available.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_chartStalkTensorComparison {x : GeometricPoint B S hS X}
    (V : SmallEtaleNeighborhood x) (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X hX)
    [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] :
    IsIso (chartStalkTensorComparison B S hS hX V F)
declarations.comment: the comparison map is an isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.surjective_chartStalkTensorComparison
declarations.doc:
**The comparison map of Stacks 05VP is surjective for a quasi-coherent module.**  Every germ
at the geometric point of a section of a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module is the image of a base
changed Zariski germ on the chart.

Quasi-coherence is required: it enters through Stacks 03DX(2), which writes a section over a
small affine étale neighbourhood as a sum of multiples of restrictions of sections over a fixed
affine neighbourhood of the point.
declarations.statement:
theorem surjective_chartStalkTensorComparison {x : GeometricPoint B S hS X}
    (V : SmallEtaleNeighborhood x) (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X hX)
    [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] :
    Function.Surjective (chartStalkTensorComparison B S hS hX V F)
declarations.comment: the comparison map is surjective for a quasi-coherent module

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartLocalRingToEtaleLocalRing
declarations.doc:
The canonical map `𝒪_{U, u} → 𝒪_{X, x̄}` of Stacks 05VP: the structure map of `𝒪_{U, u}`
into its strict henselization, followed by the identification of that strict henselization with
the étale local ring at the geometric point.
declarations.comment: the canonical map O_{U, u} → O_{X, xbar}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartLocalRingToEtaleLocalRing_germ
declarations.doc:
The canonical map `𝒪_{U, u} → 𝒪_{X, x̄}` sends the ordinary germ at `u` of a regular
function on the chart to the germ of the same function at the geometric point.
declarations.statement:
theorem chartLocalRingToEtaleLocalRing_germ {x : GeometricPoint B S hS X}
    (V : SmallEtaleNeighborhood x) (a : Γ(chartScheme V.chart, ⊤)) :
    chartLocalRingToEtaleLocalRing B S hS X hX V
        ((chartScheme V.chart).presheaf.germ ⊤ (chartPoint B S hS X V) trivial a) =
      etaleLocalRingGerm B S hS X x (op V) a
declarations.comment: the comparison map is the identity on germs of regular functions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.faithfullyFlat_chartLocalRingToEtaleLocalRing
declarations.doc:
**The base change of Stacks 05VP is faithfully flat.** The canonical map
`𝒪_{U, u} → 𝒪_{X, x̄}` is faithfully flat: the étale local ring is the strict henselization of
the chart's local ring, and a strict henselization is faithfully flat over the ring it
henselizes.
declarations.comment: the base-change map is faithfully flat

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.flat_chartLocalRingToEtaleLocalRing
declarations.doc:
The canonical map `𝒪_{U, u} → 𝒪_{X, x̄}` is flat, so the base change of Stacks 05VP along
it is exact.
declarations.comment: the base-change map is flat

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartStalkBaseChange
declarations.doc:
The base-change functor `- ⊗_{𝒪_{U, u}} 𝒪_{X, x̄}` of Stacks 05VP, taking a module over the
local ring of the chart to a module over the étale local ring at the geometric point.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def chartStalkBaseChange {x : GeometricPoint B S hS X}
    (V : SmallEtaleNeighborhood x) :
    ModuleCat.{max u m} ↥(chartLocalRing B S hS X V) ⥤
      ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) m} ↥(etaleLocalRing B S hS X x)
declarations.comment: the base-change functor - ⊗_{O_{U, u}} O_{X, xbar}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartZariskiModuleStalk
declarations.doc:
The ordinary (Zariski) stalk `(φ^* F)_u` of the restriction of an `𝒪_X`-module to an étale
scheme chart, as a module over the local ring `𝒪_{U, u}` of the chart.

It is the stalk of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictToChart` at the point
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartZariskiPoint` of the Zariski site of the chart, with its scalars
restricted along `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartZariskiFiberIso`.
declarations.comment: the Zariski stalk of the chart restriction, the left factor of the tensor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartStalkTensorEtaleLocalRing
declarations.doc:
The left-hand side `(φ^* F)_u ⊗_{𝒪_{U, u}} 𝒪_{X, x̄}` of Stacks 05VP: the Zariski stalk of
the chart restriction, base changed along the canonical map to the étale local ring.

Its type is the category in which `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricModuleStalk` also lands, so
the equation of Stacks 05VP relates two objects of one category.
declarations.comment: the left-hand side (phi^* F)_u ⊗_{O_{U, u}} O_{X, xbar}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricModuleStalk
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 05VQ.** The stalk of an `𝒪_X`-module at a geometric point `x̄` of an algebraic
space, as a module over the étale local ring `𝒪_{X, x̄}`: the stalk at the point of the small
étale site determined by `x̄`, with its scalars extended along
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pointStalkRingEquiv`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def geometricModuleStalk (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (x : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1) (F : Modules.{u, m} B S hS X.1 X.2) :
    ModuleCat (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 x)
declarations.comment: the module stalk at a geometric point

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricModuleStalkPullbackIso
declarations.doc:
The stalk at a geometric point `x̄` of the
pullback of an `𝒪_Y`-module `G` along a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces is the base
change of the stalk of `G` at the image point `f ∘ x̄` along the canonical homomorphism
`𝒪_{Y, f ∘ x̄} ⟶ 𝒪_{X, x̄}` of étale local rings of Stacks 04NG:

`(f^*G)_{x̄} ≅ 𝒪_{X, x̄} ⊗_{𝒪_{Y, f ∘ x̄}} G_{f ∘ x̄}`.
declarations.statement:
def geometricModuleStalkPullbackIso :
    geometricModuleStalk B S hS X x ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj G) ≅
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars (etaleLocalRingMap X.2 f.hom x)).obj
        (geometricModuleStalk B S hS Y (geometricPointMap f.hom x) G)
declarations.comment:
the base-change formula `(f^*G)_x̄ ≅ 𝒪_{X, x̄} ⊗_{𝒪_{Y, f ∘ x̄}} G_{f ∘ x̄}` for the
geometric stalk of a pullback of modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFinitePresentationOnSite_iff_isFinitePresentationOnCharts
declarations.doc:
**For a quasi-coherent module, finite presentation on the small étale site is finite
presentation on the étale scheme charts.**  This is the property "of finite presentation" of the
section of Stacks 05VR on properties of modules on an algebraic space: it may be read on the
small étale site, or on every étale scheme chart, where for a quasi-coherent module it is the
property of the corresponding module on the scheme (the scheme case being Stacks 05VG).
declarations.statement:
theorem isFinitePresentationOnSite_iff_isFinitePresentationOnCharts
    (M : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hqc : M.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    SheafOfModules.IsFinitePresentationOnSite M ↔ IsFinitePresentationOnCharts B S hS X.2 M
declarations.comment: of finite presentation: for a quasi-coherent module on an algebraic space, finite presentation on the small etale site is finite presentation of its restriction to every etale scheme chart, read on the Zariski site of the chart (items (2) and (4) of the section)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteTypeOnSite_of_epi
declarations.doc:
**Properties of Spaces, Section 66.30, the finite type clause for a quotient.**  A quotient
of an `𝒪_X`-module of finite type on the small étale site of an algebraic space `X` is again of
finite type.

On each member of a covering witnessing finite type for the source, the restricted epimorphism
composes with the finite coproduct presenting the source to present the target.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteTypeOnSite_of_epi {M N : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X hX} (p : M ⟶ N) [Epi p]
    (hM : SheafOfModules.IsFiniteTypeOnSite M) :
    SheafOfModules.IsFiniteTypeOnSite N
declarations.comment: finite type, quotients

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCoherentOnSite_modulePullback_of_isEtale
declarations.doc:
**The pullback of a coherent module along an étale morphism is coherent.**  For an étale
morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces, the inverse image `f^*M` of Stacks 03LU of a coherent
`𝒪_Y`-module is coherent: it is isomorphic to the étale restriction of `M` (Stacks 03LW), which
is coherent by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCoherentOnSite_etaleModulePullback`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCoherentOnSite_modulePullback_of_isEtale (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsEtale B S hS f.hom)
    (M : Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) (hM : M.IsCoherentOnSite) :
    ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj M).IsCoherentOnSite
declarations.comment: consequence (2), property 'coherent': for an étale morphism f of algebraic spaces, the pullback f^*𝓕 of a coherent module 𝓕 is coherent

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyFreeOnSite_modulePullback
declarations.doc:
**The inverse image of a locally free module is locally free.**  For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y`
of algebraic spaces over `S` and a locally free `𝒪_Y`-module `N` (Stacks 03DL (1)), the inverse
image `f^*N` of Stacks 03LU is locally free.  This is the locally free clause of Stacks 03DO along
the morphism of small étale ringed topoi of `f`, consequence (1) of Stacks 05VR.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyFreeOnSite_modulePullback {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (N : Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) (hN : N.IsLocallyFreeOnSite) :
    ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj N).IsLocallyFreeOnSite
declarations.comment: consequences (1) and (2), property 'locally free': for a morphism f of algebraic spaces, in particular an étale one, the pullback f^*𝓕 of a locally free module is locally free

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite_modulePullback
declarations.doc:
**The inverse image of a module locally generated by sections is locally generated by
sections.**  For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S` and an `𝒪_Y`-module `N`
locally generated by sections (Stacks 03DL (3)), the inverse image `f^*N` of Stacks 03LU is
locally generated by sections.  This is that clause of Stacks 03DO along the morphism of small
étale ringed topoi of `f`, consequence (1) of Stacks 05VR.
declarations.comment: consequences (1) and (2), property 'locally generated by sections': for a morphism f of algebraic spaces, in particular an étale one, the pullback f^*𝓕 of a module locally generated by sections is locally generated by sections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isGeneratedByGlobalSectionsOfCard_modulePullback
declarations.doc:
**Generation by finitely many global sections is preserved by pullback.**  For a morphism
`f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces and an `𝒪_Y`-module `G` generated by finitely many global
sections, `f^*G` is generated by finitely many global sections (Stacks 03DF).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isGeneratedByGlobalSectionsOfCard_modulePullback (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {G : Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2} (hG : ∃ r : ℕ, G.IsGeneratedByGlobalSectionsOfCard r) :
    ∃ r : ℕ, ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj G).IsGeneratedByGlobalSectionsOfCard r
declarations.comment: consequences (1) and (2), property 'generated by finitely many global sections': for a morphism f of algebraic spaces, in particular an étale one, the pullback f^*𝓕 of a module generated by finitely many global sections is generated by finitely many global sections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPresentedByGlobalSections_modulePullback
declarations.doc:
**Having a global presentation is preserved by pullback.**  For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of
algebraic spaces and an `𝒪_Y`-module `G` with a global presentation, `f^*G` has a global
presentation (Stacks 03DF).
declarations.statement:
theorem isPresentedByGlobalSections_modulePullback (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {G : Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2} (hG : G.IsPresentedByGlobalSections) :
    ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj G).IsPresentedByGlobalSections
declarations.comment: consequences (1) and (2), property 'having a global presentation': for a morphism f of algebraic spaces, in particular an étale one, the pullback f^*𝓕 of a module with a global presentation is a module with a global presentation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFinitelyPresentedByGlobalSections_modulePullback
declarations.doc:
**Having a global finite presentation is preserved by pullback.**  For a morphism
`f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces and an `𝒪_Y`-module `G` with a global finite presentation, `f^*G`
has a global finite presentation (Stacks 03DF).
declarations.statement:
theorem isFinitelyPresentedByGlobalSections_modulePullback (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {G : Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2} (hG : G.IsFinitelyPresentedByGlobalSections) :
    ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj G).IsFinitelyPresentedByGlobalSections
declarations.comment: consequences (1) and (2), property 'having a global finite presentation': for a morphism f of algebraic spaces, in particular an étale one, the pullback f^*𝓕 of a module with a global finite presentation is a module with a global finite presentation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyGeneratedByOnSite_modulePullback
declarations.doc:
**Local generation by `r` sections is preserved by pullback.**  For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of
algebraic spaces and an `𝒪_Y`-module `G` locally generated by `r` sections, `f^*G` is locally
generated by `r` sections (Stacks 03DO).
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyGeneratedByOnSite_modulePullback (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (G : Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) (r : ℕ) (hG : G.IsLocallyGeneratedByOnSite r) :
    ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj G).IsLocallyGeneratedByOnSite r
declarations.comment: consequences (1) and (2), property 'locally generated by r sections': for a morphism f of algebraic spaces, in particular an étale one, the pullback f^*𝓕 of a module locally generated by r sections is locally generated by r sections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFlat_modulePullback
declarations.doc:
**Flatness is preserved by pullback.**  For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces and a
flat `𝒪_Y`-module `G`, the inverse image `f^*G` is a flat `𝒪_X`-module (Stacks 05VD).
declarations.comment: consequences (1) and (2), property 'flat': for a morphism f of algebraic spaces, in particular an étale one, the pullback f^*𝓕 of a flat module is flat

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyFreeOnSite_of_modulePullback_of_isSurjective
declarations.doc:
**Local freeness descends along a surjective étale morphism** (Stacks 05VR, with Stacks 03DN):
if the inverse image `f^*M` along an étale morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` surjective on points is locally
free, so is `M`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyFreeOnSite_of_modulePullback_of_isSurjective (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsEtale B S hS f.hom) (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f.hom)
    (M : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (h : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOnSite ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj M)) :
    SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOnSite M
declarations.comment: consequence (3), property 'locally free': for a surjective étale morphism f : Y → X of algebraic spaces and a module 𝓕 on X, if f^*𝓕 is locally free then 𝓕 is locally free

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_of_modulePullback_of_isSurjective
declarations.doc:
**Finite local freeness descends along a surjective étale morphism** (Stacks 05VR, with
Stacks 03DN): if the inverse image `f^*M` along an étale morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` surjective on
points is finite locally free, so is `M`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_of_modulePullback_of_isSurjective (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsEtale B S hS f.hom) (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f.hom)
    (M : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (h : SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj M)) :
    SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite M
declarations.comment: consequence (3), property 'finite locally free': for a surjective étale morphism f : Y → X of algebraic spaces and a module 𝓕 on X, if f^*𝓕 is finite locally free then 𝓕 is finite locally free

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite_of_modulePullback_of_isSurjective
declarations.doc:
**Local generation by sections descends along a surjective étale morphism** (Stacks 05VR,
with Stacks 03DN): if the inverse image `f^*M` along an étale morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` surjective on
points is locally generated by sections, so is `M`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite_of_modulePullback_of_isSurjective (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsEtale B S hS f.hom) (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f.hom)
    (M : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (h : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj M)) :
    SheafOfModules.IsLocallyGeneratedBySectionsOnSite M
declarations.comment: consequence (3), property 'locally generated by sections': for a surjective étale morphism f : Y → X of algebraic spaces and a module 𝓕 on X, if f^*𝓕 is locally generated by sections then 𝓕 is locally generated by sections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyGeneratedByOnSite_of_modulePullback_of_isSurjective
declarations.doc:
**Local generation by `r` sections descends along a surjective étale morphism** (Stacks 05VR,
with Stacks 03DN): if the inverse image `f^*M` along an étale morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` surjective on
points is locally generated by `r` sections, so is `M`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyGeneratedByOnSite_of_modulePullback_of_isSurjective (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsEtale B S hS f.hom) (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f.hom)
    (M : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (r : ℕ)
    (h : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyGeneratedByOnSite ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj M) r) :
    SheafOfModules.IsLocallyGeneratedByOnSite M r
declarations.comment: consequence (3), property 'locally generated by r sections': for a surjective étale morphism f : Y → X of algebraic spaces and a module 𝓕 on X, if f^*𝓕 is locally generated by r sections then 𝓕 is locally generated by r sections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteTypeOnSite_of_modulePullback_of_isSurjective
declarations.doc:
**Finite type descends along a surjective étale morphism** (Stacks 05VR, with Stacks 03DN):
if the inverse image `f^*M` along an étale morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` surjective on points is of
finite type, so is `M`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteTypeOnSite_of_modulePullback_of_isSurjective (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsEtale B S hS f.hom) (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f.hom)
    (M : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (h : ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj M).IsFiniteTypeOnSite) :
    M.IsFiniteTypeOnSite
declarations.comment: consequence (3), property 'of finite type': for a surjective étale morphism f : Y → X of algebraic spaces and a module 𝓕 on X, if f^*𝓕 is of finite type then 𝓕 is of finite type

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasicoherentOnSite_of_modulePullback_of_isSurjective
declarations.doc:
**Quasi-coherence descends along a surjective étale morphism** (Stacks 05VR, with
Stacks 03DN): if the inverse image `f^*M` along an étale morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` surjective on
points is quasi-coherent, so is `M`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasicoherentOnSite_of_modulePullback_of_isSurjective (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsEtale B S hS f.hom) (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f.hom)
    (M : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (h : ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj M).IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    M.IsQuasicoherentOnSite
declarations.comment: consequence (3), property 'quasi-coherent': for a surjective étale morphism f : Y → X of algebraic spaces and a module 𝓕 on X, if f^*𝓕 is quasi-coherent then 𝓕 is quasi-coherent

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCoherentOnSite_of_modulePullback_of_isSurjective
declarations.doc:
**Coherence descends along a surjective étale morphism** (Stacks 05VR, with Stacks 03DN): if
the inverse image `f^*M` along an étale morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` surjective on points is coherent,
so is `M`.  Coherence of `f^*M` restricts to the slice at an étale chart `V₀` of `Y` surjective
on points, crosses the slice comparison of Stacks 04M0 to the slice of `X` at the composite
chart, and descends from that surjective chart to `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCoherentOnSite_of_modulePullback_of_isSurjective (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsEtale B S hS f.hom) (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f.hom)
    (M : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (h : SheafOfModules.IsCoherentOnSite ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj M)) :
    SheafOfModules.IsCoherentOnSite M
declarations.comment: consequence (3), property 'coherent': for a surjective étale morphism f : Y → X of algebraic spaces and a module 𝓕 on X, if f^*𝓕 is coherent then 𝓕 is coherent
